title: Workflow declarations and runtime execution differ
body: workflow_execution_bindings explicitly distinguishes executable_runtime and executable_validator. graph_registry nevertheless emits executes edges from listed project-stream skills. execute_project_stream invokes the registered workflow handler, not each listed skill body. Treat those generated executes edges as declared composition unless the handler proves invocation.
note: 05 Findings/D01 Workflow declarations and runtime execution differ.md

title: The original bounded orchestrator has a narrower effect path
body: Orchestrator.run calls enforce without effect_grant_path, signature, trust policy or project/session bindings. enforce requires these for NON_READ_EFFECTS. Consequently this entrypoint cannot establish those non-read executions as written. Agent/Workflow Studio have separate authority paths; this does not mean all PX mutation is blocked.
note: 05 Findings/D02 The original bounded orchestrator has a narrower effect path.md

title: Verification strength depends on the entrypoint
body: Orchestrator imports verify, which is a compatibility alias to evaluate_claims. verify_authoritative instead resolves signed policy and postcondition records against a scope and approved producers. These mechanisms should not be collapsed into one trust level.
note: 05 Findings/D03 Verification strength depends on the entrypoint.md

title: Learning is operationally meaningful but deliberately mediated
body: The signed learning controller has concrete transitions, frozen revisions, statistical comparisons, research/final gates and a linked knowledge proposal. admit_learning_candidate records canonical_writes_performed=false. Separate knowledge verification, approval and promotion are required before reuse measurement can affect canonical authority.
note: 05 Findings/D04 Learning is operationally meaningful but deliberately mediated.md

title: Decay changes future access, with bounded propagation
body: Measured reuse can write authority_status=suspect and require revalidation. resolve_canonical refuses authoritative access in that state. If no dependency graph is supplied, measure_learning_reuse creates only the knowledge node with no edges: broad downstream invalidation is not established by the default path.
note: 05 Findings/D05 Decay changes future access, with bounded propagation.md

title: Saved memory notes describe an earlier architecture
body: An earlier repository-local memory architecture note reported missing typed ontology. Current semantic_memory defines structured payloads, entities, typed relations, namespaces and exact query signals, and MemoryVault projects them into index generations. The report uses current implementation rather than inheriting the earlier gap claim. No private reference content was imported.
note: 05 Findings/D06 Saved memory notes describe an earlier architecture.md

title: Canonical memory and canonical knowledge are separate stores
body: MemoryVault controls project record revisions, lifecycle eligibility and retrieval. KnowledgeCoreController controls signed proposals and canonical knowledge heads. No universally enforced automatic mapping between their identities or lifecycles was established in this inspection.
note: 05 Findings/D07 Canonical memory and canonical knowledge are separate stores.md

title: Foundry and cross-domain reasoning have concrete limits
body: Foundry extracts lines/headings/list items and chooses fixed capability templates by term hits. Structural analogy scores supplied mechanism/relationship records, while theory induction groups shared signatures. These are useful deterministic candidate-making operations; arbitrary source understanding, invention and target implementation require additional work.
note: 05 Findings/D08 Foundry and cross-domain reasoning have concrete limits.md

title: Several plausible self-improvement loops lack automatic wiring
body: No automatic driver was established for event-bus-to-learning capture, repeated-run-to-process-record mining, research-method self-rewriting, theory-to-learning payload conversion, canonical knowledge-to-skill implementation, or new capabilities automatically opening research priorities. Those are unresolved caller-mediated boundaries and are excluded from confirmed closed-loop claims.
note: 05 Findings/D09 Several plausible self-improvement loops lack automatic wiring.md

title: Local release prose differs from the current user report
body: README still says v0.7.0 certification/publication are pending and START_HERE defaults to v0.6.3. The user reports Marketplace publication and verification on 2026-09-08. Record this as local-documentation versus user-report discrepancy; Marketplace state was not independently queried.
note: 05 Findings/D10 Local release prose differs from the current user report.md

title: Operational completion is stronger than output presence
body: Project-stream completion checks whether required named outputs exist after the handler and checks elapsed time/lease validity. Signed postcondition verification and installed interaction-denominator evidence are separate mechanisms. A completed stream result should retain its actual evidence scope.
note: 05 Findings/D11 Operational completion is stronger than output presence.md

title: The graph family is an interpretation with auditable boundaries
body: Layers group responsibilities analytically; they are not claimed to be declared deployable services. Every node and edge carries source anchors. Direct means source-level behavior, not a fresh runtime test. Handoff/inferred edges remain visibly distinct. The large catalog inventory is navigation coverage, not proof that every capability was semantically audited.
note: 05 Findings/D12 The graph family is an interpretation with auditable boundaries.md

title: Model execution has two materially different paths
body: Python execute_agent_plan reserves placement capacity and calls supplied GPU/CPU functions; it does not call ProviderInvocationGateway. Agent Studio can instead prepare a VS Code-host model request and validate the returned model/options/token evidence. The host can expose a local Ollama provider. These paths are shown separately; no universal gateway funnel is claimed.
note: 05 Findings/D13 Model execution has two materially different paths.md

title: Skill promotion propagates both availability and staleness
body: Skill Studio updates canonical bytes and catalog/index/admission projections in its lifecycle transaction. Cheap semantic metadata is rebuilt from the unpublished after-tree; heavier projections are listed in stale_blocked with a block-until-rebuild policy. Pass 8 narrows the earlier enforcement claim: the world-state reader expects another shape, and the dashboard capability graph reader does not consult this marker. Newly selectable skill metadata and an explicitly stale graph obligation can coexist; universal consumer blocking is not established.
note: 05 Findings/D14 Skill promotion propagates both availability and staleness.md

title: Reasoning recursion and operational learning are different loops
body: Strategy selection recursively orders declared mode dependencies; logic and belief projection iterate to bounded fixed points. Those computational loops do not themselves alter installed capabilities. Capability mutation, practice transfer and optimization produce candidate reports. The signed Learning and Knowledge controllers own the separate persistence boundary.
note: 05 Findings/D15 Reasoning recursion and operational learning are different loops.md

title: The independent panel evaluates artifacts rather than launching agents
body: The panel consumes isolated branch records, flags evidence shared by every branch and reports weighted agreement plus dissent. It always reports rounds_used=1 and authority_granted=False. The max_rounds argument does not establish repeated critique, agent isolation execution or independent source acquisition.
note: 05 Findings/D16 The independent panel evaluates artifacts rather than launching agents.md

title: Analytical uncertainty must survive the handoff
body: Constraint search reports exhaustion and truncation; causal analysis tests a supplied DAG, not its truth; robust decisions depend on caller intervals; belief confidence is explicitly heuristic. A caller that discards these caveats would strengthen conclusions beyond the source contract.
note: 05 Findings/D17 Analytical uncertainty must survive the handoff.md

title: Observed-effects fields have different evidence strength
body: RuntimeLifecycle.run_verified_tool copies declared_effects into observed_effects after a successful callback. That receipt records wrapper-level attribution, not independent OS measurement. Separate operational observers exist. A graph reader must follow the producing path before using an observation field as proof of the actual effect.
note: 05 Findings/D18 Observed-effects fields have different evidence strength.md

title: Canonical and certified are scoped terms
body: Transcript canonical records mean schema-conformant extraction records; Memory Vault admission, signed Knowledge Core heads and Skill Studio canonical bytes each have different owners. Skeptical assurance certified is a metadata-based policy result; a release certificate has separate artifact and operational requirements. Reusing the words across these boundaries would hide material differences.
note: 05 Findings/D19 Canonical and certified are scoped terms.md

title: Declared script names can map to generic behavior
body: The declared suite plans registered procedures, but script execution chooses a handler by tokens in outcome_id. Map names inventory files, rank names rank supplied values, and unmatched names normalize a record. A detailed domain name does not establish a dedicated domain algorithm or execution of every planned step.
note: 05 Findings/D20 Declared script names can map to generic behavior.md

title: Canonical persistence and graph success are deliberately separable
body: persist_with_graph_isolation writes the vault before invoking the graph callback. A failed derived write leaves canonical_persisted=True and requires reconciliation. StateKVGuard bounds the wait and opens a circuit on failures; canceling a Future does not demonstrate that a running callback has ceased effects.
note: 05 Findings/D21 Canonical persistence and graph success are deliberately separable.md

title: A planned lifecycle step is not evidence of its application
body: Memory remediation may mark individual steps apply=true while explicitly returning mutated=False. Durable-goal transitions return state objects without disk writes. Candidate compilation in operational_controls selects record IDs. These are useful decision contracts, but they must remain separate from executors and persistent transition owners.
note: 05 Findings/D22 A planned lifecycle step is not evidence of its application.md

title: Startup and surface health use different projections
body: World state aggregates bounded metadata into GREEN, STALE or BLOCKED and asks for selected hydration. Missing source authority makes startup UNVERIFIED. The registered health evaluator separately derives healthy/degraded/stale/blocked/unknown from lifecycle facts, TTLs and failures. Their states require context rather than direct string equivalence.
note: 05 Findings/D23 Startup and surface health use different projections.md

title: The workflow scheduler is richer than its standalone adapter set
body: Workflow Studio has scheduling, branches, approval, joins, retries and typed outputs. The inspected workflow_worker currently executes identity, increment, double, fail and sleep. It rechecks signed task/executor/grant bindings and runs declarative validation checks. Broad catalog composition is therefore not evidence that arbitrary skills execute through this worker.
note: 05 Findings/D24 The workflow scheduler is richer than its standalone adapter set.md

title: A deeper caller sweep found the actual hybrid-retrieval adapter
body: The first runtime-only sweep missed the portable CLI under .px/skills. That adapter imports the source or installed canonical retrieval owner, constructs typed corpus records and calls retrieve. The atlas now links this concrete path and removes the speculative recall-to-generic-kernel connection. No universal Agent Studio or canonical-memory adapter follows from this discovery.
note: 05 Findings/D25 A deeper caller sweep found the actual hybrid-retrieval adapter.md

title: Automatic operation exists where an actual driver is present
body: CanonicalMemoryLeaseController explicitly starts a timer, bounds intervals and coalesces renewals. Durable Studio terminal observation checks worker exit before finalization. These have concrete drivers. By comparison, the inspected learning API accepts externally prepared observations/trials/metrics; no equivalent automatic acquisition-and-promotion driver was found in the scoped caller sweep.
note: 05 Findings/D26 Automatic operation exists where an actual driver is present.md

title: Owner registries and runtime reachability answer different questions
body: Primitive/effect registries validate which owner is canonical. A caller search locates whether and where an operation is actually invoked. Tests establish assertions in source, while exact installed operational receipts establish exercised behavior. The atlas retains these evidence levels instead of treating one as a substitute for all the others.
note: 05 Findings/D27 Owner registries and runtime reachability answer different questions.md

title: The Studio reuse route does not forward the dependency graph
body: measure_learning_reuse accepts dependency_graph and dependency_current_revisions, and direct-controller tests demonstrate downstream projection and release-evidence invalidation. The Studio measure-reuse branch forwards counts and approval only. Consequently its current route uses the singleton fallback; a general propagation claim requires a different caller or an adapter change.
note: 05 Findings/D28 The Studio reuse route does not forward the dependency graph.md

title: Authority restoration exists but has a narrower proof contract
body: revalidate_learning requires a decayed pipeline, explicit approval, a nonempty evidence reference, a 64-hex hash and the expected suspect canonical identity. It updates the pipeline and then the signed head, retaining dependent_rebuild_required. It does not resolve those supplied evidence bytes in this method. The inspected Studio dispatch exposes no restoration operation, so this is a controller-level path with source-test evidence.
note: 05 Findings/D29 Authority restoration exists but has a narrower proof contract.md

title: Theory proposal requirements exceed the fields checked by its validator
body: Induction advertises distinctness, held-out generalization, failure boundary and operational value as required evidence. validate_proposal currently computes the pass rate from supplied held-out passed flags and checks truthy distinctness evidence. It does not explicitly validate failure-boundary or operational-value fields, execute held-out cases, or promote a theory.
note: 05 Findings/D30 Theory proposal requirements exceed the fields checked by its validator.md

title: The deterministic harness does not execute a natural-language objective
body: agent_harness_worker authenticates the task and runs the explicit sha256, json-keys or bounded-delay tool calls. Its result states model_invoked=False and records whether an objective was received plus its hash. The host-model path is where language-model invocation occurs. Treating these as one agent execution capability would conceal a substantial runtime boundary.
note: 05 Findings/D31 The deterministic harness does not execute a natural-language objective.md

title: Host instructions are an operational connection the earlier map understated
body: Active native procedures explicitly prescribe research extraction, foundry compilation and novelty review. The absence of a Python driver is therefore insufficient to call the whole connection missing. These are now explicit instruction-mediated handoffs: source proves a procedure exists, while actual host compliance, effects and promotion require their own evidence.
note: 05 Findings/D32 Host instructions are an operational connection the earlier map understated.md

title: A deferred wrapper is not an active learning engine
body: adapt-human-learning-loop has status mapped_deferred and inactive_external_candidate_wrapper provenance despite a current validation_freshness field and rich capability tags. research-to-capability and forge-skills-from-knowledge have active package records. Preserve status, source type and selection boundary rather than inferring behavior from names.
note: 05 Findings/D33 A deferred wrapper is not an active learning engine.md

title: Coordination has concrete state transitions but completion remains caller reported
body: MCP handlers directly create a DAG, claim scopes, renew leases, record usage/progress and reconcile completed tasks. Progress can mark budget-exceeded work blocked. Reconciliation records supplied evidence and conflicts_resolved and releases claims; it does not itself merge code, run acceptance tests or terminate a worker.
note: 05 Findings/D34 Coordination has concrete state transitions but completion remains caller reported.md

title: Studio commit and UI delivery are separate result boundaries
body: The host rechecks version allocation and source identity before saving. After the backend call, it validates the commit receipt. Invalid receipt yields commit-outcome-unverified; valid commit plus failed cleanup, refresh or notification yields warnings while preserving committed identity. This is more precise than treating a dashboard error as proof that saving failed.
note: 05 Findings/D35 Studio commit and UI delivery are separate result boundaries.md

title: Semantic selection has several distinct contracts
body: The cheap semantic index builds profiles and descriptions, while navigate computes weighted lexical evidence and an exact-alias boost. Independent discovery allows candidate metadata; later routing makes active/admitted and policy-filtered items selectable. Working-set dependency recursion rolls back a bundle when it cannot fit. These operations rank and explain metadata; they do not invoke a model or prove task feasibility.
note: 05 Findings/D36 Semantic selection has several distinct contracts.md

title: Persistence guarantees belong to specific publication units
body: Coordination withState publishes deferred files, state, event, receipt and handoff in order. The protected Python ledger publishes event bytes before its head; validation detects head/chain disagreement. Studio directory publication uses a no-replace atomic primitive. These are different guarantees: neither a file lock nor a hash chain makes every related file a single atomic transaction. This is source reasoning about interruption boundaries, not a reproduced crash result.
note: 05 Findings/D37 Persistence guarantees belong to specific publication units.md

title: Task fencing and budget checks need their caller contract
body: Progress checks the owner and active lease, then validates the fencing-token entries supplied by the caller. It accumulates caller-reported usage and marks over-budget work blocked. The inspected tests prove source assertions about stale supplied tokens and blocked state; neither the function nor those assertions establish mandatory complete token submission or worker termination.
note: 05 Findings/D38 Task fencing and budget checks need their caller contract.md

title: Static coverage labels do not establish all runtime effects
body: The source coverage validator checks control labels, available owner/contract/test files and eligible skill statuses. The effect scanner recognizes selected Python AST call spellings and checks a stored inventory. These complement execution evidence; they do not observe JavaScript MCP mutations, arbitrary aliases or the truth of every operational label.
note: 05 Findings/D39 Static coverage labels do not establish all runtime effects.md

title: Generated authority cycles are different from adaptive feedback loops
body: Generated input declarations must be acyclic. Artifact reachability deliberately excludes live evidence/completion/world-state/gap-head projections and engine identity to avoid self-invalidating digest cycles, while retaining independent owners. Runtime learning and control feedback can legitimately be cyclic; applying one graph rule to both would misrepresent the architecture.
note: 05 Findings/D40 Generated authority cycles are different from adaptive feedback loops.md

title: Inspected test assertions corroborate the new host boundaries
body: Coordination tests cover overlap ordering, explicit reconciliation, stale supplied fencing tokens and budget-blocked state. Studio host tests assert that failed post-commit delivery/refresh preserve a created-with-delivery-warning outcome. These are existing test-source assertions; this report does not claim they were freshly executed.
note: 05 Findings/D41 Inspected test assertions corroborate the new host boundaries.md

title: Procedural memory naming does not close the process-mining gap
body: The active memory-fabric procedure prescribes explicit capture, lifecycle and retrieval commands. The package named procedural-memory-compiler is mapped_deferred. Its existence cannot establish an active automatic producer for runtime.process_memory records. Host-mediated governance explains operational composition while this specific automation/adapter question remains open. Pass 8 found the separate active trace-to-skill-compiler package, which prescribes host normalization and CLI compilation. Thus a documented capture procedure exists; the remaining gap concerns automation and executable-package construction.
note: 05 Findings/D42 Procedural memory naming does not close the process-mining gap.md

title: An active trace procedure closes part of the process-capture explanation
body: trace-to-skill-compiler is active and directs the host to normalize successful and failed traces into the engineering-process schema and call process compile. The earlier review emphasized the differently named mapped-deferred procedural-memory-compiler. That was incomplete: a documented host producer exists. Automatic repeated-run mining, host compliance and the downstream executable package adapter remain separate questions.
note: 05 Findings/D43 An active trace procedure closes part of the process-capture explanation.md

title: Process compilation trusts submitted verification and emits a linear execution graph
body: The schema requires an outcome_met boolean, nonempty check/evidence string lists and failure verified booleans. The compiler checks those flags but does not resolve evidence bytes or run checks. decision_graph and tool_graph preserve supplied entries; execution_graph assigns each step only its preceding step as a dependency. Branch discovery and an emitted tested SKILL package are not implemented by this function, despite the richer procedural goals.
note: 05 Findings/D44 Process compilation trusts submitted verification and emits a linear execution graph.md

title: Two generated graph APIs use incompatible edge keys
body: generated_dependency_graph emits source/target edges. adapt_generated_dependency_graph reads only from/to, silently skipping records without both keys; its test explicitly supplies from/to. Directly composing these two APIs would therefore produce no adapted edges or nodes. This is a source-derived contract counterexample, not a claim that a production caller currently makes that direct call.
note: 05 Findings/D45 Two generated graph APIs use incompatible edge keys.md

title: Studio staleness does not match the world-state reader shape
body: Skill promotion writes schema px.skill-promotion-projection-staleness/1.0 with stale_blocked. build_world_state reads projections entries whose stale flag is True. With only the Studio shape, it derives no stale projection IDs and the projections component becomes GREEN. Overall health can still be BLOCKED for ledger reasons. No automatic format bridge was located in the bounded caller sweep.
note: 05 Findings/D46 Studio staleness does not match the world-state reader shape.md

title: A rebuild policy marker is weaker than a consumer gate
body: plan_projection_rebuild classifies work and does not invoke builders. The dashboard capability-graph branch directly reads cognitive_map_index and does not consult projection_staleness. The inspected test named expensive_skill_projection_staleness_is_explicitly_blocking only asserts a constructed dictionary contains the list and policy string. Independent builder equality checks exist during reconciliation, but they do not establish that every graph read is blocked.
note: 05 Findings/D47 A rebuild policy marker is weaker than a consumer gate.md

title: Lifecycle process completion is a metadata presence check
body: record_process_candidate optionally writes a process receipt and appends its relative path to evidence.process_records. lifecycle_status marks process-capture complete from bool(process_records). It does not resolve those receipt bytes in that stage check. Verification-stage checks also distinguish a few sentinel statuses rather than independently rerunning verification. This metadata router must not be treated as a release certificate.
note: 05 Findings/D48 Lifecycle process completion is a metadata presence check.md

title: Canonical knowledge has a real browsing consumer
body: KnowledgeCoreController.browse reads signed canonical heads and rollback history and projects authority/revalidation flags. That is a concrete consumer even though the exact-name search found no production resolve_canonical caller. Browsing metadata, resolving authoritative revision bytes and injecting content into an agent remain separate consumption paths.
note: 05 Findings/D49 Canonical knowledge has a real browsing consumer.md

title: A valid Doctor report can describe a blocked system
body: compose_doctor_report requires exactly eight sections and valid states/remediation links, then selects blocked before degraded before healthy. It sets valid=True for the report, operable unless blocked, and ready/certification_ready only when healthy. The inspected tests assert these differences. Those flags belong to diagnostic composition and do not issue a release certificate.
note: 05 Findings/D50 A valid Doctor report can describe a blocked system.md

title: Recovery health is bounded by configured authorities
body: RecoveryCoordinator runs configured WAL/state/callback checks. Missing event/session/resource callback groups may be healthy with configured=False. Doctor passes only its known existing WAL roots and apply=False, and downgrades an absence of discovered WALs to degraded. A healthy reconciliation is not a claim that every possible state owner was examined.
note: 05 Findings/D51 Recovery health is bounded by configured authorities.md

title: Failure root grouping is exact evidence matching rather than causal discovery
body: group_candidate_roots groups identical combined evidence/owner/dependency signatures after enforcing the complete unique failure denominator. Merely overlapping signatures remain separate. The discriminating plan proposes removals/substitutions but does not execute them, and caller-confirmed candidate IDs still grant no repair authority.
note: 05 Findings/D52 Failure root grouping is exact evidence matching rather than causal discovery.md

title: Studio catalog status can change when current projections drift
body: The catalog status reader verifies current projection bytes against the signed committed lifecycle transaction. The inspected test changes only whitespace in skill-index.json and asserts the revision loses promoted status while its admission remains authenticated and a promotion error is retained. The bridge uses that projection, and the UI falls back to candidate when no authenticated status exists. This is a current-proof dependency, not a reversal of historical publication.
note: 05 Findings/D53 Studio catalog status can change when current projections drift.md

title: Route classification and observed coverage are different denominators
body: validate_route_registry checks declared tier/mechanism pairings and marks the registry certifiable when valid and no advertised Tier D route remains. Doctor also calls reconcile_operation_coverage with health evidence and freshness before assigning its coverage state. A valid declaration alone does not prove current observer health or that the declared mediator ran.
note: 05 Findings/D54 Route classification and observed coverage are different denominators.md

title: Atomic decision functions need a separate persistent owner
body: reserve_budget and atomic_work_checkout compute new records over caller-supplied snapshots. They contain no lock, durable read/commit or worker effect. These are separate from ProviderBudgetLedger and coordination claim persistence. Two callers can evaluate the same prior snapshot; a real persistence owner must serialize acceptance.
note: 05 Findings/D55 Atomic decision functions need a separate persistent owner.md

title: Dependency additions do not update candidate capability coverage
body: optimize_candidate_package updates covered during greedy selection, then appends admitted dependencies without updating covered. Consequently covered_capabilities describes the greedy selection, not necessarily the union of the final package. For example, a selected candidate satisfying required X can pull in a dependency offering additional Y while the report still lists only X. This is source-derived accounting behavior, not an executed product test or a demonstrated false-incomplete result.
note: 05 Findings/D56 Dependency additions do not update candidate capability coverage.md

title: Offline improvement evidence remains supplied input
body: The offline comparison checks distinct actor/optimizer/judge strings and matched held-out score records, requiring an improvement within the regression allowance. It returns quarantined_candidate and requires_independent_promotion=True. It neither runs the experiment nor verifies the independence of those identities.
note: 05 Findings/D57 Offline improvement evidence remains supplied input.md

title: Completed tasks can still contribute zero sidebar completion
body: Sidebar progress counts only reconciled tasks. completed and verifying map to verifying; approved cancelled/skipped tasks are excluded from the weighted denominator. This is a deliberate projection distinction between output delivery and reconciliation, independent of render acknowledgement.
note: 05 Findings/D58 Completed tasks can still contribute zero sidebar completion.md

title: Workflow trace helper tests and browser code have different owners
body: The CommonJS projectWorkflowTrace helper is imported by its unit test, while the dashboard uses a separate projectWorkflowTraceResult implementation. Both inspect workflow/version/run identity and conflicting hashes, but a helper test is not evidence that the actual browser implementation executed. The atlas now anchors the browser producer/consumer too.
note: 05 Findings/D59 Workflow trace helper tests and browser code have different owners.md

title: MCP runtime verified is invocation-scoped
body: observeMcpRuntime requires registration, integrity-valid activity and one fresh successful invocation matching the exact server version; its default window is 24 hours. It retains the matching operation and event. This is stronger than registered metadata but narrower than all-tools behavioral certification.
note: 05 Findings/D60 MCP runtime verified is invocation-scoped.md

title: Cleanup reclaimed counts include retained local quarantine
body: Cleanup can move an unchanged staged tree to local quarantine after recycling fails. The final confirmedResults set includes that state when calculating resources_reclaimed and bytes_reclaimed. Those counters describe disposition of the original cache location, not measured disk-space recovery. Errors with disappearance remain disposition-uncertain.
note: 05 Findings/D61 Cleanup reclaimed counts include retained local quarantine.md

title: Rollback identity custody is not an available rollback artifact
body: Extension uninstall retains the exact prior version before native dispatch. Rollback consumes custody only after that version is observed again; command failure, wrong version or pending reload leaves it retained. When no hash-bound local VSIX exists, actual restoration still depends on an available source accepted by VS Code.
note: 05 Findings/D62 Rollback identity custody is not an available rollback artifact.md

title: Host cache metadata contains more than its read gate checks
body: MetadataCache.set records dependency_fingerprints, but get checks the supplied source fingerprint and maximum age; it does not compare each dependency field. PxBridge separately propagates revisions, clears request caches and incorporates revision fingerprints into some keys. Correct cache use depends on that caller wiring.
note: 05 Findings/D63 Host cache metadata contains more than its read gate checks.md

title: A provider isolation harness performs real provider operations
body: run_provider_isolation_suite invokes a supplied factory twice and executes synthetic writes, reads, searches, prompt-log checks, injected failure and correction. It is not merely metadata scoring, but certification remains bounded to those seven probes and the supplied provider/configuration. This report inspected the implementation without executing the harness.
note: 05 Findings/D64 A provider isolation harness performs real provider operations.md

title: Listener coverage can mean registered rather than exercised
body: markRegistered can mark an available enabled listener healthy with events_recorded still zero. snapshot excludes unsupported required APIs from incomplete and can report coverage_complete when the bus is connected. buildActivityAttestation copies the same supplied effect label into declared and observed. Read this as supported listener registration/publication coverage, with explicit limitations, rather than independent observation of every actual effect.
note: 05 Findings/D65 Listener coverage can mean registered rather than exercised.md

title: Activity cancellation and repair have narrower meanings
body: reconcileStaleOperations emits a cancelled activity record without killing a process. repairActivityIntegrity retains exact pre-repair backups, reconstructs predecessor hashes and reseals parsed records. Its postcondition proves internal consistency of that repaired chain, not original event authenticity. recordActivity appends JSONL before atomic state publication; those two files are not one atomic transaction.
note: 05 Findings/D66 Activity cancellation and repair have narrower meanings.md

title: Source coverage labels differ from exact execution evidence
body: certify_python_surfaces source mode accepts supplied exact-tool flags, associates tests textually and can assign generic full-suite-and-installed-integration labels. The function does not thereby resolve fresh passing execution receipts for each surface. certify_exact_tools contains an actual bounded execution harness, with its own fixtures and repeat comparison. Both were inspected, not run here.
note: 05 Findings/D67 Source coverage labels differ from exact execution evidence.md

title: Enterprise readiness is a write and billable policy is a decision
body: enterpriseDoctor initializes and mutates enterprise state, appends an event and writes a receipt. Its cloud_connectors_ready remains false. evaluateBillableExecution checks caller-supplied spend, cost, resource and approval values without a persistent reservation in that function. Treat configuration, readiness reporting, authorization and actual billing execution as separate owners.
note: 05 Findings/D68 Enterprise readiness is a write and billable policy is a decision.md

title: Studio staging publication and reclamation are separate contracts
body: materializeSkillPackage registers custody before writing files individually to the target and verifies the complete tree before recording published. Failure retains uncertain resources. Reclamation requires a matching durable draft-create receipt, closed lifecycle record and exact inventory, then checks the moved tree before deleting the owned staging resource. This is distinct from canonical immutable revision publication.
note: 05 Findings/D69 Studio staging publication and reclamation are separate contracts.md

title: A valid installed index may retain partial observation coverage
body: build_index binds current receipt and artifact/engine identities plus platform smoke evidence, including process_tree_closed_verified. Listener coverage_complete false adds a limitation; it is not independently a blocking reason in that branch. Therefore index validity, exact byte identity and complete activity observation are separate claims.
note: 05 Findings/D70 A valid installed index may retain partial observation coverage.md

title: Product validity and whole-tree validity have different denominators
body: classify_tree separates product_errors from all classification errors. Unclassified paths may fail overall valid while product_valid remains true. Control-plane and evidence content hashes are omitted from the product digest, so product identity alone is not a digest of all repository evidence.
note: 05 Findings/D71 Product validity and whole-tree validity have different denominators.md

title: Child exit is not a descendant census
body: terminateProcessTreeAsync first signals the child and resolves on its exit/close, cancelling escalation. That success branch does not independently enumerate surviving descendants. Other callers and reconciliation evidence must establish process-tree closure; this source observation is not a demonstrated live orphan-process incident.
note: 05 Findings/D72 Child exit is not a descendant census.md

title: Candidate test evidence may be supplied rather than executed
body: test_evidence_builder derives proposal admission_ready from supplied case fields. orchestration_builder generates evidence_steps with status current as proposal metadata. Neither establishes independently resolved current execution receipts. Keep those producer fields separate from runtime certification owners.
note: 05 Findings/D73 Candidate test evidence may be supplied rather than executed.md

title: A resumed release can finish its journal while its aggregate remains invalid
body: execute_all starts a new stages list and calls next_pending_step, which skips and verifies earlier passed stages. Its final valid compares this invocation list length to the entire 12-stage STEP_ORDER. Therefore a resumed call with prior passed stages can finish the journal but return valid false and count only newly executed stages. This is source-derived behavior, not a product reproduction.
note: 05 Findings/D74 A resumed release can finish its journal while its aggregate remains invalid.md

title: The installed owner has nested parallel and serial order
body: Windows and Ubuntu smoke processes start before either wait; validation results are retained separately. Exhaustive starts afterward even if a parsed smoke result is invalid, while launch/wait exceptions prevent reaching it. All three must pass before settlement advances the campaign.
note: 05 Findings/D75 The installed owner has nested parallel and serial order.md

title: An authoritative-named trace helper uses substring correlation
body: authoritative_runtime_path tests the requested correlation string anywhere in json.dumps(event), skips malformed JSON or TypeError and sorts string timestamp values. Matching rows are useful navigation evidence but do not establish an exact causal trace or full malformed-record accounting.
note: 05 Findings/D76 An authoritative-named trace helper uses substring correlation.md

title: External service templates leave meaningful deployment work
body: The Edge Function checks a header but leaves authentication and idempotent work as comments. The vector schema has RLS enabled without local policies and has no explicit tenant predicate in match_documents. The queue composition retains a pin placeholder. These are concrete scaffold boundaries; they do not establish an exploit or behavior in a deployed system.
note: 05 Findings/D77 External service templates leave meaningful deployment work.md

title: Read-only enterprise MCP routes can persist state without the write gate
body: pacify_enterprise_status and pacify_billable_guardrail_evaluate are read-only annotated but call initializeEnterprise with default persistence. Missing or migrated state causes a write. Middleware authorizes only non-read-only annotations and derives both declared and observed effects from the label. Dashboard callers pass persist false. Existing tests separately check nonpersisting initialization and tool labels but do not cover this composition. This is source-derived, not a fresh execution finding.
note: 05 Findings/D78 Read-only enterprise MCP routes can persist state without the write gate.md

title: Empty MCP context can pass the probe and support runtime_verified
body: Production definition and probe pass an empty context path. contextEnvelope falls back to an empty object; the context snapshot uses a truthiness fallback, so it returns that object. Probe accepts truthy structuredContent. Middleware records success for every resolved handler value, and observed runtime status checks event metadata rather than useful payload content. The evidence proves narrower invocation conditions.
note: 05 Findings/D79 Empty MCP context can pass the probe and support runtime_verified.md

title: The structural function denominator includes a generated dependency bundle
body: server/index.js is esbuild output from source.mjs with dependencies, not another independent authored subsystem. Its 4,383 extracted functions remain visible as artifact contents; authored and test functions are counted separately in the semantic ledger. Builder check mode could establish exact byte identity, but was not executed. VSIX packaging separately compiles the extension entry and retains the MCP bundle.
note: 05 Findings/D80 The structural function denominator includes a generated dependency bundle.md

title: Loaded dashboard bridge and navigation registry are not the controller implementation
body: The HTML loads 20-bridge.js and 40-surfaces.js, which define reusable modules. Controller constructs its own VS Code wrapper and visible/advanced arrays and registers its own message listener. The helper spread allows payload.type to override its first argument, but no controller use was found, so that helper behavior is not asserted as a production routing fault.
note: 05 Findings/D81 Loaded dashboard bridge and navigation registry are not the controller implementation.md

title: Enterprise state, event and doctor receipt have separate commit points
body: initialize can persist missing or migrated state. mutate writes sealed state before appending its event; doctor then writes a separate receipt. load substitutes defaults after read/parse errors, which does not itself establish preserved recovery of malformed existing data. No one transaction spans these writes.
note: 05 Findings/D82 Enterprise state, event and doctor receipt have separate commit points.md

title: Successor config construction relies on supplied artifact identities
body: The builder transforms predecessor string values and overwrites explicit successor fields from CLI input; it does not independently hash artifact bytes or prove the predecessor terminal state. It writes automation before stage configuration, so a later failure can leave the first output.
note: 05 Findings/D83 Successor config construction relies on supplied artifact identities.md

title: Certification and complete are separate producer fields
body: The UI gives certified plus fresh first precedence. Tracing upstream narrows the initial concern: build_completion_status requires no gate blockers before freshness and certified can become true, so it does not normally emit certified/fresh with current_gates false. complete is separately derived from blocking_reasons, including historical acceptance. Dashboard verifies stored ledger/engine/source bindings and clears green claims on mismatch. Do not label the UI precedence alone a proven certification fault.
note: 05 Findings/D84 Certification and complete are separate producer fields.md

title: Native helper verification and durable state have narrower authority
body: claim-ledger verify assigns a caller-selected status and timestamp without reading evidence. durable-state transition accepts any name and rewrites the JSON; new can replace an existing file. permission-guard matches supplied patterns and prints an approval label without enforcing an effect or approval. Keep these helpers distinct from runtime claim, lifecycle and host admission authorities.
note: 05 Findings/D85 Native helper verification and durable state have narrower authority.md

title: Native memory checking and writing are separate caller steps
body: memory-write-gate checks supplied source/scope/verified and three sensitive patterns. scoped-memory requires a flag for semantic/procedural writes but never calls that gate, authenticates scope or independently verifies evidence. Its delete-scope removes matching rows by direct rewrite. No automatic gate-to-store integration is asserted, and the canonical memory vault remains a distinct owner.
note: 05 Findings/D86 Native memory checking and writing are separate caller steps.md

title: Helper analytical and replay outputs retain supplied-input limits
body: Context packing uses supplied token costs without requiring nonnegative values; retrieval evaluation scores supplied IDs and accepts the supplied citation flag. Trace recorder hashes stable fields without timestamp, so repeated spans can share IDs. Replay-bundle records paths/hashes and textual instructions; it does not preserve or replay the files.
note: 05 Findings/D87 Helper analytical and replay outputs retain supplied-input limits.md

title: Helper permission changes request tests without invalidating prior evidence
body: recertification-impact adds adversarial and resilience suites for permissions_changed, but invalidate_prior_evidence is computed only from code_changed or dependencies_changed. It computes a proposal over supplied graph/flags and does not execute invalidation. Certification-aggregator only combines PASS/active labels; it explicitly does not replace independent production approval.
note: 05 Findings/D88 Helper permission changes request tests without invalidating prior evidence.md

title: Native protocol metadata is weaker than implemented compatibility
body: protocol-validator tests required-key presence, without values/types/full specification checks. OpenAPI importer creates tool metadata and schema path strings but no schema files; it derives risk/idempotence from method alone. Backend probe lists SGLang installed when python is found, and hardware probe labels an opted-in failed GPU probe completed. These are exact source predicates, not observed deployed behavior.
note: 05 Findings/D89 Native protocol metadata is weaker than implemented compatibility.md

title: Native patch scope omits deleted-file destinations
body: patch-scope-guard adds paths only from +++ b/ headers. A deleted-file header uses +++ /dev/null, so the removed path is absent from denied-file checks; its removed text still contributes to the line count. Empty allowed patterns disable path filtering. The helper reports a decision and does not intercept another executor applying a patch.
note: 05 Findings/D90 Native patch scope omits deleted-file destinations.md

title: Native verification runners test embedded examples and can accept zero cases
body: Differential/metamorphic runners exercise local softmax functions; formula tests exercise one local KV formula; fuzz runner calls Python json.loads. Case counts are not required positive, so no iterations can still yield PASS. Mutation operator only writes a variant, while judge/trajectory helpers score supplied fields and can exit successfully with a negative result field. Their process success must not be read as universal target verification.
note: 05 Findings/D91 Native verification runners test embedded examples and can accept zero cases.md

title: Supply-chain helper declarations do not enforce or attest execution
body: Sandbox profile writes desired restrictions; tool policy checks truthy approval_id and rollback_ready. Provenance generator records supplied command strings without running/signing them. SBOM-lite hashes top-level manifests without parsing dependencies. Deterministic archive uses fixed timestamps but does not exclude an output created inside its source tree. Keep these artifacts distinct from enforced runtime boundaries and exact release certificates.
note: 05 Findings/D92 Supply-chain helper declarations do not enforce or attest execution.md

title: Sanitation primary bounds do not constrain its separate secret scan
body: build_sanitation_summary bounds and hashes its first corpus, then calls scan_secret_shapes(root) through a separate os.walk/full-file-read path without explicit count/byte ceilings. That scanner applies shared external-scope checks to directory names, but not file-specific mutable exclusions to file entries. Consequently primary corpus bounds/hash do not alone identify or bound all credential-scan inputs. Matching review classifications also remain supplied dispositions, not independent credential verification.
note: 05 Findings/D93 Sanitation primary bounds do not constrain its separate secret scan.md

title: Coordination read routes can publish corruption evidence
body: readAuthoritativeState copies raw corrupt, invalid-shape, workspace-mismatched or hash-mismatched state into quarantine and writes a receipt before throwing. Several MCP read-only tools call it through readCoordination or readMemoryTelemetry. tool_conflict_status catches that error and can return a normal result after the evidence write. The missing-store nonpersisting read test does not establish no-write behavior for damaged existing state.
note: 05 Findings/D94 Coordination read routes can publish corruption evidence.md

title: Expired stored claims are rejected before built-in expiry cleanup
body: withState copies state and calls assertCoordinationState(previous, requireSeal false) before expireClaims. That validator still invokes conformance, which rejects active claims whose expires_utc is at or before now. Thus an otherwise intact stored active lease that has expired prevents the normal mutation path from reaching expiry normalization or its mutator. Read paths expire only in-memory projections. This is a source-derived ordering boundary; no clock-controlled reproduction was run.
note: 05 Findings/D95 Expired stored claims are rejected before built-in expiry cleanup.md

title: MCP retained resume packet bypasses packet hash and freshness checks
body: writeHandoff binds packet.sha256 and verified_state_hash, and its Markdown instructs consumers to verify. pacify_resume_handoff only reads current coordination to get the packet path, then calls generic JSON loading. It does not verify packet.sha256 or equality with current coordination state, so the source route can return a stale or resealed-independent packet. Fresh taskHandoff is a separate derived route.
note: 05 Findings/D96 MCP retained resume packet bypasses packet hash and freshness checks.md

title: Coordination result limits apply after full event and memory reads
body: tailJsonlDetailed reads/parses the full file before slicing up to MAX_EVENTS; readCoordination requests smaller tails after that work. memoryRecords reads all layer/session JSONL files and sorts all matches before slicing. A 100-record API limit therefore does not bound filesystem bytes or parser memory. Malformed event suffixes are reported and mutation checks reject degraded parse health.
note: 05 Findings/D97 Coordination result limits apply after full event and memory reads.md

title: Shared exact-target claims conflict with the global fence invariant
body: Overlap logic permits shared/shared claims on different tasks. claimTask increments one fencing_by_target counter for each exact target without updating earlier active claim tokens. If two shared claims request the identical target string, the prior claim token is now behind the global counter and next-state validation rejects active-claim-fence-not-current. The existing shared-mode test uses ancestor/descendant target strings with different counter keys, so it does not cover this composition.
note: 05 Findings/D98 Shared exact-target claims conflict with the global fence invariant.md

title: Hard-stop state can block an otherwise authorized release transition
body: recordProgress marks exceeded hard-stop usage as blocked. releaseTask sets task.status to released but preserves that budget/usage. assertBudget requires any hard-stop usage to retain blocked status, so the transition guard rejects that release. This concerns ledger transition consistency, not actual worker termination; no runtime reproduction was performed.
note: 05 Findings/D99 Hard-stop state can block an otherwise authorized release transition.md

title: Environment writer and reader accept different dataset sizes
body: writeDataset serializes and writes data without a maximum size check; readDataset rejects any shard larger than8MiB before returning records. Thus a produced snapshot can be validly indexed yet have an unreadable graph or subject shard; a small API page limit does not avoid that check because pagination follows full loading. No large-dataset reproduction was executed.
note: 05 Findings/D100 Environment writer and reader accept different dataset sizes.md

title: Retained discovery freshness differs by consumer
body: Host memory-only refresh updates currentEnvironment but skips shards; MCP and dashboard subject queries still call stored readers. On a stale stored snapshot, environments deactivates active rows; the graph route returns captured graph properties unchanged with a freshness label. Consumers must interpret that observation metadata rather than treating active graph properties as current liveness.
note: 05 Findings/D101 Retained discovery freshness differs by consumer.md

title: Environment consumer edges are lexical and can span root scopes
body: Environment key names across parsed files form one regex used against source text, including Markdown and JSON. Each matching key accumulates consumer rows across all roots; every declaration of that name receives those rows. semanticGraph uses global name-derived variable IDs and labels edges consumes-variable. These links can arise from comments, documentation or another root and do not prove runtime reads or per-root environment binding. Values and fingerprints are intentionally not retained.
note: 05 Findings/D102 Environment consumer edges are lexical and can span root scopes.md

title: Discovery completeness and deadlines cover different work
body: Tree scanning caps accepted entries/depth and checks time between operations, but prunes selected directories and silently prefilters missing roots in discoverEnvironment. Virtual environment marker reads slice only after full-file reads; .env parsing precedes the consumer-loop deadline checks. The worker45s wrapper covers the combined worker duration but requests termination without waiting for exit. A complete marker describes the bounded scan corpus, not exhaustive host discovery or proven cleanup.
note: 05 Findings/D103 Discovery completeness and deadlines cover different work.md

title: Existing environment shards are trusted by the writer and verified later by readers
body: writeDataset skips an existing target yet returns the digest of the newly serialized intended bytes. It does not verify or repair that target. A corrupted existing file can therefore survive refresh; later readDataset detects a mismatch and rejects it. Current index replacement and event append are separate, so event failure can leave a published current snapshot without its event.
note: 05 Findings/D104 Existing environment shards are trusted by the writer and verified later by readers.md

title: Governor slot release does not establish producer termination
body: _drain races the producer promise against AbortSignal. Abort rejects the race and finally decrements pool.active, removes the entry and drains the next work, even if a noncooperative producer is still running. dispose signals entries without joining them. This bounds governed waiting slots; physical threads/processes need their own shutdown proof. Existing deadline tests use cooperative producers.
note: 05 Findings/D105 Governor slot release does not establish producer termination.md

title: Cancelled half-open circuit trial can leave admission closed indefinitely
body: _admitCircuit sets halfOpenActive true after cooldown. _recordCircuit returns immediately for cancelled work, leaving that flag set. The next call rejects whenever halfOpenActive is true, with no later cooldown transition clearing it. Queued cancellation/displacement also lacks that reset, unlike explicit queue-full rejection. The existing half-open test covers success, not cancellation; this is source-derived, not a live incident reproduction.
note: 05 Findings/D106 Cancelled half-open circuit trial can leave admission closed indefinitely.md

title: First persistent snapshot return bypasses the normal short TTL refresh branch
body: snapshot accepts matching persisted metadata up to24h old and immediately returns persistent-hit. Its ordinary cache TTL is5s..5min, but the first restore does not invoke that branch or mark refresh_pending. A later snapshot request can initiate stale-while-revalidate. Matching source identity is not equivalent to current dynamic provider/coordination observations.
note: 05 Findings/D107 First persistent snapshot return bypasses the normal short TTL refresh branch.md

title: Canonical lease maintenance can select a project independently of the visible root
body: ensureWorkspaceProjectLease accepts the current shared vscode-dashboard session without comparing projectRoot. If selection is needed it prefers one active project over a basename match, then a sole eligible project. Activation and renewal are separate subprocess calls. The host calls this before visible snapshots and on a timer; it therefore has canonical state effects beyond reading the dashboard.
note: 05 Findings/D108 Canonical lease maintenance can select a project independently of the visible root.md

title: Host bridge disposal covers governed work and fingerprint workers selectively
body: dispose requests termination for tracked fingerprint workers and disposes only an internally owned governor. Direct capture callers for native query/hydrate, workspace operations and verifier description have no shared child registry in PxBridge and receive no disposal signal. Each retains its local timeout; that is a separate lifecycle guarantee from bridge-wide cancellation. Canonical lease stop likewise clears its timer without cancelling an in-flight direct bridge call.
note: 05 Findings/D109 Host bridge disposal covers governed work and fingerprint workers selectively.md

title: Git context conflict count is computed after change capping
body: gitSnapshot retains at most maxChanges rows and then counts conflicts from that retained list. An unmerged path beyond the cap is therefore omitted from conflicts even though staged/unstaged totals scan retained command output. The subprocess wrapper also keeps only the last200000 stdout characters without a truncation flag, potentially losing branch/status prefix. gitConflictDecision depends on that conflicts field and operation markers. This is source-derived, not a reproduced missed-conflict event.
note: 05 Findings/D110 Git context conflict count is computed after change capping.md

title: Authenticated catalog status is not rebound to the JS record read
body: Python verifies lifecycle receipts against current record/tree bytes internally, then emits a row keyed by relative path with status/authenticated/reason but no record digest. PxBridge fetches that projection before studioCatalog reads physical records, and can reuse the status response cache. JS uses authenticated === true to choose displayed status without comparing the projection to its new revision digest. This is an observation-time gap; it does not prove the separate mutation authority accepts changed source.
note: 05 Findings/D111 Authenticated catalog status is not rebound to the JS record read.md

title: Portable context flags describe construction rather than universal policy enforcement
body: buildContextEnvelope includes no file bodies and copies locators, objective and coordination metadata. It labels credentials_included false and supplies a numeric context_injection_cap_tokens, but performs no general secret scan or token calculation over those caller fields. codexPrompt states Git and claim rules as host instructions; the module does not intercept future commands. Its environment filter removes a fixed list of key names.
note: 05 Findings/D112 Portable context flags describe construction rather than universal policy enforcement.md

title: Nominal dashboard reads perform persistent derived work
body: build_snapshot enters RuntimeWorkPlane, which writes lock owners, result cache and start/finish state. Hardware misses also write diagnostics/hardware-dashboard-cache.json. MCP summary, hardware, readiness and enterprise catalog helpers can traverse this composed path while their outer annotation is read-only. This describes actual source effects, not a claim that every call writes every optional cache.
note: 05 Findings/D113 Nominal dashboard reads perform persistent derived work.md

title: Dashboard runnable and coordination totals use weaker evidence than lifecycle catalog status
body: Snapshot agent/workflow runnable totals inspect retained receipt fields without calling Studio receipt authentication. _coordination copies stored state_hash and active status count without hash, workspace or expiry validation. The separate Python Studio catalog projection and JavaScript coordination reader enforce other checks. A displayed count or LIVE provenance label therefore has a different proof basis from those stronger readers.
note: 05 Findings/D114 Dashboard runnable and coordination totals use weaker evidence than lifecycle catalog status.md

title: Graph path and overview do not enforce returned node and edge caps
body: query_graph computes bounded_nodes/bounded_edges for all modes, but overview returns every cluster and aggregate edge, and path performs unrestricted BFS over the loaded graph then returns the entire found path. Both report limits and truncated false. Full mode independently pages nodes/edges so one edge page may reference nodes absent from the current node page. Neighborhood has separate explicit depth/node/edge enforcement.
note: 05 Findings/D115 Graph path and overview do not enforce returned node and edge caps.md

title: Missing capability graph can appear as available empty graph
body: Repository view returns available false for missing, oversized or invalid source. Capability view uses _read_json(...,{}) and then empty records/edges on missing or malformed JSON; later empty-selection response reports available true. Neither branch verifies a projection-staleness marker in query_graph. Unavailable source and a valid empty capability graph are not distinguished by that path.
note: 05 Findings/D116 Missing capability graph can appear as available empty graph.md

title: Python work timeout is admission waiting time, not producer execution time
body: RuntimeWorkPlane uses timeout_seconds while acquiring operation lock and later pool slot, each with its own wait clock. Once admitted it calls producer() synchronously with no timer/cancellation wrapper. Thus the dashboard60-second work-plane argument does not itself impose a60-second runtime ceiling; an outer host subprocess timeout is a separate mechanism.
note: 05 Findings/D117 Python work timeout is admission waiting time, not producer execution time.md

title: Python result cache records a digest that reuse does not verify
body: Producer publication writes result_sha256, but _read_cache only requires an object/result and convertible created_epoch. Fast hits compare input hash/age; concurrent joins compare input hash/new publication time. No reuse branch recomputes result_sha256. authoritative true bypasses the initial TTL path but not concurrent identical-result joining. The malformed-cache test only supplies invalid JSON.
note: 05 Findings/D118 Python result cache records a digest that reuse does not verify.md

title: Work result publication precedes causal finish state
body: execute writes the result cache before _record_finish updates state.json. If finish-state recording fails, the owner records failure/raises while a concurrent joiner may already consume the result cache. Pool and operation locks are released sequentially; a pool-release exception can prevent operation release. These boundaries need separate recovery evidence; no failure injection was executed for the report.
note: 05 Findings/D119 Work result publication precedes causal finish state.md

title: Python budgeted invocation and immutable policy are separate entry points
body: ProviderInvocationGateway.invoke calls _invoke_once directly. execute_provider_request performs supplied immutable policy comparisons before delegating. Repository static symbol search found direct gateway construction/calls and wrapper execution in tests; no production wrapper caller was found. Existing host-model and execute_agent_plan routes remain separately mapped. This is static reachability evidence, not proof against dynamic imports.
note: 05 Findings/D120 Python budgeted invocation and immutable policy are separate entry points.md

title: Provider accounting can commit before terminal event publication fails
body: _invoke_once commits successful settlement before publishing completed. An exception at that publication escapes with accounting already settled and no response receipt returned. Adapter failures burn reservation before publishing failed; failure-event publication errors can replace the original sanitized failure. Budget and event owners have separate WAL transactions.
note: 05 Findings/D121 Provider accounting can commit before terminal event publication fails.md

title: Fallback retains primary model and attachment metadata
body: Policy wrapper allows fallback by adapter ID after validating declared fallback metadata. Gateway replace() changes invocation_id and adapter_id only; model_id, revision and attachment remain primary. Returned policy outcome also uses primary request metadata, and exact receipt check expects the primary model ID. Thus a fallback declaration naming a different model is not itself applied by this path. No live fallback was executed.
note: 05 Findings/D122 Fallback retains primary model and attachment metadata.md

title: Immutable policy cost ceiling checks expected charge only
body: provider_execution_policy_report compares expected_charge_microunits to policy cost maximum. Actual reserve/settlement limits come from separate budget registry. After invocation, wrapper checks model/adapter and digest shapes but does not compare returned charge with its policy maximum. If those limits differ, the wrapper itself does not enforce its maximum against final usage.
note: 05 Findings/D123 Immutable policy cost ceiling checks expected charge only.md

title: Provider observed effects are registry-derived labels
body: Gateway writes identical declared and observed effect arrays from adapter registry mode. Local mode reports model only, although included local HTTP adapters make loopback POST requests. This is an effect-label convention, not independently measured I/O; the local-effects test uses a fake adapter.
note: 05 Findings/D124 Provider observed effects are registry-derived labels.md

title: Provider source scan does not establish universal mediation
body: Scan corpus is runtime/scripts Python; gateway itself is excluded and detector uses selected SDK imports/call suffixes. Cached records reuse prior violations for unchanged source bytes without a scanner-revision check. Current index validates source identity but does not independently recompute its findings. This cannot prove host JavaScript or arbitrary adapter/network calls are mediated.
note: 05 Findings/D125 Provider source scan does not establish universal mediation.md

title: Memory append has several publication points before its returned receipt
body: Lifecycle event, anchor and head are published before record JSON and Markdown note. No transaction wraps all these files, and records/lifecycle readers do not take the writer lock. A failure or concurrent read can observe intermediate state; underlying FileLock serializes writers only.
note: 05 Findings/D126 Memory append has several publication points before its returned receipt.md

title: Memory revision validation follows filesystem path order
body: records iterates sorted recursive paths and requires the next per-ID revision immediately. append chooses category/address/directory from current type/title/key and does not require those fields unchanged. A revision whose new path sorts before its predecessor can therefore fail subsequent chain reads; prior_payloads[-1] also depends on path order. Existing tests exercise different IDs and duplicate revision rejection, not title-changing same-ID history. This is a source-inferred branch, not an executed reproduction.
note: 05 Findings/D127 Memory revision validation follows filesystem path order.md

title: Active memory index and canonical search are separate paths
body: Index validation checks entries against all historical records, without requiring every latest record to be represented. Reconciliation selects generation from retained activation events but does not compare event manifest_sha256 with current validated manifest. Direct vault.search reads canonical eligible records and workspace search uses a separate ranker; neither consults active index entries.
note: 05 Findings/D128 Active memory index and canonical search are separate paths.md

title: Memory monitor healthy and eligible fields omit some retrieval and activation checks
body: healthy checks absence of orphan generations and queue.valid, while nested index.activation_error is not in that predicate. eligible_record_count sums certified/trusted states without checking expiry, actor visibility or supersession. These summary labels therefore do not equal query eligibility or valid active-index authority.
note: 05 Findings/D129 Memory monitor healthy and eligible fields omit some retrieval and activation checks.md

title: Three retrieval paths have different filters and scoring
body: Vault search uses candidate_memories exact semantic/SimHash selection then structured/lexical/relationship scoring. Workspace search first checks lease and actor, obtains vault retrieval_records, and calls rank_memories with lexical and optional caller scores/fixed bindings. Generic retrieve uses seven fixed weighted signals and visibility. Its strategy is a label and its byte counter includes excerpts only. No shared ranking equivalence is established by their names.
note: 05 Findings/D130 Three retrieval paths have different filters and scoring.md

title: Certified supersession is decided before expiry and actor filtering
body: Vault retrieval_records builds superseded IDs from all certified/trusted latest records, then filters individual records by expiry and actor ACL. An expired or inaccessible certified correction can suppress a prior record even when that correction is not returned. The standalone candidate_memories helper is broader still: it collects supersedes from every supplied record before filtering. No live retrieval reproduction was run.
note: 05 Findings/D131 Certified supersession is decided before expiry and actor filtering.md

title: Memory context and compaction budgets have distinct practical limits
body: assemble_context sums block lengths but joins blocks with extra newline separators omitted from used_chars. compact_tool_results preserves protected tail and only offloads eligible older large tool results, so output may remain above max_chars. Preview returns pointers without ensuring object persistence; restore checks digest but does not verify path containment or project.
note: 05 Findings/D132 Memory context and compaction budgets have distinct practical limits.md

title: Write-intent deduplication does not make handlers execute exactly once
body: Queue key binds project/operation/payload, but flush calls handler(operation,payload), then writes receipt and moves pending intent. There is no queue lock or atomic commit spanning handler and receipt. A handler effect followed by receipt failure leaves replayable pending work, and concurrent flushes can call the same handler. No failure/concurrency injection was executed.
note: 05 Findings/D133 Write-intent deduplication does not make handlers execute exactly once.md

title: Integration health loads all valid registered targets
body: validate_integrations imports handler and healthcheck even with smoke false, despite returning a loading_rule that says metadata startup then explicit selection. Smoke true invokes all active checks. Current checks are one noop scheduling simulation, one public retrieval fixture, and metacognitive registry denominators/references; they do not prove external service or complete workflow operation.
note: 05 Findings/D134 Integration health loads all valid registered targets.md

title: Memory lifecycle primitives rely on caller evidence authority
body: append accepts a valid record with supplied certified/trusted state; transition requires allowed state change and nonempty evidence strings, and reinstatement requires revoked plus supplied evidence. These primitive functions do not invoke decide_promotion or authenticate evidence receipts themselves. Stronger workspace admission must be traced at its own call boundary.
note: 05 Findings/D135 Memory lifecycle primitives rely on caller evidence authority.md

title: Memory materialization does not supply current revision freshness checks
body: validate_memory_query_plan can compare current source/dependency revisions when explicitly passed. materialize_memory_context calls it without those arguments, and agent preview passes only plan, supplied records and clock. Therefore the shown path checks plan integrity but does not establish that its retained source/dependency revision values are current.
note: 05 Findings/D136 Memory materialization does not supply current revision freshness checks.md

title: Governed execution binds memory and handoff hashes without forwarding their contents
body: preview_governed materializes memory and validates acknowledged handoffs, but _resolved_preview returns their hashes. execute_governed_plan includes those hashes in request/receipt and calls execute_agent_plan with task plan, placement, run ID and CPU/GPU callbacks only. The integration test CPU lambda returns a constant answer without consuming context. This establishes receipt binding; content injection requires a separate caller path.
note: 05 Findings/D137 Governed execution binds memory and handoff hashes without forwarding their contents.md

title: Semantic required and excluded context are declarations in reviewed retrieval paths
body: Envelope validates and preserves required_context/excluded_context, but semantic_query_signals takes only query/envelope and uses keys, aliases, tags, entities and predicates. Reviewed vault candidate search, workspace ranker and memory materializer do not evaluate these context maps. Invalid nonmapping context inputs are also normalized to empty objects by mapping conversion.
note: 05 Findings/D138 Semantic required and excluded context are declarations in reviewed retrieval paths.md

title: Agent structural admission and launch readiness are different gates
body: test_candidate labels its receipt structural_preflight_not_behavioral_certification and excludes memory_runtime_resolved/handoff_runtime_resolved from admission_ready. _new_session later calls plain preview, which blocks unresolved memory/handoff bindings. Governed preview accepts additional broker/handoff inputs through a different API. A passed preflight or admitted catalog row therefore does not imply an ordinary launch can run.
note: 05 Findings/D139 Agent structural admission and launch readiness are different gates.md

title: Host preparation does not repeat the instruction byte identity check
body: Creation and structural identity test compare instruction bytes with spec.instruction_sha256. _admitted_context checks saved record/builder/admission/live authority; it does not rehash instructions.md. prepare_host_run and host resume then read that file directly into a newly signed prepared request. This describes the Python boundary; host acceptance and filesystem protection are separate controls requiring their own evidence.
note: 05 Findings/D140 Host preparation does not repeat the instruction byte identity check.md

title: Agent terminal state can precede its signed run receipt
body: Host completion and governed callback execution publish terminal durable state before signing and writing the final run receipt. Signing or receipt publication failure can therefore leave terminal state without that artifact. Host preparation has explicit best-effort compensation for preparation failure; these later commit boundaries are different.
note: 05 Findings/D141 Agent terminal state can precede its signed run receipt.md

title: Deterministic worker setup and cleanup have failure paths outside terminal handling
body: _execute_session transitions running before creating the task workspace/signing task outside its guarded supervisor try. After supervision it parses last stdout JSON without asserting an object, then reclaims task content before terminal transition; cleanup errors raise first. These source paths can leave nonterminal state requiring owner reconciliation, rather than guaranteeing immediate terminal publication on every exception.
note: 05 Findings/D142 Deterministic worker setup and cleanup have failure paths outside terminal handling.md

title: Memory broker receipt authority is scoped to supplied records
body: Materialization maps supplied records by ID with last duplicate winning, checks metadata predicates and provenance hash shape, then returns a digest. It does not load vault records, authenticate lifecycle history, recompute source bytes or call full MemoryRecord.validation_errors. Future effective times are not rejected by the age comparison; context token count is ceil(serialized item bytes/4), not a model tokenizer.
note: 05 Findings/D143 Memory broker receipt authority is scoped to supplied records.md

title: Detached launch acceptance does not require a running live worker
body: launch_studio_worker returns accepted true and live_worker_observed true whenever durable state differs from launch_state, before checking process.poll.
