body: read_event_tail reads and retains all valid events before slicing output limit. Intake walker max_files+1 allows a truncation result only for one extra file; additional files raise instead. Walked size limit is based on stat before later whole-file hash reads. Workspace substantive rglob is separate and not bounded by intake max_files.
note: 05 Findings/D291 Tail and intake limits have narrower scopes than their result labels.md

title: Workspace health depth depends on selected caller and transitive reads
body: workspace_status runs project_check only when source_root is supplied; otherwise project validity covers listed hashes/bindings and session state. workspace_monitor adds all-vault scans, index and queue health plus validate_integrations(smoke=True). Its no-mutation docstring does not itself prevent transitive vault/workplane setup effects; read-only status and live service operational proof remain distinct.
note: 05 Findings/D292 Workspace health depth depends on selected caller and transitive reads.md

title: Questionnaire schema closes missing acceptance keys but not unresolved content
body: commission and apply_project_brief validate exact eight human acceptance booleans and required ten answer keys. All answer values permit null/empty string, and accepted state depends on flags rather than unresolved contradictions/unknowns/pending decisions. This strengthens direct template key validation while leaving semantic acceptance a caller assertion.
note: 05 Findings/D293 Questionnaire schema closes missing acceptance keys but not unresolved content.md

title: Commissioning preview reads complete skill bodies and can reuse stale inventory
body: _skill_registry reads every active/admitted body to derive hash/byte metadata, though project scaffold copies only metadata. _existing_inventory trusts saved JSON without current-tree comparison. Metadata-only startup and commissioning preview therefore have different I/O scopes; the latter is not purely compact catalog loading.
note: 05 Findings/D294 Commissioning preview reads complete skill bodies and can reuse stale inventory.md

title: Scaffold collision checks do not form a concurrent creation transaction
body: commission plans absent/conflicting files, then checks exists and calls write_bytes for absent paths without exclusive open, final nested-link containment or a project-wide lock. Concurrent creation/replacement between checks can change target ownership; later map/event/receipt failure leaves earlier writes. Existing owner preservation is demonstrated for stable fixtures, not all interleavings.
note: 05 Findings/D295 Scaffold collision checks do not form a concurrent creation transaction.md

title: Framework binding records certificate identity without verifying trust
body: _framework_binding records authoritative version, optional certificate path/hash and revocation existence/hash. project_check compares this metadata with receipt but does not verify certificate contents/signature or reject revoked true. A matching binding means same current metadata; admission/certification trust requires another owner.
note: 05 Findings/D296 Framework binding records certificate identity without verifying trust.md

title: Commissioning checker accepts matching historical receipt anchor
body: Receipt validation finds any event matching commissioning_event_sha256 and payload digest, not necessarily latest event. Producer publishes event before replacing receipt. A failure after event or restoration of an older still-file-compatible receipt can leave project_check accepting prior binding. It checks listed managed files without regenerating their full expected denominator; producer manifest coverage test is a separate guarantee.
note: 05 Findings/D297 Commissioning checker accepts matching historical receipt anchor.md

title: Brief update preserves history but publishes three uncoordinated files
body: apply_project_brief archives existing state/questionnaire/dashboard then replaces questionnaire, state and dashboard using fixed next names without lock, fsync, rollback or commissioning event linkage. Regex can leave dashboard unchanged when Current state section shape does not match. Accepted state can coexist with pending approvals; returned applied does not independently verify all document agreement.
note: 05 Findings/D298 Brief update preserves history but publishes three uncoordinated files.md

title: Framework rebind valid status excludes unrelated project errors
body: rebind_commissioning_framework filters project_check errors to receipt-related prefixes, permits sole framework-binding drift, and can return valid when other project errors remain. It intentionally preserves managed artifacts but does not revalidate whole project after replacement. History/event/current receipt are separate writes with no compare-and-swap on prior receipt.
note: 05 Findings/D299 Framework rebind valid status excludes unrelated project errors.md

title: Portable profile validation checks keys rather than routing values
body: validate_profile requires local_models/cloud_models/sensitive_data keys without validating their values. Set validation collects IDs into a set and rejects missing known IDs but permits duplicates. Heavy-lane1 is a checked declaration, not runtime serialization; machine-path check is only selected substrings and reads file separately from parsed payload.
note: 05 Findings/D300 Portable profile validation checks keys rather than routing values.md

title: Missing world-state inputs can still produce overall GREEN
body: Builder _read maps missing or JSON-invalid source files to empty objects. Overall health uses blocker count0 and empty stale list, independent of authority component UNVERIFIED or absent project/model/release inputs. Supplied source revision is attached without validating each source revision. GREEN therefore describes this reduction, not complete verified system health.
note: 05 Findings/D301 Missing world-state inputs can still produce overall GREEN.md

title: Startup loses world-state authority warning at caller boundary
body: Without current_source_revision, loader compares stored revision with itself and returns wrapper UNVERIFIED/source_authority_not_supplied. bounded_startup retains only world_state and hydrate fields; CLI calls without revision and omits those fields entirely while returning valid true. No-current-revision startup does not establish freshness of the stored world projection.
note: 05 Findings/D302 Startup loses world-state authority warning at caller boundary.md

title: World-state validation covers self-consistency and selected top-level rules
body: Validator checks schema label, revision equality, self hash, detail flag, encoded size and forbidden top-level names. It does not validate all field types/counts/health vocabulary, nested private payload or external revision syntax. Loader reads full bytes before64KiB cap; builder reads all source JSON before producing compact output. Private-payload-named test only exercises stale revision.
note: 05 Findings/D303 World-state validation covers self-consistency and selected top-level rules.md

title: Startup count and worker bounds are not whole-operation resource bounds
body: Capability, policy and catalog limits are checked after materialization; model/project data have no analogous count cap. Explicit tool_names bypass default candidate limit8. ThreadPoolExecutor limits parallel workers but waits for all callbacks without deadline, including at context exit. Configured coordination startup also reads retained events/memory, despite no skill-body hydration.
note: 05 Findings/D304 Startup count and worker bounds are not whole-operation resource bounds.md

title: Tool discovery returns locations rather than verified executable capability
body: Alias loader drops nondict records, candidate values are stringified and family maximum has no1..8 validation. Probes catch OSError and return optional resolver path; no version/trust/function test or timeout. Startup default list is bounded, but selected-family resolver and caller override have distinct bounds.
note: 05 Findings/D305 Tool discovery returns locations rather than verified executable capability.md

title: Lazy hydration guarantees retained-state atomicity after full reads
body: prepare recursively reads body/reference text before checking total active count and byte footprint. Failure leaves active map unchanged under RLock, as tests cover, but huge inputs can allocate beyond retained budget before rejection. This is an in-memory context commit guarantee, not a pre-read byte/time bound.
note: 05 Findings/D306 Lazy hydration guarantees retained-state atomicity after full reads.md

title: Catalog loader omits dependency closure and hash admission
body: from_catalog initializes dependencies empty for every descriptor and only reads package references. Hydration checks descriptor active/admitted status and root containment, not declared body hashes, version, package admission or selected-task authority. Custom descriptor dependencies tested separately do not prove catalog dependencies are wired.
note: 05 Findings/D307 Catalog loader omits dependency closure and hash admission.md

title: Active skill cache does not upgrade references or recheck current source
body: hydrate returns active entry immediately by ID, even when a later request enables references or source/status changed. unload can remove a dependency while dependent remains active. A selected-body cache and lifecycle/dependency authority therefore need distinct owners; no automatic refresh follows file mutation here.
note: 05 Findings/D308 Active skill cache does not upgrade references or recheck current source.md

title: Classifier labels are substring routing hints
body: ASCII normalization and term-in-text checks do not implement token boundaries or negation. Missing task-class matches default read-only and confidence is fixed arithmetic. Capability routing consumes these labels but they cannot establish allowed effects or semantic understanding.
note: 05 Findings/D309 Classifier labels are substring routing hints.md

title: Frozen package identity omits execution-relevant fields
body: Requirement fingerprint excludes goal, dependency map and deferred work. Duplicate/empty IDs and dependency existence/cycles are not checked. Existing requirements can produce complete nodes while missing capabilities also mark them blocked. load_work_package reconstructs fields without verifying ID/fingerprint/frozen semantics. No production builder caller was found.
note: 05 Findings/D310 Frozen package identity omits execution-relevant fields.md

title: Scheduler pressure and ownership are caller-fed transient facts
body: Missing pressure becomes0; NaN bypasses threshold comparisons and caller agents count replaces internal heartbeat count. Path normalization is lexical and omits canonical alias/traversal resolution. Maps lack synchronization or persistence, while project dispatch instantiates a new scheduler each time. This is local admission bookkeeping, not durable cross-owner capacity custody.
note: 05 Findings/D311 Scheduler pressure and ownership are caller-fed transient facts.md

title: Worker reassignment and loss do not prove released physical ownership
body: Reassigning a worker can retain its old work ownership; multiple workers may reference one work. release removes assignments but leaves heartbeat entries used for agent counts. recover_lost releases the whole work and other assignments without stopping or verifying live workers. A timestamp threshold is not child-process closure.
note: 05 Findings/D312 Worker reassignment and loss do not prove released physical ownership.md

title: Durable persistence can remove current state before replacement succeeds
body: persist_state validates existing source version, moves it into history, then writes replacement exclusively. It does not validate the new dataclass payload before writing and lacks owner lock, rollback or fsync. A replacement failure can leave only history, and a newly written malformed payload can fail subsequent load.
note: 05 Findings/D313 Durable persistence can remove current state before replacement succeeds.md

title: Migration WAL does not pin the originally decoded source
body: migrate_state invokes WAL recovery before decoding source or rejecting a downgrade. Exact original bytes are backed up, but no owner lock or expected-source compare-and-swap spans decode through WAL commit; concurrent replacement can be overwritten. Unsupported target versions are rejected before WAL construction, which is a separate earlier check.
note: 05 Findings/D314 Migration WAL does not pin the originally decoded source.md

title: Resume metadata ignores pending approvals and selected capability freshness
body: reconcile_resume checks evidence-reference membership, interrupted steps and completed idempotency keys. It does not enforce pending approvals, package goal binding, selected skill current versions or authenticated evidence contents. The positive resume test contains a pending approval and still expects allow.
note: 05 Findings/D315 Resume metadata ignores pending approvals and selected capability freshness.md

title: Recovery fallback precedes retry budget and idempotence checks
body: After policy/irreversibility and circuit/rollback handling, an eligible fallback is selected before retry logic and without current capability/effect authorization. Trace repetition counts matching signatures throughout supplied trace. Retry backoff tops at32 seconds under exponent cap5. Decisions are explicitly non-authorizing and have no authored runtime caller found.
note: 05 Findings/D316 Recovery fallback precedes retry budget and idempotence checks.md

title: Coordinator healthy is limited to configured callback reports
body: Empty configuration can report healthy. Event/agent callback dictionaries default missing valid to true; callbacks have no coordinator deadline or independent postcondition check. Dry-run version errors become migration-required even when version may be unsupported for migration. CLI and doctor configure different authority sets; healthy is not global runtime closure.
note: 05 Findings/D317 Coordinator healthy is limited to configured callback reports.md

title: Shared coordination vectors prove only a seven-rule subset
body: Node runner and Python comparison call coordinationConformanceReport/coordination_conformance_report, not complete validators. JavaScript transition checks project identity, actor, operation, event predecessor and exact operation-specific memory increments. Python candidate checks monotonic counters and hashes but not all those fields; startup performs different retained-chain checks. Equality on the shared vectors is narrower than full semantic parity.
note: 05 Findings/D318 Shared coordination vectors prove only a seven-rule subset.md

title: Python WAL coordination guard is optional and only test-wired in inspected callers
body: CoordinationPreCommitGuard has a definition and test constructor use; no authored production caller was found. JavaScript coordinationManager directly invokes its own guard before deferred/state/event/receipt/handoff publications. Python startup uses retained-state validation. These are separate paths, so a precommit guard class cannot be treated as universal production enforcement.
note: 05 Findings/D319 Python WAL coordination guard is optional and only test-wired in inspected callers.md

title: Python guard checks role presence without validating all artifact semantics
body: Guard requires one exact state target, one event and presence of state/event/receipt/handoff roles. Receipt and handoff bodies/paths are not bound to candidate/event. Candidate validator checks before/after hashes and event self digest but not predecessor event head, operation, actor or project continuity. Startup event audit adds other checks, after any publication.
note: 05 Findings/D320 Python guard checks role presence without validating all artifact semantics.md

title: Coordination structured rejection does not cover every malformed shape or depth
body: Reduced conformance iterates candidate tasks before full array validation, so tasks=null can raise TypeError rather than produce the intended report. Dependency DFS is recursive without explicit depth bound. Target ownership uses lexical normalization rather than canonical path identity, and actor equality does not require a matching active session registry record. These limits coexist with substantive cycle, budget and fencing checks.
note: 05 Findings/D321 Coordination structured rejection does not cover every malformed shape or depth.md

title: Retained coordination memory seals are optional and revisions are sorted
body: Memory record SHA is checked only when non-null. Per-ID revisions from all stores are sorted and compared to1..N, allowing physical reordering while preserving continuity. Count, project and layer checks establish other useful invariants, but they do not prove authenticated append order or record origin.
note: 05 Findings/D322 Retained coordination memory seals are optional and revisions are sorted.md

title: Python startup audit does not acquire a coherent store snapshot
body: State, memory and events are stat-checked then read separately without a shared coordination lock or final identity pin. Missing state returns valid configured=false. Byte caps bound observed sizes and event count5000, while session file enumeration and recursive DAG depth have different resource limits. Concurrent publication can yield a mixed observation or grow files between stat and read.
note: 05 Findings/D323 Python startup audit does not acquire a coherent store snapshot.md

title: Architecture invariant names can exceed their underlying predicate scope
body: Tree helper conformance/task-model checks require files to exist, empty projection arrays satisfy all predicates, and release identity check only rejects a particular active/certified mapping lacking source digest. Parent-child-NA reuses evidence compatibility result. No authored tree-helper caller was found; registry names it as bypass detector. Boolean unit tests cover aggregation rather than these tree semantics.
note: 05 Findings/D324 Architecture invariant names can exceed their underlying predicate scope.md

title: Authority topology checks declarations rather than effect interception
body: Python owner inspection accepts any unqualified matching AST definition, including nested names; JavaScript checks substring presence. Runtime labels are not vocabulary-validated and multi-runtime vectors only need to exist. Non-contract receipt identifiers are nonempty strings. No authored executing resolve_effect_authority caller was found; a declared rollback owner is not proof it rolls back.
note: 05 Findings/D325 Authority topology checks declarations rather than effect interception.md

title: Primitive resolution does not inherit exception expiry validation
body: Primitive registry requires nonempty expiry/rationale and matching declared exception IDs, but date/wildcard checks live in primitive_lint.validate_primitive_exceptions. resolve_primitive_owner calls only registry validation. Names establish static ownership metadata, not actual route discovery or mandatory dispatch through that owner.
note: 05 Findings/D326 Primitive resolution does not inherit exception expiry validation.md

title: Duplicate primitive scan has a bounded syntactic denominator
body: Default scope is runtime/scripts Python. Canonical leaf-name dictionary can overwrite collisions. Walker omits class declarations themselves, nested functions and definitions under conditionals; only constant bare getattr is considered dynamic ambiguity. Bare assignment aliases are allowed and federated owners are not exception entries. No clean scan can establish absence of every equivalent or bypass implementation.
note: 05 Findings/D327 Duplicate primitive scan has a bounded syntactic denominator.md

title: Maturity evaluator trusts evidence metadata rather than authenticating it
body: Highest contiguous level requires valid=True, exact caller source/dependency revisions and sufficient authority label. It does not verify evidence artifact, signature, subject capability, producer or timestamp. SkillStudio generates L0-L3 labels and forwards caller higher rows; its separate signed admission and tree binding remain real checks, but do not authenticate these higher rows.
note: 05 Findings/D328 Maturity evaluator trusts evidence metadata rather than authenticating it.md

title: Maturity level semantics depend on the supplied policy
body: Installed policy requires installed-host evidence at L5 and external-authority at L6. General policy validator checks ordered levels, unique nonempty evidence types and nondecreasing rank, so a custom policy may weaken those requirements. Architecture helper adds an L5/L6 stronger-authority predicate, but evaluator does not invoke that helper. verified means at least L0, not all operational levels.
note: 05 Findings/D329 Maturity level semantics depend on the supplied policy.md

title: Semantic profile source backing is declared text and ID normalization
body: Minimal ID text creates a positive intent and synonym even with no behavioral provides. Owner may fall back to admission_record string; evidence_sources are locator labels. Validator checks vocabulary/conflicts/guards but not source existence, owner implementation or maturity evidence. Effects/paths are normalized into ASCII phrases, not retained authority tokens.
note: 05 Findings/D330 Semantic profile source backing is declared text and ID normalization.md

title: Semantic index overlay and hash reads can describe different source observations
body: Catalog/body/contracts honor byte overlays; aliases/workflows read disk directly. Contract JSON and contract digest come from separate reads. Catalog paths are joined without canonical containment. Builder reads whole bodies before compact output and stored loader does not verify freshness; exact-rebuild validator is separate and has no source snapshot lock.
note: 05 Findings/D331 Semantic index overlay and hash reads can describe different source observations.md

title: Golden query complete proves only supplied metadata expectations
body: Each case checks required/forbidden IDs and result equality after reversing input order. Empty case corpus fails, but nonempty cases with no expectations can pass with deterministic empty results; duplicate IDs and string-valued expectation collections are not rejected. Report does not bind signed corpus identity or verify actual capability behavior. Builder/certifier scripts publish JSON by direct overwrite.
note: 05 Findings/D332 Golden query complete proves only supplied metadata expectations.md

title: Skill Studio construction and promotion preflight can recover prior effects
body: Constructor creates authority/resource owners and enters lifecycle recovery. promote also recovers lifecycle and legacy projection journals before checking new approved/admitted fields. These are retained prior-transaction effects, so constructing this owner or invoking a rejected promotion is not necessarily filesystem-read-only.
note: 05 Findings/D333 Skill Studio construction and promotion preflight can recover prior effects.md

title: Strong skill tree framing is not a single immutable read snapshot
body: Attestation has explicit path/count/depth/byte bounds, rejects links/reparse and empty/unowned directories, and length-frames ordered path/body bytes. Descriptor reads reject changed length but do not pin every directory/member for the full traversal or detect all same-size concurrent content changes. Verified copy rechecks source/target identity at later points.
note: 05 Findings/D334 Strong skill tree framing is not a single immutable read snapshot.md

title: Skill behavioral validation executes limited declarative assertions
body: Runner accepts required-files, JSON/YAML object parsing and text-contains cases. It does not run skill scripts. Python leaf names such as get/run can classify unrelated methods as network/process; unknown dynamic aliases and unsupported suffixes are outside selected scans. Signed independently_derived receipt authenticates this checker result, not arbitrary operational capability.
note: 05 Findings/D335 Skill behavioral validation executes limited declarative assertions.md

title: Skill admission copies signed validation without rechecking current draft
body: admit verifies receipt signature and passed flag plus caller approval/approver, then copies validation digests. It does not rehash current draft or check those digests against current package in this method. promote separately compares manifest and payload tree before accepting new promotion. A displayed admitted state can therefore precede currentness rejection at promotion.
note: 05 Findings/D336 Skill admission copies signed validation without rechecking current draft.md

title: Promotion projections can retain different lifecycle and effect metadata
body: Package/admission projections take effects from package.permissions, while validation allows package.effects or permissions. Existing TOML entry updates version/tags but leaves status/body/contract/admission fields unchanged, whereas native/package/admission rows are rebuilt active. Denominator equality checks IDs, not all corresponding state/locator semantics. Staleness marker is a declaration requiring consumer enforcement.
note: 05 Findings/D337 Promotion projections can retain different lifecycle and effect metadata.md

title: Lifecycle recovery is roll-forward rather than reader-atomic publication
body: Canonical directory is displaced/replaced and verified before _bounded_lifecycle_artifacts validates all images. Artifacts then publish individually, including receipt in sorted path order, before final committed manifest. Corrupt image or conflicting projection can leave changed canonical with incomplete projections and an applying journal. Tests exercise synchronous exceptions and successful restart with intact custody, not actual process-kill at every boundary.
note: 05 Findings/D338 Lifecycle recovery is roll-forward rather than reader-atomic publication.md

title: Prepared canonical after-image is not rebound to the earlier admission digest
body: promote checks current_tree_sha256 against signed admission, then builds projections and calls preparation. Preparation freshly attests/copies canonical_source and records its new digest without requiring equality to the earlier current_tree_sha256 embedded in promotion receipt. A source change between checks can produce canonical/projection/receipt observations from different moments; lifecycle lock does not freeze external draft bytes.
note: 05 Findings/D339 Prepared canonical after-image is not rebound to the earlier admission digest.md

title: Rollback backup rehash is not checked against original pre-promotion tree
body: Rollback verifies current canonical equals promoted_tree_sha256 and authenticates committed promotion journal. It then computes restored_sha from current backup contents and uses those contents as new canonical_source without comparing to promotion_manifest.canonical.before_tree_sha256. A changed but structurally valid backup can therefore be re-attested as rollback output. This source path has not been executed as a reproduction.
note: 05 Findings/D340 Rollback backup rehash is not checked against original pre-promotion tree.md

title: Rollback can overwrite post-promotion projection changes
body: Current rollback reads authenticated old before-images, but does not require live projections to match the promotion after digests. New preparation snapshots current live projection bytes as its own before state, then writes historical bytes. Later unrelated valid changes can be replaced. The older _restore_projection_transaction helper checks before/after conflicts, but current rollback uses the lifecycle path instead.
note: 05 Findings/D341 Rollback can overwrite post-promotion projection changes.md

title: Lifecycle preparation retention differs from registered draft workspace closure
body: Draft staging registers its temporary workspace and preserves committed-create truth through cleanup warnings. Lifecycle preparation creates .preparing and canonical .lifecycle directories directly; recovery retains .preparing entries and does not register/reclaim these through ResourceManager. _atomic_bytes write-loop failure precedes its prepared-file cleanup block. Retention can therefore include incomplete preparation debris distinct from durable signed journal custody.
note: 05 Findings/D342 Lifecycle preparation retention differs from registered draft workspace closure.md

title: Universal cycle policy and cone validation have separate gaps
body: Graph builder compares DFS back-edge node subsets to allowed_cycle_components regardless cycle_policy reject/declared_components. Those subsets are not full SCCs. compute_invalidation_cone does not validate graph/policy and only examines supplied current revisions; omitted nodes cannot seed drift. Generated adapter retains edge endpoints only and expects from/to rather than generated SCC source/target.
note: 05 Findings/D343 Universal cycle policy and cone validation have separate gaps.md

title: Projection rebuild plan groups work without ordering or execution
body: Plan returns stale records in input order split by cost/gate, with usable meaning no blocked list. Cheap stale outputs can still need rebuilding. It does not topologically sort or call builders. Registry cycle check deduplicates adjacency but increments indegree per duplicate dependency entry, causing some duplicate entries to look like cycles.
note: 05 Findings/D344 Projection rebuild plan groups work without ordering or execution.md

title: Projection reconciliation can refresh unknown output hashes without builder equivalence
body: Only four known projection IDs are rebuilt for equality before revisions refresh; others receive current hashes. All-current staleness builder merely projects supplied metadata as stale=false. Known registry inventory builder uses no supplied root. Reconciliation reads separate observations and replaces metadata without owner lock/fsync; it must remain governed by the external ordered rebuild owner.
note: 05 Findings/D345 Projection reconciliation can refresh unknown output hashes without builder equivalence.md

title: Graph authority validates output digest but not current source revisions
body: Graph manifest requires source revision strings to look like SHA-256 but does not compare them with current source bytes. Output digest and two-directory graph inventory are checked. Reconciliation updates graph/source hashes without rebuilding graphs, so these functions alone cannot prove output was derived from those sources.
note: 05 Findings/D346 Graph authority validates output digest but not current source revisions.md

title: Affected proof completion checks names rather than authenticated exact plan evidence
body: Validator does not recompute/bind plan_sha256, authenticate test/section receipts or require focused_vectors. Negative proof is checked per card, not every negative case. Extra completion names are accepted, and an empty plan/completion can pass. Tests named exact plan acceptance provide lists without hash or vector proof. No authored runtime caller was found.
note: 05 Findings/D347 Affected proof completion checks names rather than authenticated exact plan evidence.md

title: Generated dependency helper loses one-shot inputs and fails self-loop formatting
body: Declared Iterable values are traversed to collect nodes then traversed again for edges, so generators can be exhausted. Self-loop insertion yields an extra nested list; subsequent string join for failure message raises TypeError instead of structured RP-GEN-002. Tests cover reusable-list DAG/two-node cycle only. Casefold-only edge sort also leaves tied case variants without a full tie-break.
note: 05 Findings/D348 Generated dependency helper loses one-shot inputs and fails self-loop formatting.md

title: Dependency audit misses producer declared_required vocabulary
body: Inventory builder emits declared_required for runtime YAML. validate_dependency_closure checks only required when enforcing presence in project runtime dependencies, so the generated classification skips that branch. Tests assert valid counts and separately assert declared_required, without removing YAML declaration. This is a concrete producer-consumer vocabulary mismatch.
note: 05 Findings/D349 Dependency audit misses producer declared_required vocabulary.md

title: Lock hash count does not prove unique artifacts for every platform
body: Dependency audit counts --hash=sha256 marker occurrences and compares counts to Python/OS matrix sizes. It does not validate digest syntax/uniqueness or bind each hash to a platform wheel. Requirement names are parsed by equals splitting and workflow authority by substring checks. Actual package installation and resolved dependency closure are outside these checks.
note: 05 Findings/D350 Lock hash count does not prove unique artifacts for every platform.md

title: Generated equality gate can accept a matching invalid graph report
body: validate_generated_artifacts marks its generated dependency check valid when stored JSON equals computed report, without requiring report.valid. A stored two-node-cycle report can therefore match an invalid expected result at this check. Release preflight separately evaluates the helper valid flag; these gates should not be conflated. Installed profile comparison can also be vacuously true when owner glob is empty.
note: 05 Findings/D351 Generated equality gate can accept a matching invalid graph report.md

title: Revision tree hashing and import classification have bounded scope assumptions
body: revision_for_path resolves the requested root target but does not independently contain every nested file symlink and reads full tree contents without count/byte bounds. Import inventory uses stored packaged surface membership, AST static imports and current interpreter stdlib names, omitting dynamic imports. Distinct source denominators must be retained when interpreting revision or dependency coverage.
note: 05 Findings/D352 Revision tree hashing and import classification have bounded scope assumptions.md

title: Learning validates typed commitments but accepts unresolved evidence hashes
body: Controller evidence snapshots accept bare sha256 references without bytes, while path-plus-hash checks only identity. Trials accept caller winner labels; research independence defaults true; final validation checks reference/hash rather than interpreting a result. The typed parser recomputes records and ancestry, so consistency is stronger than independent provenance. Tests deliberately use hash-only evidence.
note: 05 Findings/D353 Learning validates typed commitments but accepts unresolved evidence hashes.md

title: Direct decay can mutate the canonical head before rejecting approval
body: measure_learning_reuse writes the suspect canonical head before calling _transition_learning, which checks approved, actor and revision CAS. Thus a direct method call with approved false can reach a write before denial when decay criteria pass. Studio API consumes host proof before dispatch, so this is a direct-controller boundary, not an established unauthenticated Studio route.
note: 05 Findings/D354 Direct decay can mutate the canonical head before rejecting approval.md

title: Decay and restoration have opposite nontransactional failure windows
body: Decay writes canonical head then learning event/head; restoration writes learning event/head then canonical head. Pipeline CAS failure can follow decay mutation. Restoration head failure leaves a canonical pipeline that the decayed-only revalidation method cannot normally retry; final write also reuses a pre-transition head without canonical CAS. These interleavings are source-inferred, not reproduced here.
note: 05 Findings/D355 Decay and restoration have opposite nontransactional failure windows.md

title: Revalidation does not resolve its fresh evidence claim
body: revalidate_learning checks approval, a nonblank reference and lowercase SHA shape. It does not call _evidence_snapshots, verify bytes, validate producer/result or establish freshness. The positive test uses an unmaterialized evidence:fresh-validation reference. dependent_rebuild_required reports a condition but executes no rebuild.
note: 05 Findings/D356 Revalidation does not resolve its fresh evidence claim.md

title: Studio reuse cannot supply the richer dependency graph
body: studio_operation forwards cumulative counts and actor to measure_learning_reuse, but omits dependency_graph and dependency_current_revisions. That route therefore computes the singleton default cone. Authored runtime/script/extension call-site search found revalidate_learning and resolve_canonical only in their definitions and tests; availability of their methods is not proof that ordinary consumers enforce them.

title: Signed learning readers and recovery enforce different history rules
body: The normal learning reader verifies signed event/hash chains and typed nested state, but recovery additionally binds event pipeline identity, state sequence, initial evidence state, directory identity and legal transitions. Proposal history has a similar normal-reader versus recovery difference. A valid signature does not itself establish every lifecycle invariant.
note: 05 Findings/D358 Signed learning readers and recovery enforce different history rules.md

title: Knowledge source limits follow materialization and signed histories are read whole
body: Source snapshot traversal sorts/materializes all files before checking count and reads each file before checking cumulative bytes. Signed JSON/history readers have no pre-read total budget; learning publication bounds projected state/history after materialization. Original source links are resolved before later symlink checks. These are bounded output policies rather than fully bounded input acquisition.
note: 05 Findings/D359 Knowledge source limits follow materialization and signed histories are read whole.md

title: Canonical knowledge commit precedes final proposal actor validation
body: Promotion validates approval/base/source identities, writes canonical revision and head, then calls _publish where actor.strip is checked. Empty direct-call promoted_by can therefore fail after publication. Recovery rolls forward a signed retained revision without resnapshotting source evidence; that treats revision creation as the recoverable commit point.

title: Knowledge rollback replaces status metadata before its receipt exists
body: Rollback CAS-checks current candidate and verifies the retained signed target, writes a fresh head, then separately writes receipt. It does not carry suspect/revalidation metadata forward; an unchanged candidate hash can still permit status replacement. Actor emptiness and target hash grammar are not early explicit guards. No rollback receipt recovery transaction is present.

title: Pure promotion helpers are weaker than the typed pipeline parser
body: promote_revision checks record_type, immutable/passed flags, validation hash shape and dependency equality, without independently recomputing every supplied gate or binding comparison to revision. The controller typed parser adds exact reconstruction. Standalone compare_revisions permits repeated evidence hashes, as its tests demonstrate; controller trial capture rejects phase-local duplicates.

title: Typed learning validation validates present fields rather than complete lifecycle states
body: validate_learning_pipeline_state recomputes nested records that are present but does not require the outer state-specific set or enforce transition history. Missing optional components can pass this parser alone. Failed promotion decisions receive weaker semantic reconstruction than passed decisions; reuse reconstruction does not itself enforce cumulative history. Controller transition methods supply additional checks.

title: Learning candidate and admitted pipeline are separate commits
body: admit_learning_candidate scans proposal heads for a matching pipeline/decision, otherwise proposes the candidate, then CAS-transitions the pipeline. No atomic joint commit exists.

title: Cleanup learning compiler derives wins from selected success labels
body: The compiler requires at least two failed and six successful receipts across two lanes, but does not pair observations or bind each receipt to the declared incumbent/challenger implementation. Only successful rows become challenger-winning trials; all reuse is labelled successful. It hashes the audit and section files without validating their contents and asserts research independence. Synthetic receipts satisfy its source test.

title: Canonical authority and browse labels have limited enforcement scope

Browse derives authoritative from status alone and returns bounded subsets with no pagination. read_only constructor mode avoids initialization but is not retained as a mutator prohibition.

title: Summary cursor consumes omitted facts and does not enforce terminal closure
body: summarize stops selecting at max_facts but advances end_event_id across every pending event. Later calls cannot recover omitted later facts through this cursor. Source hash excludes created_at; SessionEnd only marks final when it is last, and later events after a final record are still accepted. Number allocation and cursor read have no common lock or history authentication.
note: 05 Findings/D367 Summary cursor consumes omitted facts and does not enforce terminal closure.md

title: Summary namespace sanitization retains dot segments and collisions
body: Session directory names replace unsupported characters but allow dots; a session ID of .. can resolve to the parent directory. Different IDs can normalize to the same name and share an unvalidated cursor. This is a direct helper boundary; source search found no production caller exposing it as an external route.

title: Memory timeout bounds waiting but not callback effects or aggregate concurrency
body: StateKVGuard creates a new executor per call and shutdown(wait=False) cannot stop an already-running callback. Breaker state has no lock and uses invocation-start time for failures, so long calls can consume the cooldown before failure is recorded. Concurrent calls can race success/failure resets; no central worker or resource custody bound is present.
note: 05 Findings/D369 Memory timeout bounds waiting but not callback effects or aggregate concurrency.md

title: Graph clustering bounds retained nodes after consuming the full iterable
body: build_graph_clusters materializes every node before slicing max_initial_nodes and iterates every edge. Duplicate IDs overwrite in lookup while enumerated_nodes counts the original selected rows. BFS treats edges as undirected, splits components at cluster size and retains first32 lexical terms rather than semantic novelty. Missing endpoints include nodes excluded by truncation.

title: Memory repair steps are not ordered by the computed dependency order
body: Planner computes a topological node list but sorts repairs by defect class then node ID. Every node remaining after Kahn traversal is labelled dependency_cycle, including acyclic descendants blocked behind a cycle. Citation values need only a nonempty collection and temporal values need no date semantics. apply is planning data; no mutation occurs.

title: Process verification and execution graphs are supplied flags and a linear projection

Jaccard comparison uses every catalog ID/tag without active status filtering and chooses lexical greatest ID on equal scores.

title: Process receipt identity omits mutable compilation inputs

title: Research independence is citation-string diversity

The positive test assigns identical source hash to two citation strings and receives multi_source. Bundle hash follows input order even though groups are sorted.

title: Blocked research bundles still emit experiment-state candidate rows

title: Clean-room workflow validation checks membership without matching each binding
body: Validator requires exact operation set and unique step IDs, but each runtime_binding need only belong to the allowed set rather than correspond to that step operation. Dispatcher independently uses its explicit handler map.

title: Refinery novelty precedence can classify changed same-ID artifacts as duplicates

title: Refinery portable inventory separates walk snapshot from later byte reads
body: bounded_walk captures file metadata and applies traversal limits; portable_inventory later reads entire files for hashing and rereads small files for secret scanning without a retained snapshot identity. title: Refinery retrieval validity omits failed no-result expectations and empty denominators

title: Foundry bundle identity does not commit all generated artifacts

title: Foundry confidence and relationships are heuristic line projections
body: Repeated normalized statements add0.1 confidence even when repetitions come from the same source. Every source-wide wiki relation attaches to each extracted statement. Capability detection is substring matching over all statements, and emitted procedures/tests are fixed generic templates. Evidence coverage means a reference exists, not support was independently verified.

title: Candidate certification checks structure and Python syntax rather than tests
body: certify_foundry_bundle trusts retained certification_errors, requires nonempty knowledge/skill fields and parses generated Python. Manually supplied dataclasses can bypass compiler-generated identity assumptions.
note: 05 Findings/D384 Candidate certification checks structure and Python syntax rather than tests.md

title: Foundry materialization has partial publication and duplicate output identities
body: Materializer creates destination/bundle_id before rendering/writing sorted files and publishes receipt last. Failure leaves an unregistered partial directory that normal retry refuses. Duplicate calculation IDs overwrite entries in the file map while bundle metadata retains both. Supplied bundle/skill IDs are used as path components without separate validation; compiler-produced slugs are narrower than direct dataclass inputs.
note: 05 Findings/D385 Foundry materialization has partial publication and duplicate output identities.md

title: Generated calculation functions omit interpreter runtime controls
body: evaluate_calculation checks numeric nonboolean finite inputs, exact variable set, AST64/depth16, magnitude1e100 and exponent16. Emitted Python directly returns the expression and JavaScript directly evaluates it with a modulo helper. Neither emitted function contains these guards; JavaScript division by zero and overflow differ from interpreter rejection. Tests inspect strings and execute only the interpreter.
note: 05 Findings/D386 Generated calculation functions omit interpreter runtime controls.md

title: Calculation units establish dimensions without scale or offset conversion
body: Known units km/cm/mm all map to L, time variants to T, and kelvin/absolute Celsius/delta Celsius to Theta. Values are never converted before arithmetic. Dimension compatibility alone can accept mixed scales or physically invalid absolute-temperature operations. Unit parser also tolerates repeated/trailing operators rather than a strict unit grammar.

title: Generated calculation identifiers are not fully validated
body: Compiler checks the slugged function name with isidentifier but not reserved keywords; supplied variable names are joined directly into both function signatures without unique/identifier/keyword validation. AST validates names used in the expression, leaving unused declared variables outside that check. Compilation can return malformed generated source; later candidate certification only parses Python.

title: Calculation-bearing Foundry export mismatches its producer contract
body: CalculationPackage defines equation and normalized_dimension as a string. export_foundry_candidate reads item.expression and converts item.normalized_dimension with dict. Nonempty calculations therefore encounter an attribute mismatch before a usable candidate export. Existing bridge tests compile no calculation specs and do not cover this branch. Source-established mismatch, no product execution performed.

title: Foundry lineage signature is an unkeyed integrity digest
body: lineage_signature is SHA256 of a public domain prefix plus candidate hash; signed_by is a fixed string. Validation recomputes the digest but authenticates no external signer. This supports content consistency, while source hashes/citations and candidate-only authority remain separate claims. Export filters missing source references rather than requiring complete reference membership.
note: 05 Findings/D390 Foundry lineage signature is an unkeyed integrity digest.md

title: Foundry Studio intake returns an object without staging a package
body: SkillStudio.intake_foundry_candidate delegates to build_skill_studio_draft and returns its dataclass. Neither method writes a physical draft or calls stage_draft. Studio construction can initialize/recover other lifecycle state, but that is not persistence of this candidate. title: Formula registration executes supplied examples but treats property authority as text
body: Executable registration requires assumptions, authoritative_source, validation, expected_examples and property_cases; only examples are evaluated. Example inputs are float-coerced and bypass runtime domain min/max validation. Infinite tolerance is not explicitly rejected. Unknown non-executable status is retained reference metadata, while evaluate requires exact executable status.

title: Formula evaluation always computes perturbations and has distinct numeric limits
body: FormulaEngine accepts float-coercible finite values, including booleans/strings, and has no input magnitude cap; bare Name return bypasses intermediate-result bounds. It computes sensitivities even without requested uncertainty. Declared bounds guide perturbation, but implicit sqrt/log/division domains can still fail at an otherwise evaluable point. This differs from the foundry interpreter contract.
note: 05 Findings/D393 Formula evaluation always computes perturbations and has distinct numeric limits.md

title: Formula covariance and equivalence proofs are local and input-scoped
body: Covariance validation checks each pair bound and final propagated variance for the current sensitivity vector, not positive semidefiniteness of the whole covariance matrix. Equivalence compares variable-name sets/output dimension and supplied cases, not every variable dimension/domain or symbolic identity. Empty cases correctly yield false; nonfinite tolerances are not explicitly rejected.
note: 05 Findings/D394 Formula covariance and equivalence proofs are local and input-scoped.md

title: Cognitive facade validity and health have limited denominators
body: Facade defaults outer valid to true when a handler lacks valid, so a well-formed equivalent false result is a successful dispatch. Health executes small logic/probability/constraint fixtures while listing13 operations, leaving formula and other families unprobed there. Common stable_hash uses default=str and permits nonfinite JSON numbers; it is not a strict typed identity schema.

title: Logic exceptions are monotonic firing guards rather than truth maintenance
body: Rules execute in descending priority and ID order; once support is added it is not retracted if an exception is derived later. Reordering rules can therefore change retained conclusions. Rule IDs need not be unique and derivation support uses only rule:id. Literals are ground exact tuples, without variable unification or unrestricted theorem proving.
note: 05 Findings/D396 Logic exceptions are monotonic firing guards rather than truth maintenance.md

title: Logic result hash excludes appended queries
body: KnowledgeBase.infer hashes atoms/derivations before reason appends the queries list. The nested result_sha256 therefore does not bind the complete returned result. Facade adds a separate hash of that result. max_rounds bounds rounds only; rule/fact count and retained support remain unbounded.

title: Abduction output limit does not bound subset enumeration
body: Hypothesis count is capped24, but max_combination_size is only clamped to the count, allowing every nonempty subset; max_candidates slices after all valid candidates are retained and sorted. Default size4 is smaller but caller can raise it. Nonmapping hypotheses are silently dropped, and stripped IDs differ from raw by_id keys, causing whitespace-ID lookup failure.
note: 05 Findings/D398 Abduction output limit does not bound subset enumeration.md

title: Bayesian dependence damping depends on caller order and overrides
body: Within a declared group, default weights are1/sqrt(n) in input order, so exchanging unequal likelihood records changes their influence. Caller dependence_weight may override to1 for each. Zero prior/likelihood remains impossible, and all-live-zero evidence correctly rejects. These are declared-likelihood updates, not learned dependence estimation or evidence authentication.
note: 05 Findings/D399 Bayesian dependence damping depends on caller order and overrides.md

title: Information value uses supplied post-test utilities and calibration coerces outcomes
body: VOI validates probability sums and finite nonnegative costs but receives best_expected_utility per outcome rather than solving posterior decisions or running tests. Calibration converts outcomes with int before binary checking, so fractional values can be truncated into accepted0/1. Collection sizes/bins have no upper bound.
note: 05 Findings/D400 Information value uses supplied post-test utilities and calibration coerces outcomes.md

title: Constraint search distinguishes exhausted budget only in a separate flag
body: No found solution sets satisfiable false even when node_budget_exhausted true, which is not an unsatisfiability proof. The budget check precedes complete-assignment acceptance, so reaching it exactly can omit that leaf. Nonmapping constraints are filtered out; repr-based domain/all_different uniqueness differs from eq value equality. Recursive depth is not bounded by variable count policy.
note: 05 Findings/D401 Constraint search distinguishes exhausted budget only in a separate flag.md

title: Causal path results and operation dispatch omit some completeness signals
body: Effect paths obey caller limit/depth but report no truncation flag. Unknown operation strings fall into graph description rather than rejection. Nodes/edges deduplicate in adjacency while description retains duplicate supplied edge rows; Kahn remainder called cycle nodes can include blocked descendants. Valid backdoor/separation results remain conditional on the supplied DAG.

title: Temporal projection advances through invalid and simultaneous transitions
body: Timeline records errors for prohibited transitions but still updates current state to each target. Empty allowed_transitions disables validation; equal timestamps sort by ID and can affect projected final state. Zero-duration intervals are accepted although standard proper-interval relation assumptions differ. All pairwise interval relations are materialized without a count cap.
note: 05 Findings/D403 Temporal projection advances through invalid and simultaneous transitions.md

title: Decision scores depend on supplied feasibility and candidate population
body: Constraints are trusted violation lists, not evaluated predicates. Metrics normalize over all eligible candidates, so adding an alternative changes utility scales. A sole candidate gets a regret bound from its own best-minus-worst interval. No-eligible early return skips weight/posture validation and hash. NaN weight can be clipped to zero before finite checking; very large finite aggregates can overflow.
note: 05 Findings/D404 Decision scores depend on supplied feasibility and candidate population.md

title: Belief ledger is an ephemeral heuristic rather than canonical truth maintenance
body: Projection excludes revoked/superseded but allows other caller status strings. Support/attack/dependency links affect scores without same-scope checks when all scopes requested; filtered links contribute zero and duplicate links are not deduplicated. Cycles run at most50 iterations. Contradictions remain valid if iteration converges; no evidence resolution or canonical write occurs.

title: Structural analogy uses degree and relation summaries without node correspondence
body: Analogy combines relation-label/multiplicity overlap, degree-profile multiset and counts, not graph isomorphism or explicit node mapping. Distinct graphs can share these signatures. Invalid triples and nonmapping candidates can be discarded; a candidate is selected even at zero similarity because there is no abstention threshold.

title: Reasoning strategy required modes are ranking hints and its plan is not execution
body: Required recognized modes gain100 then remain subject to max_modes truncation; unknown required modes are ignored. Recursive prerequisite expansion can exceed max_modes and introduce evidence, which is not a selectable mode/handler. Generic stop conditions are returned strings. No mode-to-operation translation, payload creation or execution occurs.
note: 05 Findings/D407 Reasoning strategy required modes are ranking hints and its plan is not execution.md

title: Cognitive metadata index construction reads full bodies and trusts merged status
body: Nested index discovery reads each referenced JSON body and may place procedure content into relations; skill description fallback reads entire body. _add unions list fields but first nonempty scalar wins, including first status/title/risk. Missing catalog owner defaults active; missing integration_state in target capability registries becomes admitted. These labels are projection rules, not admission receipts.
note: 05 Findings/D408 Cognitive metadata index construction reads full bodies and trusts merged status.md

title: Cognitive dependency and alias resolution have different ambiguity rules
body: Dependency edges use explicit reviewed mappings or one unique exact/normalized identity, otherwise retain unresolved. Alias-to-leaf helper mapping overwrites normalized collisions before applying aliases. Target project/metacognitive capability records retain dependency/formula fields without creating corresponding edges, so hydration can omit those declarations. Explicit reviewed status is a string, not authenticated review evidence.

title: Cognitive index validation does not validate every referenced asset
body: Validator rebuilds and compares index, detects dangling target keys and reports unresolved dependencies without failing them. It does not rehash each supplied body digest, require source/implementation paths to exist/contain root, reject source-edge omissions or validate cycles/status semantics. Tolerant nested JSON readers can skip malformed assets. Standalone builder rebuilds twice then directly overwrites output without atomic publication.
note: 05 Findings/D410 Cognitive index validation does not validate every referenced asset.md

title: Navigator can return unrelated selectable records for a nonmatching query
body: Each selectable record gets+0.25 even without lexical/fuzzy/dense evidence, and only nonpositive total scores are discarded. Thus an unmatched query can produce nondegraded results if such records exist. Selectable includes reference_only/reference/formula, not just admitted/executable; default selectable_only is false. Exact governed alias reason does not prove freshness or authority.

title: Hydration plan returns unverified paths and incomplete dependency semantics
body: Navigator trusts supplied index revision/records, can hydrate any known key regardless selectable status, and includes no source hash in plan entries. It follows owned_by/depends_on/uses_formula/step edges but omits extends and plain dependency fields lacking edges. It returns valid true with unresolved or truncation and reads no files. Limits bound records, not initial keys or all queued edges.

title: Cognitive CLI run depends on the index even for pure operations
body: CLI loads cognitive_map_index.json before branching into status/query/hydration/run. Discovery revision and executable operation evidence are separate boundaries.

title: Cognitive trust and reality labels do not resolve evidence
body: TrustEvidence flags are tested for truthiness, confidence against0.6 and text against seven poison substrings. Quarantine is only a returned decision. Reality checks nonempty reference-set inclusion in caller current IDs and contradicted is True; empty claim input can pass. Neither checks content hashes, signatures, current revisions or claim meaning independently.

title: Drift and health comparisons lack finite-value guarantees
body: Identity is exact supplied field equality without identity provenance. Personality compares baseline traits only, ignoring extras; NaN differences do not exceed tolerance. These helpers do not collect runtime measurements.

body: Each runner call actually executes supplied code. Exceptions inside run/comparison become an error name, but actual.encode for hashing is outside that catch and a nonstring return can escape. Unknown match modes fail; duplicate case IDs are not rejected. No case/time/output limit or process lifecycle wrapper is supplied here.

title: Cognitive passport certification is a metadata conjunction
body: Ten component mappings need only be nonempty, so nonempty invalid-status components satisfy presence. Empty trust decisions satisfy the trust condition. title: Black-box exclusive files lack sequence and path ownership controls
body: Recorder stores payload_hash, not raw nested payload. runtime_id, event_type and evidence_refs are stored verbatim. Exclusive create prevents replacement of one exact path, not authenticated append-only history or containment.

title: Capability genome invalidity does not stop downstream analysis
body: Build reports unknown relation types/endpoints but still computes graph metrics; malformed rows can raise. body: Required domains affect a score unless a domain_fit minimum is supplied; unknown requirement keys are ignored unless included in weights. estimated_cost is the hard budget field, while cost is a normalized scoring field. title: Team composition rewards additional failure labels and lacks aggregate budgets
body: After primary selection, compose_team adds a candidate when its known_failure_modes are not a subset of the accumulated failures. This grows failure-label coverage, not proven complementary success. Duplicate IDs resolve back to first matching profile. max_agents zero or negative can still select the first candidate because limit checks follow append. title: Introspection validates selected shape rather than causal evidence
body: Event IDs must be unique but whitespace is accepted; timestamps and summaries require presence, not parsed time/typed contents. body: Profiler records prohibited fields as violations but keeps rows in pattern aggregation. successful is bool-coerced, so nonempty false-like strings count true. Only the first three example slots are retained before filtering absent references. compare_profiles ignores source/target valid flags and can suggest patterns derived from invalid profiles.

title: Metacognitive epistemic state is independent binary updating
body: Each hypothesis receives sequential supplied likelihood updates with no dependence correction or cross-hypothesis normalization. body: Claims group by exact subject without scope/time/provenance handling. A different non-None value or normalized statement equal to not plus the other statement yields unresolved pair. body: simulate computes effective_trust from age and half-life for entropy but contradiction_pressure reads each record original trust. Thus time decay need not reduce contradiction pressure. Relations are unvalidated coexecution pairs, including missing IDs stringified None, and attractor strength is summed caller weight. Stability/priorities are fixed weighted formulas with no calibration evidence or persistence.
