title: Optimization recommendations can bypass intended checks through malformed numeric policy
body: Unknown direction strings bypass threshold and regression branches but dominate/utility treat them as minimize. NaN metrics evade less/greater threshold and regression checks and can remain Pareto candidates. Empty directions retain all candidates and can still select by utility/ID order. Rollback and independent-validation fields are constant requirements, not performed operations. No collection/time budget or identity/provenance check exists.
note: 05 Findings/D427 Optimization recommendations can bypass intended checks through malformed numeric policy.md

title: Semantic lint checks declarations and selected prefixes only
body: Required list containers are type-checked but elements are not; unhashable rows or nonstring observed effects can raise. Undeclared effects are rejected only for selected sensitive prefixes, using exact write membership rather than hierarchy. Concrete rollback requires only a truthy method; rollback.required false produces warning. Evidence arrays and observed effects are caller declarations, not admission or runtime interception.
note: 05 Findings/D428 Semantic lint checks declarations and selected prefixes only.md

title: Theory clusters use connected similarity rather than universal shared mechanism
body: Signatures merge tokens across mechanisms/formulas/inputs/outputs/failure_modes/invariants, losing field roles. Similarity-connected components can join dissimilar endpoints and have empty all-member intersection. Duplicate IDs collapse records. Cluster IDs include only first two sorted members and can remain unchanged as membership grows. Threshold is unbounded and all pairs are retained.
note: 05 Findings/D429 Theory clusters use connected similarity rather than universal shared mechanism.md

title: Theory admission flag counts supplied held-out pass values
body: validate_proposal bool-coerces case passed and only requires some cases, caller minimum pass rate and truthy distinctness_evidence. It does not execute cases, bind them to proposal identity, enforce independence or validate failure-boundary/operational-value requirements returned by induce. Output reads proposal_id while induced cluster uses cluster_id, requiring an explicit conversion. admit does not publish a theory.
note: 05 Findings/D430 Theory admission flag counts supplied held-out pass values.md

title: Metacognitive facade valid does not mean every domain recommendation succeeded
body: Missing result.valid defaults true, so admit false, abstained true or retain_baseline can accompany wrapper valid true. Only KeyError/TypeError/ValueError are caught around handler; ZeroDivisionError and hashing errors can escape. Fixed denominator and ID-set checks do not establish duplicate-free bijection, implementation/formula correctness or executed workflows. Sixteen operations are explicit payload-only analyses.
note: 05 Findings/D431 Metacognitive facade valid does not mean every domain recommendation succeeded.md

title: Cognitive assurance integration is demonstrated by tests rather than a production owner
body: Repository Python caller search finds cognitive_assurance function definitions and test imports/calls; registry-builder ownership and a reference candidate string do not call the helpers. Tests compose successful passport inputs and selected poison/drift/redaction failures. Metacognitive tests cover basic facade dispatch/denominators and selected validation, not all sixteen operation branches or newly identified numerical/order cases. This report reads tests without running them.
note: 05 Findings/D432 Cognitive assurance integration is demonstrated by tests rather than a production owner.md

title: Behavioral probe validation does not prevent effects or enforce a deadline
body: Duplicate IDs, missing control roles and invalid role labels accumulate reasons but every callback still runs. max_latency_ms is evaluated after invoke and compare complete, so it cannot stop a hanging callback. If all declared oracles have identical repr, discriminating is true even for constant output. Observed successful outputs are retained raw; only exception details are reduced to type.
note: 05 Findings/D433 Behavioral probe validation does not prevent effects or enforce a deadline.md

title: Attribution confidence and coverage demand are supplied-data heuristics
body: attribute_failure prioritizes fixed confidence constants over caller boolean signals; it performs no retrieval or probe. Coverage frontier groups exact normalized ASCII tokens, not semantic clusters; representative text remains and normalization is not redaction. Prioritization can accept nonfinite normalized values through less/greater checks and accepts nonboolean regression/safety inputs. Neither function permits mutation.
note: 05 Findings/D434 Attribution confidence and coverage demand are supplied-data heuristics.md

title: Lineage and six-axis gates have separate unchecked policy inputs
body: Lineage checks exact origin/authority/visibility labels and nonempty source_refs without authenticating them; omitted authority/visibility can avoid rejection. assurance_score rejects NaN axis values through range checks but does not validate minimum_axis, so NaN or negative threshold can bypass intended minimums. Numeric string axes can pass float range checking yet fail the later raw-value comparison.
note: 05 Findings/D435 Lineage and six-axis gates have separate unchecked policy inputs.md

title: Behavioral delta certificate does not prove an executed improvement
body: Cases require unique nonblank IDs, expected candidate equality and lowercase SHA shape. Negative-trigger and hard-gate cases must return deny-like labels, but positive coverage is optional, equal baseline/candidate hashes are allowed and changed_case_count may be zero. A positive case with both decisions omitted can pass equality. Evidence hashes are not resolved and the certificate digest is unkeyed.
note: 05 Findings/D436 Behavioral delta certificate does not prove an executed improvement.md

title: Shadow containment and kill switch describe already supplied results
body: compare_shadow_behavior receives completed results, not executable functions. It labels effects contained when caller strings are a subset of read_local/isolated_compute; it does not observe effects or stop a candidate. Kill switch suppresses candidate comparison/hash after result production has already happened elsewhere. Incumbent always returns and authority_granted stays false.
note: 05 Findings/D437 Shadow containment and kill switch describe already supplied results.md

title: Coverage gate trusts summary counts and suffix path matching
body: Validator trusts num_branches/missing_branches without nonnegative or missing<=total checks; zero total gives100percent. An empty class/module policy can pass. It matches exact or suffix module paths rather than source hashes, and accepts any nonempty context name somewhere in the file. Aggregated class coverage can hide a poorly covered module; per-module floors are not imposed.
note: 05 Findings/D438 Coverage gate trusts summary counts and suffix path matching.md

title: Coverage policy errors and class validity can diverge
body: Class valid depends only on complete module matches and aggregate percentage; missing dynamic contexts can make overall valid false while the class still reports valid true. Exemptions are shape-checked and counted, not applied to branch totals. Coverage and policy are read again for hashing after evaluation, so concurrent mutation can bind different bytes from those evaluated. Release caller adds report generation and release-root/hash checks, but helper alone does not prove execution.
note: 05 Findings/D439 Coverage policy errors and class validity can diverge.md

title: Foundation contract compatibility is asymmetric and supplied
body: Only consumer required_fields are compared for presence/type. Provider required_fields, consumer optional fields and consumer ownership are not checked; empty sides can be compatible and unconsumed providers are informational. Authorization sets must match because either-direction differences create findings. Runtime surface plans validate ID/owner/check labels but allow duplicate surface IDs or no checks and execute nothing.
note: 05 Findings/D440 Foundation contract compatibility is asymmetric and supplied.md

title: Retrieval readiness binds result summaries rather than the complete evaluation policy
body: Readiness correctly rejects duplicate top-k results, absent relevance judgments and observed forbidden IDs. However it materializes full result sequences before slicing; leakage beyond k is outside scope. evaluation_sha256 includes rows/metrics but excludes threshold values, full judgments and actual ranked IDs. Identical summary hash can therefore accompany different readiness decisions. activation_allowed is a returned recommendation, not a backend activation.
note: 05 Findings/D441 Retrieval readiness binds result summaries rather than the complete evaluation policy.md

title: Dataset admission is metadata-only and does not require split diversity
body: TrainingRecord gate validates hash shape, allowed license/consent strings and cross-split same-content/subject overlaps. It does not fetch source bytes or approval evidence, require train/validation/test presence or prohibit duplicate content within a single split. minimum_records is unvalidated; zero can allow empty metadata. Dataset hash excludes allowed-license policy and threshold.
note: 05 Findings/D442 Dataset admission is metadata-only and does not require split diversity.md

title: Numerical and dimensional foundation helpers have narrower guarantees
body: Numeric shift rejects nonfinite series but does not require a finite threshold; NaN threshold can suppress drift and finite large values may overflow intermediate variance. For nonconstant baseline it measures only mean shift, not changed variance/distribution. Dimension checks int-coerce exponents before algebra, so fractional exponents can be truncated; steps are independent declarations, not linked to an expression or units.
note: 05 Findings/D443 Numerical and dimensional foundation helpers have narrower guarantees.md

title: Provider suite performs effects before guarded probes and lacks disposal
body: Factory calls and initial local.put occur outside _probe exception handling. Factories may start services or mutate stores; suite provides no timeout, ownership registration, close/finally or rollback and retains synthetic data. The foreign root is derived as a sibling of configured root. shared_process/source_of_truth flags are checked, but other isolation properties depend on actual factory behavior.
note: 05 Findings/D444 Provider suite performs effects before guarded probes and lacks disposal.md

title: Provider negative probes can certify weak or empty behavior
body: Prompt-log checks pass with empty logs; correction check only proves old value absent from search and can pass when search always returns empty, without proving corrected value retrievable. Global-slot probe compares configured namespace strings and Python object identity, not real process/storage separation. foreign_write_denied actually writes through foreign instance and checks local value unchanged. Tests use an in-memory fake and typed failure injection.
note: 05 Findings/D445 Provider negative probes can certify weak or empty behavior.md

title: Provider certificate identity excludes publication metadata and actual observations
body: Probe observed_sha256 hashes name/pass/error label, not provider response details. Certificate ID hashes provider/version/config/tests but excludes executed_utc, harness_version, project_id as a separate field, decision and later evidence_refs; config hash includes project indirectly. Optional JSON is exclusive but unkeyed, without independent verifier or backend artifact identity. Returned certified_accelerator does not install or activate a provider.
note: 05 Findings/D446 Provider certificate identity excludes publication metadata and actual observations.md

title: Change proof classification is lexical metadata and has precedence traps
body: Paths are stripped and slash-normalized without resolving dot segments or verifying a diff. Marker substrings such as version can raise unrelated files to release critical. Authority/schema paths return before declared effects, so effects do not always produce the higher RUNTIME class. Malformed non-list symbols/effects are silently treated empty. Upward override verifies hash shape and nonempty approver/rationale but does not retrieve evidence.
note: 05 Findings/D447 Change proof classification is lexical metadata and has precedence traps.md

title: Assurance test names do not establish end-to-end integration
body: Behavioral tests demonstrate callbacks, fixed attribution, lineage labels and average gating. Foundation tests pass synthetic contracts/results/datasets; provider tests use a fake backend. Coverage fixtures supply generated-looking counts and test certificate byte tampering. Python caller search finds actual CLI attribution/score, clean-room delta/shadow dispatch and release coverage generation, but no production run_behavioral_probe or provider-isolation owner.
note: 05 Findings/D448 Assurance test names do not establish end-to-end integration.md

title: Runtime startup and exit helpers have limited authority
body: runtime package import sets sys.dont_write_bytecode globally; runtime.__main__ invokes CLI main. Exit mapping recognizes a closed set and otherwise uses fallback_valid. Platform support checks exact major.minor membership in supplied policy rather than interpreting python_requires; empty version falls back to interpreter. Runtime VERSION is0.7.0 in this source snapshot, not independently verified marketplace state.
note: 05 Findings/D449 Runtime startup and exit helpers have limited authority.md

title: Generic instrumentation preserves caller identity and timestamps across lifecycle variants
body: SDK deep-copies payload and changes lifecycle/result only, retaining event_id, time and previous hash. A caller emitting variants directly to bus must refresh identity/linking itself; RuntimeLifecycle separately uses UUIDs. Started emission happens before try, failed emission can mask original exception, and completed-emission failure follows successful body execution. No effect observation or actor authorization occurs.
note: 05 Findings/D450 Generic instrumentation preserves caller identity and timestamps across lifecycle variants.md

title: Route certifiable is a declaration check rather than current operating readiness
body: Route validator checks schema, ID uniqueness, A/B/C mechanism pairing and blind-spot labels. It does not check consent, active status, health, owner files or evidence content, and Tier D mechanism none is enforced only by deeper reconciliation. Event capture authorization is a classification string, not a verified grant; schema permits nonempty event IDs without safe path syntax and does not correlate lifecycle/result/timing/effects.
note: 05 Findings/D451 Route certifiable is a declaration check rather than current operating readiness.md

title: Bus publication trusts state and route metadata before extending history
body: publish recovers WAL and reads state but does not invoke head or replay before appending. It checks route ID/tier while ignoring route status, consent, effect classes and component/owner identity. Registry is validated then reread, cached by size/mtime/ctime. Event IDs may repeat and receipt path is built from raw ID, so existing receipts can be replaced and dot segments can target other paths within the WAL allowed root. WAL containment does not imply receipt-namespace confinement.
note: 05 Findings/D452 Bus publication trusts state and route metadata before extending history.md

title: Operational batches are sequential commits rather than atomic ingress
body: publish_batch caps1000 events then calls publish independently. Later invalid input leaves earlier events committed, and concurrent publishers can interleave between batch members. CLI caps ingress bytes and overwrites previous hash using link_current_head; this authenticates local chain placement, not the external event producer. There is no cross-event lifecycle or unique event-ID guard.
note: 05 Findings/D453 Operational batches are sequential commits rather than atomic ingress.md

title: Head and replay have different integrity and concurrency limits
body: head holds publish lock, recovers WAL and validates current anchor/state/event plus preceding event digest, not complete ancestry. replay recovers without publish lock, scans all events and can race publication. If no event files exist, replay skips state/head consistency even with nonzero state; head revision0 checks head presence but not orphan event files. Anchors are unkeyed local JSON rather than an external trust root.
note: 05 Findings/D454 Head and replay have different integrity and concurrency limits.md

title: Replay output limits and subscriptions do not bound all work or guarantee all deltas
body: replay reads/retains full history before selecting records after cursor and taking the latest limit; it does not indicate omitted earlier deltas. limit0 still scans history. wait_for_revision uses an instance-local condition, so another instance/process cannot wake it and new state may be observed only at timeout. Full replay cost follows the timeout and is not included in it.
note: 05 Findings/D455 Replay output limits and subscriptions do not bound all work or guarantee all deltas.md

title: Runtime lifecycle wrapper has incomplete terminal traces and declared observations
body: Wrapper emits plan/orchestration/workflow/task starts before checking approved truthiness. Denial or execution failure closes only task/approval or tool/task, leaving parent starts open. verify exceptions are outside execution catch and leave verification started. Successful tool event copies declared_effects to observed_effects; no sensor validates them. Cached previous head races other publishers, and publication failure can follow completed callback effects. No production RuntimeLifecycle caller was found in runtime/scripts search.
note: 05 Findings/D456 Runtime lifecycle wrapper has incomplete terminal traces and declared observations.md

title: Operational coverage hashes receipts without checking their semantic claims
body: A/B advertised routes require healthy supplied state, timezone freshness and matching local receipt SHA. Receipt contents need not name route, state, observation time, kind or current owner revision. Accepted card artifacts need status accepted and matching bytes, but are not tied to each route requirement beyond card prefix. Tier C needs no current health state. valid describes input integrity while certifiable also requires no blockers.
note: 05 Findings/D457 Operational coverage hashes receipts without checking their semantic claims.md

title: Coverage read bounds and identities are not one immutable evidence snapshot
body: JSON size is checked by stat before full read, and health file is fully hashed before the bounded loader. Evidence glob is fully sorted before1000 cap; artifact hashes stream arbitrary total bytes. Hash and parse passes can observe different contents, registry validates then reloads and is hashed later. Linked card JSON paths are not independently resolved below root before load. Unknown/duplicate health routes fail input validity, while stale receipts are operational blockers.
note: 05 Findings/D458 Coverage read bounds and identities are not one immutable evidence snapshot.md

title: External owner evidence is a portable assertion rather than current external-file verification
body: Extension/MCP missing owners may be satisfied by an accepted local receipt with exact owner-path key and SHA shape. The external root need only be a nonempty string; actual external bytes, receipt producer, timestamp and result are not verified. Planned unadvertised routes skip acceptance validation, so such receipts can be considered without that hash-validation path. Local owner checks hash current bytes but do not prove those bytes implement the route.
note: 05 Findings/D459 External owner evidence is a portable assertion rather than current external-file verification.md

title: Host startup attribution has bounded-tail and cache-identity qualifications
body: Selects lexically newest of64 session directories, then latest Codex log with exthost file, without first proving start marker exists. Reads up to16MiB tail by initial size, but growth after stat can exceed it. Main/gateway truncation is not included in log_tail_truncated and their stats are omitted from cache fingerprint. Times are host-local without offsets and marker order is observational; output explicitly refuses causal PX cost or first-tool-readiness claims.
note: 05 Findings/D460 Host startup attribution has bounded-tail and cache-identity qualifications.md

title: Skill host boundary and projection agreement do not inspect every skill body
body: Global SKILL.md paths are recursively enumerated without a cap. facade_only checks10–20 directories and px- prefixes, not body semantics. Skill integrity compares ID sets of index/catalog/directories/package filenames after index validation; it does not compare each package body or status, and set conversion hides duplicate catalog IDs. Direct host-global selection remains explicitly outside PX enforcement.
note: 05 Findings/D461 Skill host boundary and projection agreement do not inspect every skill body.md

title: Frozen benchmark profile is a mutable hash-bearing declaration
body: freeze returns shallow nested structures with hashes, not immutable storage, and cold environment rules are enforced only by subsequent verify. verify checks sections/lane/hash/retry but omits freeze schema_version/run_id/enabled checks; self-rehashed malformed profiles can pass some consumers. Comparison intentionally removes enabled/capabilities/run_id, so distinct enabled capability sets share comparison treatment identity. No environment or oracle observation occurs.
note: 05 Findings/D462 Frozen benchmark profile is a mutable hash-bearing declaration.md

title: Benchmark preflight retry and contamination are caller-policy decisions
body: Preflight requires selected flags is True, but callers can replace required_checks with empty sequence. Retry uses completed_attempts and declared retryable classes without durable attempt accounting or retry execution. Cold contamination accepts any treatment_visibility except exact visible; noncold lanes bypass contamination restrictions. Test-only admission treats every scope string except exact test_only as normal.
note: 05 Findings/D463 Benchmark preflight retry and contamination are caller-policy decisions.md

title: Matched summaries do not pair trial identities or enforce frozen treatment
body: Task sets and per-task row counts must match, but run/trial IDs, environment hashes and comparison profiles are absent. Duplicate rows satisfy counts. Infrastructure-error rows remain in pass-rate denominator. Optional metrics can have different sample denominators and lack finite checks. Strict passed is True avoids truthy strings; result explicitly claims no statistical significance.
note: 05 Findings/D464 Matched summaries do not pair trial identities or enforce frozen treatment.md

title: Benchmark sealed and valid claim labels are not independent custody proof
body: build_custody_record reads full supplied paths or bytes and hashes them plus arbitrary aggregate, returning sealed true even for empty artifacts or run ID. No filesystem seal, signature, atomic snapshot or aggregate-to-artifact relationship is created. Claim labels trust supplied booleans and can call a result controlled uplift without observing actual delta; external comparability is a separate flag.
note: 05 Findings/D465 Benchmark sealed and valid claim labels are not independent custody proof.md

title: Operational tests establish selected source-level contracts rather than observed whole-system closure
body: SDK test compares one Python/Node fixture. Bus tests exercise ordered publish, same-instance wake, selected tampering and CLI ingress; lifecycle tests cover success, callback exception and approval denial. Coverage tests validate synthetic hashes/freshness/external owner declarations. Host tests use synthetic log markers; benchmark tests use supplied results. Cross-process wake, empty-history nonzero state, duplicate IDs, verifier exceptions and semantic receipt contents are not covered by these source tests.
note: 05 Findings/D466 Operational tests establish selected source-level contracts rather than observed whole-system closure.md

title: Classified JSON containment is enforced only on the corrupt-authority path
body: load_classified_json loads/validates caller path before any allowed-root check; successful files and derived-corruption results can be outside allowed root. Optional validator TypeError/ValueError is treated as corrupt state, even if caused by validator logic. No production caller found in runtime/scripts search; registry owner existence does not wire this loader into every state store.
note: 05 Findings/D467 Classified JSON containment is enforced only on the corrupt-authority path.md

title: Authoritative quarantine snapshots are not bound to the bytes that failed parsing
body: After parse failure, quarantine takes two snapshots and a third immediate snapshot but does not compare them to original parsed bytes. A repaired file arriving before those snapshots can be moved as corrupt. Resolving source/quarantine before link checks can erase original symlink spelling. Registry artifact_kind joins destination directories without identifier validation; no final destination containment check follows that join.
note: 05 Findings/D468 Authoritative quarantine snapshots are not bound to the bytes that failed parsing.md

title: Authoritative quarantine detects post-move identity changes but requires explicit recovery
body: Intent is exclusively written/fsynced before os.replace. Destination snapshot must match size/mtime/device/inode/hash; mismatch or final receipt failure retains custody and tries recovery receipt, falling back to intent if recovery write fails. There is no rollback or recovery executor here. Destination-existence check and replacement are separate; no shared lock closes producer/path races. Tests exercise identity swap and final receipt failure.
note: 05 Findings/D469 Authoritative quarantine detects post-move identity changes but requires explicit recovery.md

title: Intake full-tree snapshots actually identify regular-file projections
body: snapshot_tree records files only, hashes whole files after separate stat and omits empty directories, links as links, device/inode and permissions. File symlinks can be followed and enumeration/read work has no count/byte bound. Equality is therefore file-projection identity, not full filesystem snapshot or a lock against concurrent changes.
note: 05 Findings/D470 Intake full-tree snapshots actually identify regular-file projections.md

title: Intake sequence and reopen semantics have gaps
body: Exclusive filenames include sequence plus event kind, so concurrent different event kinds can occupy the same sequence and later fail sequence validation. Events have no hash chain or authentication. close_intake chooses the last two snapshot events over entire history, not since latest open/reopen or matching alias, so unchanged prior-epoch snapshots can satisfy closure. Only actor string presence is checked; nonfinite stability window is not rejected.
note: 05 Findings/D471 Intake sequence and reopen semantics have gaps.md

title: Closed intake movement can complete before failing without a journal
body: The dedicated move helper performs repeated file equality checks then mkdir/shutil.move and post-move snapshot. It has no intent journal, failure compensation or recovery receipt; an existing source manifest name is discovered only after move when exclusive manifest creation fails. Destination-inside-source is not explicitly rejected, and destination existence can change between check and shutil.move. No quarantine event updates the intake ledger.
note: 05 Findings/D472 Closed intake movement can complete before failing without a journal.md

title: Explicit-path wrapper has a file-shape heuristic and independent final publication
body: Expected hashes treat len(inventory)==1 plus path suffix as a file. An extensionless file instead gains a duplicated basename, while a dotted one-file directory can lose its child name. Backend only compares expected keys that match actual inventory, so mismatched wrapper keys do not prove preplanned identity. Backend provides overlap/journal checks, but wrapper post-check or manifest failure can follow committed movement. Final manifest write is nonexclusive after an earlier existence check.
note: 05 Findings/D473 Explicit-path wrapper has a file-shape heuristic and independent final publication.md

title: Evidence cache reserved revisions can be shadowed by dependency names
body: EvidenceCache.key constructs source/authority/toolchain fields then expands caller dependency_revisions into the same mapping. A dependency named source_revision can replace the explicit source revision, yielding a key that does not bind that argument. Stringified dependency keys can collide too. Values require SHA format, not authoritative freshness or complete dependency inventory.
note: 05 Findings/D474 Evidence cache reserved revisions can be shadowed by dependency names.md

title: Evidence cache immutability applies to blobs rather than key mappings
body: put stores content-addressed blobs but overwrites entries[key], so same revision key can point to a different result. Corrupt/missing manifest often resets to empty, while some malformed shapes/Unicode errors escape. get builds a path from unvalidated manifest digest before integrity checking and locks even reads; no blob size cap exists. Prepared files use atomic replace without fsync or failure cleanup, and blob publication can precede failed manifest write.
note: 05 Findings/D475 Evidence cache immutability applies to blobs rather than key mappings.md

title: Durable goal blocker repetition cannot accumulate from refused transitions
body: block requires three consecutive matching history entries, but failed first/second block attempts are not appended because history is updated only when event_applied. Normal returned-state reuse therefore cannot reach blocked without preexisting caller-injected history. Block and complete do not require an in-progress source; supplied acceptance truthiness/nonempty evidence can complete planned or already complete state. No state hash or history integrity is verified.
note: 05 Findings/D476 Durable goal blocker repetition cannot accumulate from refused transitions.md

title: Goal budget and specification closure do not prove durable acceptance
body: continuation_cost is subtracted on every applied event, but budget exhaustion is checked only for continue. Other events may yield negative remaining budget. Specification requires all stage names and earlier references, but can skip adjacent-stage lineage and acceptance need not depend on implementation evidence. Evidence hash is truthiness only. closure_sha256 hashes aggregate counts/errors, not supplied artifact IDs/dependencies/content. Neither helper persists state or grants authority.
note: 05 Findings/D477 Goal budget and specification closure do not prove durable acceptance.md

title: Artifact reachability labels are generated declarations not observed call paths
body: Registry files receive release_validated and default structural owner by filename table. Workflow entrypoint/mode comes from binding strings; duplicate binding keys collapse and targets are not resolved/executed. Agency assets are classified by directory pattern. Structural audit compares rebuilt inventory, which establishes projection freshness rather than runtime reachability.
note: 05 Findings/D478 Artifact reachability labels are generated declarations not observed call paths.md

title: Reachability exclusions avoid digest cycles but do not bound traversal
body: Static inventory intentionally omits live completion/evidence/test-group/world/ledger/engine projections to avoid hash cycles. Root YAML globs and registry/provider traversals enumerate and hash files before record filters external-environment paths, so exclusion does not prevent all I/O to ignored trees. No global file/byte cap or link identity check exists. Standalone builder directly overwrites output without atomic publication or independent validation.
note: 05 Findings/D479 Reachability exclusions avoid digest cycles but do not bound traversal.md

title: State and intake tests leave important lifecycle branches unproved
body: Authoritative tests cover corruption preservation, snapshot mismatch, post-move identity swap and receipt failure. Cache tests cover revision change and blob corruption only. Intake tests cover two snapshots and drift, while closed-intake/path wrappers cover simple moves and selected boundary rejection. No source test here covers reopened epoch reuse, concurrent different event kinds, existing manifest collision, reserved cache revision names or goal block accumulation through returned state. No product operations were run.
note: 05 Findings/D480 State and intake tests leave important lifecycle branches unproved.md

title: Proposal digest is sanitized identity, not source identity
body: Sanitization redacts/stringifies keys and values before hashing; collisions can discard distinctions, and recursive collections lack depth/cycle limits. Bounded lists are fully materialized before size rejection.
note: 05 Findings/D481 Proposal digest is sanitized identity, not source identity.md

title: Proposal writer does not authenticate or exclusively publish envelope
body: Writer checks IDs and candidate/nonactivating flags but not proposal_digest or promotion requirements. Existing-file check precedes ordinary write, leaving overwrite race and partial-write exposure.
note: 05 Findings/D482 Proposal writer does not authenticate or exclusively publish envelope.md

title: Skill gap is relative to caller registry rows
body: One supplied provides superset blocks even inactive records; combined coverage is not considered. The candidate contains metadata, not an implemented skill or resolved evidence.
note: 05 Findings/D483 Skill gap is relative to caller registry rows.md

title: Workflow currentness and budget are caller declarations
body: Active/admitted, failed default zero and evidence current label qualify contracts without receipts. Int-converted negative cost/time contributions can lower estimates; these are not runtime enforcement.
note: 05 Findings/D484 Workflow currentness and budget are caller declarations.md

title: Effect subset can suppress proposed approval gates
body: Requested nonempty effects may be a subset of the capability declaration; approval gates derive from that subset. Structural validation checks known effects but does not prove capability implementation omits other declared mutations.
note: 05 Findings/D485 Effect subset can suppress proposed approval gates.md

title: Adapter can omit a required target field
body: Mapping validation accepts optional source to required target of matching type. Transform skips absent optional source and never validates resulting target, so required output can be absent. Source-derived branch finding, not executed reproduction.
note: 05 Findings/D486 Adapter can omit a required target field.md

title: Repair quarantine is a heuristic proposal label
body: Snippet regex checks selected spellings only and can match comments while missing aliases. Original snippet hash may differ from sanitized retained snippet. No file move or code execution follows.
note: 05 Findings/D487 Repair quarantine is a heuristic proposal label.md

title: Proposed test evidence does not run tests
body: passed is evaluated by truthiness, so a nonempty string counts as passed. Required kinds and sanitized digest do not prove observed results, current receipts or admission readiness.
note: 05 Findings/D488 Proposed test evidence does not run tests.md

title: Domain publication can stop after rewriting earlier owners
body: Generator writes domain body/contracts/helper/package before advancing to later domains and registry projections. Missing directory or later parse/write failure leaves partial state; no journal or compensation is implemented.
note: 05 Findings/D489 Domain publication can stop after rewriting earlier owners.md

title: Domain builder assigns validation counts without running tests
body: Package is active/current; admission sets passed=4, failed=0. Owner/workflow/build receipt remains not verified, while already implemented_verified cards survive target rewriting. Status consumers must preserve these different proof scopes.
note: 05 Findings/D490 Domain builder assigns validation counts without running tests.md

title: Generated body and routing namespaces differ
body: Body creation/hash uses .agents/skills; catalog body, references and implementation targets use .px/skills. Generator does not synchronize those trees, so another projection owner is required. Catalog replacement also assumes exact block formatting.
note: 05 Findings/D491 Generated body and routing namespaces differ.md

title: Support schemas and callable registry are declarations
body: Top-level schema is closed and required, but objects/array members remain broad. Callable strings and producer/consumer ownership labels are emitted without resolution or instance execution. Generic input cases repeat across outcomes.
note: 05 Findings/D492 Support schemas and callable registry are declarations.md

title: Support generator writes certified and provisional status together
body: Pack index says implemented_and_certified before QA says operational tests pending and certification says provisional. No test/certifier call exists in builder; hashes include only owner body/package, excluding generated support corpus.
note: 05 Findings/D493 Support generator writes certified and provisional status together.md

title: Semantic index CLI publication is caller-directed and nonatomic
body: Output joined to resolved root can be absolute or traverse parents. No output parent creation, staged replacement or postwrite validation is performed by this wrapper.
note: 05 Findings/D494 Semantic index CLI publication is caller-directed and nonatomic.md

title: Builder tests do not establish generated runtime integration
body: Wave5 fixtures cover proposal helpers and sequential duplicate write; build-support checks strings/schema fields; integration acceptance directly calls builder and runtime utilities. None execute generated declared-suite publication or certify proposed workflows.

title: Assimilation safety filtering is based on filenames

note: 05 Findings/D587 Section input paths and temporary publication need caller discipline.md

title: Bounded failure attribution still contains caller-controlled names
body: Output is hashed and raw bodies omitted, but extracted pytest node IDs, Node/TAP titles are retained up to 50 by 300 characters. Parameterized names can include sensitive values; length limits and stripping assertion tails do not perform general redaction.
note: 05 Findings/D588 Bounded failure attribution still contains caller-controlled names.md

title: Repair phase checking and actual stage claims are separate
body: Phase table blocks closure while intake/unresolved remains. Project marker adds release identity and pending/current claim checks; require_processing_stage does not claim or advance state. Repository campaign is preferred over project state, and roots without campaign/marker are unmanaged.
note: 05 Findings/D589 Repair phase checking and actual stage claims are separate.md

title: CLI narrows inherited test lease to one marked child
body: CLI only permits reuse for test-group run-stale when owner and supervised-child environment values match, then removes child marker. This supplements the permissive lock helper, but values are environment claims rather than OS parent verification.
note: 05 Findings/D590 CLI narrows inherited test lease to one marked child.md

title: Independent gate cache does not bind every executable input
body: Digest includes gate ID, matched file bytes and dependency receipt hashes, not GateSpec definition or runner/toolchain identity by default. Licensing input list omits runtime/licensing.py, third-party license files and several required root files, so those changes may reuse an earlier passing cache.
note: 05 Findings/D591 Independent gate cache does not bind every executable input.md

title: Independent gate receipt integrity is not semantic consistency
body: _load_receipt accepts matching unkeyed hash. Run/finalize trust passed and input hash without requiring nested result.valid or expected schema/gate identity. Malformed nonobject JSON may escape because TypeError/AttributeError are not uniformly caught.
note: 05 Findings/D592 Independent gate receipt integrity is not semantic consistency.md

title: Independent gate ordering and publication assume fixed registry
body: Run recurses dependencies without explicit cycle guard; finalize assumes registry insertion order supplies dependencies first. Direct receipt overwrite has no transaction/lock/fsync, and fingerprint is captured before callback only. CLI lock selector does not include gates surface.
note: 05 Findings/D593 Independent gate ordering and publication assume fixed registry.md

title: Licensing consistency does not authenticate every attribution body
body: Validator exact-hashes main LICENSE, but fixed third-party files only require presence and NOTICE markers; reported hashes are not compared to expected bodies. Missing README is not itself a required-root failure. This is configured metadata consistency, not legal sufficiency or exhaustive dependency licensing.
note: 05 Findings/D594 Licensing consistency does not authenticate every attribution body.md

title: Licensing report checks relative location after writing
body: Caller can supply absolute destination; writer creates parents and writes report before relative_to(root) is evaluated for returned locator. Outside-root destination therefore can receive bytes before ValueError. CLI default uses repository evidence path.
note: 05 Findings/D595 Licensing report checks relative location after writing.md

title: Gate and test-profile tests leave consumer asymmetries uncovered
body: Tests cover useful input drift, failed-gate rerun, strict chunk receipt tamper, structural inventory drift and phase order. They do not assert section/group hash verification, relative-import closure, stale-index status loss or independent-gate self-resealed inconsistency.
note: 05 Findings/D596 Gate and test-profile tests leave consumer asymmetries uncovered.md

title: Verifier description can create or migrate authority state
body: studio_approval calls StudioAuthorityStore constructor, which creates project identity/key directories and keys or migrates legacy key and writes receipt. Bridge calls descriptor during approval setup. No host approval signature is issued here, but operation is not filesystem read-only.
note: 05 Findings/D597 Verifier description can create or migrate authority state.md

title: Preview and dry-run do not mean constructor-free reads
body: Agent preview/workflow dry-run bypass approval but instantiate ordinary controllers, which initialize Studio authority/run control. Their task behavior is nonexecuting. Runs/status instead use open_existing and knowledge browse requests read_only, providing different effect boundaries.
note: 05 Findings/D598 Preview and dry-run do not mean constructor-free reads.md

title: Host approval can be consumed before operation validation fails
body: Dispatcher verifies/consumes proof then parses typed specs, checks task shapes, constructs controllers or resolves later files. Successful proof consumption is not the same as successful requested mutation; later error may require a new approval. Payload mismatch is rejected before consumption by lower verifier, as tested.
note: 05 Findings/D599 Host approval can be consumed before operation validation fails.md

title: Direct draft helpers have a different trust boundary
body: create_draft and admit_skill_source are public Python helpers called directly by tests. They do not perform top-level signed host-proof consumption; they rely on trusted caller and lower source/allocation/controller checks. The CLI routes through studio_operation.
note: 05 Findings/D600 Direct draft helpers have a different trust boundary.md

title: Studio transport bounds are not identical across entry routes
body: Base64 decode allocates before decoded 256 KiB check. Stdin reads at most 528 KiB plus sentinel for envelope and does not apply same generic 256 KiB check to read payload. Direct Python studio_operation has no transport bound. Only version-conflict exceptions receive compact structured errors in main.
note: 05 Findings/D601 Studio transport bounds are not identical across entry routes.md

title: Studio protocol validates vocabulary shape but not handler closure
body: Import chooses source registry before packaged fallback; schema/kinds mapping checked. Non-list kinds silently disappear and list members become strings, without nonempty/duplicate/known-operation validation. Parser accepts union while dispatcher pair check and handlers provide later limits.
note: 05 Findings/D602 Studio protocol validates vocabulary shape but not handler closure.md

title: Studio coercion is broader than field names imply
body: _strings accepts arrays but stringifies nonstrings. Workflow required/approval flags use bool and retry counts int, so string false and fractional inputs change meaning before controller checks. Layout validation is stricter: exact nodes, x/y fields, no bool, finite coordinates and absolute bound.
note: 05 Findings/D603 Studio coercion is broader than field names imply.md

title: Authority sidecar stores input contract but deliberately omits runtime values
body: Workflow envelope validates run_inputs mapping but stores contract descriptors and runtime_input_values_stored=False, not actual run inputs. Default contracts derive undriven input ports; supplied nonempty list replaces inference. Execution inputs arrive at run/start/resume separately.
note: 05 Findings/D604 Authority sidecar stores input contract but deliberately omits runtime values.md

title: Agent start branches by harness owner
body: start uses prepare_host_run for harness:vscode-lm; other harnesses call start_harness. run uses invoke_harness, and complete-host-run is separate authenticated completion route. Treating all agent starts as identical subprocess execution hides the host-model handoff.
note: 05 Findings/D605 Agent start branches by harness owner.md

title: Agency compilation authenticates metadata shape rather than source truth
body: Selection valid is truthy, route receipt only nonempty, score evidence only matching agent row. Plan/body/manifest digests have length checks but no hex/content/signature verification. Authority/budget ceilings are supplied by caller, and int coercion permits booleans/truncated numeric values.
note: 05 Findings/D606 Agency compilation authenticates metadata shape rather than source truth.md

title: Agency request submission does not revalidate request hash
body: Frozen dataclass includes mutable budgets mapping; submit accepts request attributes and callable create without recomputing hash or checking executor/type. Altered checkpoint values can be forwarded with unchanged hash. This is a record submission boundary, not proof of execution authorization.
note: 05 Findings/D607 Agency request submission does not revalidate request hash.md

title: Agency capability and route evidence do not survive create arguments
body: Request includes allowed_capabilities and agency_route_receipt_sha256, but submit forwards neither. It forwards specialist revision, request hash, plan/authority/budgets only. Downstream execution must establish capability authority independently. Source compiler callers found in tests; runtime wrapper does not compile or launch.
note: 05 Findings/D608 Agency capability and route evidence do not survive create arguments.md

title: Studio test approval is simulated fixture authority
body: Testkit installs a committed test-only public verifier and signs claims with fixture key material while labelling host/human context. Tests establish validation behavior under fixture authority, not real user approval. Helper can overwrite selected verifier and depends on caller test isolation.
note: 05 Findings/D609 Studio test approval is simulated fixture authority.md

title: Studio test coverage distinguishes artifact identity from all operations
body: API tests cover immutable revisions, allocation conflicts, layout, source attestation, signature/replay and selected agent/workflow fixture runs. Catalogue drift test preserves admission authentication while promotion status fails. No complete operation-by-operation execution receipt is established by these tests or this source review.
note: 05 Findings/D610 Studio test coverage distinguishes artifact identity from all operations.md

title: Skill comparison limits apply after full tree hashing
body: _comparison_tree calls inventory_tree before checking 512 files/16 MiB. Inventory sorts full rglob and hashes all files; hydration and description read whole text. Returned candidate/change limits do not bound total read work.
note: 05 Findings/D611 Skill comparison limits apply after full tree hashing.md

title: Native backup verifier permits empty source denominator
body: verify_backup never requires BACKUP_SCHEMA or nonempty sources; an empty sources manifest returns valid. Source/inventory/record paths are joined without resolved snapshot containment, and malformed structures may raise instead of returning invalid.
note: 05 Findings/D612 Native backup verifier permits empty source denominator.md

title: Native restore rejects an advertised empty destination
body: restore_backup permits absent or empty destination in its precheck, then copy_verified rejects any existing target. Existing empty directory therefore fails. Restore also mutates copied files for CRLF reconstruction before final tree check, leaving partial output on failure.
note: 05 Findings/D613 Native restore rejects an advertised empty destination.md

title: Native body identity and returned text are separate observations
body: Hash helper accepts raw bytes or newline-normalized text, and hydration opens body again afterward. Concurrent change can make returned content differ from checked hash. Preserved query records derive a new current body hash rather than authenticating original custody manifest.
note: 05 Findings/D614 Native body identity and returned text are separate observations.md

title: Native query grants and admission remain metadata assertions
body: Domain access checks grant strings, selectability trusts active/admitted labels or allow-unadmitted grant. Exact lookup returns first visible ID, so requesting multiple domains can select canonical before derived preserved record. Semantic query is weighted token overlap, not model-based semantic evaluation.
note: 05 Findings/D615 Native query grants and admission remain metadata assertions.md

title: Native package validation checks selected packaging invariants
body: Manifest JSON equality/id/domain, required path existence, resource list and body hash are checked. Package root itself is not uniformly constrained to PX root; schema/version/whole support-file hashes/admission evidence and actual tests are not established. Empty native record set can pass.
note: 05 Findings/D616 Native package validation checks selected packaging invariants.md

title: First migration can fail before its first recoverable journal
body: Snapshots and workspace/user backup copies occur before main journal creation. Failure leaves snapshot custody that causes a later no-journal run to refuse legacy state. Partial prepared-skills directory skips rebuild and can later be published before missing package detection.
note: 05 Findings/D617 First migration can fail before its first recoverable journal.md

title: Migration resume does not bind all original preparation inputs
body: Main journal binds workspace tree but catalog/enterprise metadata and prepared package contents are not one frozen transaction identity. Catalog is reread on resume; existing native package validation checks only selected identity fields. Initial source IDs are used as path components without local sanitization.
note: 05 Findings/D618 Migration resume does not bind all original preparation inputs.md

title: Publication recovery trusts more path data than preparation checks
body: Prepare resolves target under root, but recovery checks lexical target path and reads after_image from manifest without resolved transaction containment or link-ancestor checks. Journal schema/denominator are not fully validated, committed state is skipped, and per-file replace has no shared lock/fsync or before-image rollback.
note: 05 Findings/D619 Publication recovery trusts more path data than preparation checks.md

title: Eligibility refresh updates declaration consistency not admission proof
body: Eligibility derives active/admitted index labels, changes package isolation flags, rebuilds index and packaging and commits after-images. It does not authenticate lifecycle receipts or execute package validation. Recovery of prior transactions runs before new update construction.
note: 05 Findings/D620 Eligibility refresh updates declaration consistency not admission proof.md

title: Migration maintenance modes can rewrite broad source outside lifecycle owner
body: rewrite_operational_paths replaces every matching string across runtime/tests/scripts and selected registries without transaction or semantic parsing, then rewrites packaging. CLI flags are precedence-selected rather than mutually exclusive. Backup sealing writes inventories/manifest before final verification.
note: 05 Findings/D621 Migration maintenance modes can rewrite broad source outside lifecycle owner.md

title: Packaging render discards content following generated start
body: render takes prefix before first START and appends a freshly generated section, never retaining suffix after END. Unrelated TOML sections after block can be lost while parsed output remains valid. Duplicate tests cover repeated generated keys but not retained suffix.
note: 05 Findings/D622 Packaging render discards content following generated start.md

title: Packaging path emission relies on trusted filenames and overlays
body: File values and destinations are quoted by interpolation without TOML escaping. Logical overlay names are unvalidated; external staged paths can fail root-relative sorting. Canonical native root symlinks rejected, but facade directories lack same root check. No bounded enumeration or hash attestation is performed by renderer.
note: 05 Findings/D623 Packaging path emission relies on trusted filenames and overlays.md

title: Lifecycle reconciliation writes before final denominator checks
body: Specialty state map collapses duplicate IDs and accepts arbitrary state strings. Script writes specialty/packages/ledgers before discovering some missing records, and writes catalog before checking every specialty matched. It does not update through signed SkillStudio lifecycle transaction.
note: 05 Findings/D624 Lifecycle reconciliation writes before final denominator checks.md

title: Commissioned skill reconciliation can miss non-row drift
body: Changed detection uses first matching current row and stale ID set; duplicate identical rows or top-level metadata drift can leave check valid. Apply directly rewrites complete expected file only when row delta exists and returns true without reread.
note: 05 Findings/D625 Commissioned skill reconciliation can miss non-row drift.md

title: Skill packaging tests partly reuse implementation corpus
body: Expected file coverage calls generator._owned_files, sharing its exclusions. The test loop named facades iterates .px/skills, not .agents/skills. Manifest projection counts are checked, but no artifact build/install occurs in this test file.
note: 05 Findings/D626 Skill packaging tests partly reuse implementation corpus.md

title: Native and migration tests cover selected successful recovery boundaries
body: Tests prove fixture backup bytes/CRLF/order, query caps and domain denial; migration resumes after journaled relocation and detects first-snapshot drift. Pre-journal, partial-prepare, empty-denominator/destination, path trust and post-END data-loss cases remain untested here.
note: 05 Findings/D627 Native and migration tests cover selected successful recovery boundaries.md

title: Skill library vocabulary tests are documentation coverage
body: Library tests require provenance/clean-room/freshness labels, hashes and specific words in references. These are packaging/documentation invariants, not demonstrations of the named runtime mechanism or independent provenance verification.
note: 05 Findings/D628 Skill library vocabulary tests are documentation coverage.md

title: Native helper tests do not prove all capability execution
body: Support tests exercise ledger/report fixtures, owner/test path checks and a selected declared-suite outcome count. The separately reviewed helper implementations define actual scope; current execution and all-procedure behavior are not claimed.
note: 05 Findings/D629 Native helper tests do not prove all capability execution.md

title: Isolation pre-move resume skips a fresh snapshot check
body: Comparison occurs in snapshots-and-backup-verified. Resuming pre-move-verified can move changed source before destination hash detects mismatch.
note: 05 Findings/D630 Isolation pre-move resume skips a fresh snapshot check.md

title: Isolation move and phase record are separate effects
body: Move precedes source-relocated journal write. Interruption leaves destination present with earlier state and blocks ordinary retry. Initial backup copies also precede main journal.
note: 05 Findings/D631 Isolation move and phase record are separate effects.md

title: Manifest mutation precedes journaled custody pointer
body: Helper saves bytes and clears installer metadata before caller stores returned receipt. Restart may return already-empty without original restoration pointer.
note: 05 Findings/D632 Manifest mutation precedes journaled custody pointer.md

title: Unknown pending isolation state can return valid
body: Selected pending states handled explicitly, then function returns reconciled valid without requiring committed terminal state. Blocked/unknown state can fall through.
note: 05 Findings/D633 Unknown pending isolation state can return valid.md

title: Isolation invocation paths are not fully bound on resume
body: Existing journal not compared with new live/relocation arguments. Disjoint check covers live versus relocation only; backup manifest paths trusted beyond byte hashes.
note: 05 Findings/D634 Isolation invocation paths are not fully bound on resume.md

title: Empty committed live tree may hide installer reappearance
body: Already-committed empty source can return without clearing newly populated installer metadata. Tree emptiness and discoverability are separate state.
note: 05 Findings/D635 Empty committed live tree may hide installer reappearance.md

title: Restore has no prepared transaction or isolation lock
body: Restore moves original before manifest and final journal update. Failure after move leaves committed journal pointing at absent destination. Pending reconciliation not checked.
note: 05 Findings/D636 Restore has no prepared transaction or isolation lock.md

title: Restored manifest and tree can belong to different generations
body: First original tree is restored with most recent isolated manifest. Empty current skills check permits overwriting other new metadata. Historical trees remain separate.
note: 05 Findings/D637 Restored manifest and tree can belong to different generations.md

title: Isolation test proves recorded recovery seam only
body: Fixture stops after journaled relocation. Effect-before-journal windows, unknown pending states, changed paths, concurrent and multiple-generation restore remain untested here.
note: 05 Findings/D638 Isolation test proves recorded recovery seam only.md

title: Campaign validation is structural and self-hashed
body: Exact stages/prefix and identity self-hash checked, without full provenance field typing/authentication. isinstance(int) accepts bool apply_count. Pre-identity failure marker is caller assertion.
note: 05 Findings/D639 Campaign validation is structural and self-hashed.md

title: Fresh campaign status has limited state and input scope
body: Source verification defaults false and only runs for active/certified, not failed. Selected product/harness digests and repair ID do not cover phase/intake or all provenance.
note: 05 Findings/D640 Fresh campaign status has limited state and input scope.md

title: Campaign claim concurrency depends on external owner
body: Read-check-write has no local lock/CAS. Claims lack process/expiry. CLI has orchestration boundary; direct concurrent helpers can overwrite claims.
note: 05 Findings/D641 Campaign claim concurrency depends on external owner.md

title: Finish does not repeat all claim conditions
body: Matching claim and source check do not require unchanged phase, closed intake or zero unresolved work. Intervening repair state change can escape finish checks.
note: 05 Findings/D642 Finish does not repeat all claim conditions.md

title: Certified campaign label consumes caller outcome
body: Helper uses passed truthiness without receipt reference, gate denominator or signature validation. CLI explicit finish or output.valid supplies boolean; terminal label records owner outcome.
note: 05 Findings/D643 Certified campaign label consumes caller outcome.md

title: Release archive filename trusts campaign ID
body: Nonempty ID validation permits separators while archive paths interpolate ID without resolved containment. Parent creation/write is not a containment boundary.
note: 05 Findings/D644 Release archive filename trusts campaign ID.md

title: Archive and successor pointer split on interruption
body: Exclusive archive write/fsync precedes successor pointer replacement. Interruption leaves old pointer and archive collision on retry, without a multi-file recovery journal.
note: 05 Findings/D645 Archive and successor pointer split on interruption.md

title: Release recovery paths preserve different history
body: Clear for different repair/campaign can replace state without supersession archive. Successor attempts increment under eligibility rules without universal one-attempt ceiling; repair phase rewinds separately.
note: 05 Findings/D646 Release recovery paths preserve different history.md

title: Release package and install branches are audits of existing artifacts
body: package_audit records artifact_rebuilt False; install_audit records install_command_executed False. Stage pass advances campaign based on observed retained bytes, not building/installing current source.
note: 05 Findings/D647 Release package and install branches are audits of existing artifacts.md

title: Artifact and source identity are co-recorded without build derivation
body: VSIX audit binds configured bytes/count/CRC and attaches current kernel digests. It does not reproduce build or compare artifact content with all current source. Existing annotated Git tag is moved locally, not remotely published here.
note: 05 Findings/D648 Artifact and source identity are co-recorded without build derivation.md

title: Owner input containment does not cover interpolated IDs and external roots
body: inside checks nominal/resolved project path ancestors, but candidate/predecessor strings lack safe-component validation and later form receipt/log filenames. Installed directory/code command resolve outside root without the same reparse checks; numeric values coerce via int.
note: 05 Findings/D649 Owner input containment does not cover interpolated IDs and external roots.md

title: Owner running marker creates a durable no-retry boundary before effects
body: Marker is written before dispatch; general failures do not always replace it with failed receipt. Fresh-output checks reject rerun. Stage finish, phase advance and final receipt order differ by branch and can split on interruption.
note: 05 Findings/D650 Owner running marker creates a durable no-retry boundary before effects.md

title: Git identity transition has multiple independently persisted intermediate states
body: Index add precedes exact cached-set validation, commit precedes post-dirty check, and retag precedes identity apply/receipt. Failures can leave staged changes, new commit or moved tag without completed owner receipt.
note: 05 Findings/D651 Git identity transition has multiple independently persisted intermediate states.md

title: Installed audit requires one changed but equivalent package JSON
body: Byte-identical package.json increments identical rather than normalized; valid requires normalized == 1. A fully byte-identical install can fail. Only observed __metadata is removed for normalized equality.
note: 05 Findings/D652 Installed audit requires one changed but equivalent package JSON.md

title: Archive and tree audits are not fully bounded snapshots
body: CRC and archive.read process full uncompressed data without expansion budget; installed files read whole. install entries collapse duplicate names; install audit lacks final artifact hash recapture. Tree walk omits onerror and uses path checks then later reads.
note: 05 Findings/D653 Archive and tree audits are not fully bounded snapshots.md

title: Stage process closure is strongest on handled timeout only
body: command attempts taskkill/process-group termination on TimeoutExpired; ordinary exit does not independently prove descendants exited, and other exceptions/cancellation lack matching finally closure. Nested processes and temporary VS Code profile are not registered here.
note: 05 Findings/D654 Stage process closure is strongest on handled timeout only.md

title: Owner receipt verification is selective rather than semantic replay
body: Verifier checks state, schema, candidate, selected claim/identity/artifact fields and registered resource status. It does not rerun full audit or validate all receipt counts/log hashes. Hardcoded resource zero fields do not enumerate unregistered effects.
note: 05 Findings/D655 Owner receipt verification is selective rather than semantic replay.md

title: Default stage-owner plan returns unsuccessful CLI exit status
body: plan returns effects False but no valid field; main returns zero only when output.get(valid) is truthy. Default plan therefore prints plan and exits 1. Tests call plan directly, not default CLI exit.
note: 05 Findings/D656 Default stage-owner plan returns unsuccessful CLI exit status.md

title: Owner tests often replace actual operational effects
body: FakeEffects verifier is no-op across stage-selection tests. Git, source classifier, supersession, process and extension listing are mocked for selected seams. No real full package/install or interrupted multi-file campaign is proven by these cases.
note: 05 Findings/D657 Owner tests often replace actual operational effects.md

title: Effect inventory resolves spellings rather than all effects
body: Literal dotted process/network names and mutation leaves omit import aliases, dynamic dispatch, open-write modes, other languages and native effects. Some method-name matches may be unrelated operations. IDs encode locator, not argument semantics.
note: 05 Findings/D658 Effect inventory resolves spellings rather than all effects.md

title: Popen timeout association ignores control flow and nearest scope
body: AST walk chooses first containing function, potentially outer; any matching handle wait/communicate with timeout keyword can satisfy association even unreachable or unrelated after reassignment. timeout None is nonempty syntax, not bounded execution.
note: 05 Findings/D659 Popen timeout association ignores control flow and nearest scope.md

title: Effect validator accepts expressions it does not evaluate
body: Rejects shell only when unparsed expression equals True; variables/truthy alternatives can pass. Timeout only requires non-None metadata, not positive finite value. Network timeout and actual process closure are not checked.
note: 05 Findings/D660 Effect validator accepts expressions it does not evaluate.md

title: Policy ownership fields are declarations without enforcement evidence
body: Discovery stamps approval and containment text. Validation checks policy file existence and filename-based destructive exceptions, not receipts, actual retained backup, admission or resolved effect target. Special process owners receive timeout labels without local control-flow proof.
note: 05 Findings/D661 Policy ownership fields are declarations without enforcement evidence.md

title: Effect tests share discovery denominator with generated expected registry
body: Fixture expected records are produced by discovery itself. Tests cover selected literal unsafe calls/pruning; no alias, expression, nested scope or enforcement receipt cases. Locator hash test hashes a constant without invoking discovery.
note: 05 Findings/D662 Effect tests share discovery denominator with generated expected registry.md

title: Driver journal does not bind resumed configuration
body: Journal checks schema/candidate only, not full config/owner argv/timeouts/artifact/control roots. Resumed readiness drops initial hygiene/predecessor checks; supplied current config can change remaining execution under same candidate.
note: 05 Findings/D663 Driver journal does not bind resumed configuration.md

title: Driver owner command authority is largely configuration supplied
body: Every stage requires one nonempty argv, but only four card-reconcile commands have exact tails. Python check is filename substring. Other owners are not matched to canonical module, executable hash or declared effect inventory.
note: 05 Findings/D664 Driver owner command authority is largely configuration supplied.md

title: Admission IDs are recorded without local scope guard before execution
body: execute-next requires nonempty IDs in main, then records them; execute-all appends admissions. Neither driver nor stage owner invokes guard-work before scoped effects. Run/lane IDs propagated to child are not admission/checkpoint IDs.
note: 05 Findings/D665 Admission IDs are recorded without local scope guard before execution.md

title: Candidate work sessions describe read write execute only
body: Per-stage admission generates those three effects and authority text from candidate config. Network/install/service/destructive effects in arbitrary configured commands receive no separate admission from this helper. Caller/owner enforcement remains necessary.
note: 05 Findings/D666 Candidate work sessions describe read write execute only.md

title: Candidate journal is replace-written without concurrency control
body: Journal start/finish overwrite full JSON without lock/CAS/hash chain. Next-step ignores unknown extra keys and does not validate all attempt/evidence fields. Running/failed state intentionally blocks replay but does not reconcile effects interrupted before terminal publication.
note: 05 Findings/D667 Candidate journal is replace-written without concurrency control.md

title: Resumed aggregate report does not count earlier successful invocations
body: execute_all starts empty stages and final valid requires len(stages)==12, despite running only remaining steps. Successful partial resume or already-complete campaign returns invalid aggregate. Admission failure branch reports completed_stage_count zero even after prior loop successes.
note: 05 Findings/D668 Resumed aggregate report does not count earlier successful invocations.md

title: Candidate settlement and report are not protected by final cleanup
body: next_pending_step and governance.settle can raise outside per-owner catch. BaseException cancellation bypasses ordinary Exception handlers; session/process or terminal journal/report may remain unsettled. Closure precedes checkpoint, so checkpoint failure can leave a closed session without report progress.
note: 05 Findings/D669 Candidate settlement and report are not protected by final cleanup.md

title: Candidate checkpoint drops older unresolved branch carry-forward
body: settle computes unresolved branches only from newly discovered cards since previous checkpoint; prior unresolved list is not merged. Its append-only journal claim describes a file replaced at each update, not immutable event storage.
note: 05 Findings/D670 Candidate checkpoint drops older unresolved branch carry-forward.md

title: Candidate resource completion checks counters but not valid flag
body: After complete_process, four counters must equal zero; resource_status.valid is not required. Lifecycle proof field is set true after selected checks. Non-timeout exceptions/cancellation lack unconditional terminate/reconcile; late command can spawn before remaining deadline becomes zero.
note: 05 Findings/D671 Candidate resource completion checks counters but not valid flag.md

title: Installed smoke and lifecycle evidence bodies are not interpreted
body: Exact member set and selected success fields are checked; referenced smoke/lifecycle files are hash-checked only. Fixture accepts arbitrary ok/closed JSON. No semantic smoke schema, embedded artifact identity or lifecycle closure replay is required here.
note: 05 Findings/D672 Installed smoke and lifecycle evidence bodies are not interpreted.md

title: Installed summary cross-binding is selective and unsigned
body: Package/install receipt fields and exhaustive report/count agreement are stronger than labels alone, but live kernel self-hash/source freshness, receipt signatures and finished-time recency are not checked. Exhaustive receipt path need not equal configured installed_exhaustive_receipt.

title: Derived exhaustive error counts use recursive normalized key search
body: Any matching key at any depth contributes length or int-coerced value; conflicts fail but schema/location/type meaning not established. Booleans/numeric strings can be accepted. Full recursive JSON traversal has no local depth/size limit.

title: Postcondition replay observes selected state rather than every original receipt
body: Phase-at-least permits later states for earlier owners. Archive cleared branch allows empty all-pending denominator; some stage checks omit campaign/identity validation. Preflight accepts claimed certify without independently checking preflight report; finalize observes certified state rather than signature validation.
note: 05 Findings/D675 Postcondition replay observes selected state rather than every original receipt.md

title: Driver test success isolates many real proof producers
body: Fake owners/governance and automatic hygiene patch prove orchestration shape. Synthetic installed proof uses minimal smoke/lifecycle JSON. Tests do not establish actual multi-host execution, resumed aggregate correctness or guard-work enforcement.
note: 05 Findings/D676 Driver test success isolates many real proof producers.md

title: Corrective closed status requires only receipt existence
body: Contained receipt path must be a file, but content, validity, signature, source freshness and relation to card/command are not inspected. Same minimal receipt can close every card, as test explicitly demonstrates.
note: 05 Findings/D677 Corrective closed status requires only receipt existence.md

title: Corrective dependency and child validation has no order or cycle proof
body: Known IDs required, but self/cyclic dependency/parent relationships and unresolved prerequisites are not rejected. Fixed source IDs establish historical denominator; arbitrary additional child IDs need only known parent.
note: 05 Findings/D678 Corrective dependency and child validation has no order or cycle proof.md

title: Corrective acceptance syntax checks do not prove runnable target behavior
body: Pytest form may have no target and checks only tokens beginning tests; selector existence/other paths/options not validated. Python script form checks file existence without resolved root containment. CLI allowlist is fixed including historical version strings.

title: Corrective malformed records can escape structured error output
body: Top-level nonobject reaches .get; nonobject card is recorded as error but final blocking_open still calls .get on every card. Unhashable dependency/status/priority shapes can also raise. Strict finalizer exception may return valid while blocking_open remains nonzero.
note: 05 Findings/D680 Corrective malformed records can escape structured error output.md

title: Hygiene targets are named custody rather than authenticated ownership

title: Diagnostic visual limits can differ from displayed totals
body: Readiness bar uses a finite clamped zero-to-five value while label retains supplied score/maximum. Trace list is sliced to twelve but metric counts all constructed traces. Maturity and ceiling are supplied assessments, not recomputed guarantees.
note: 05 Findings/D774 Diagnostic visual limits can differ from displayed totals.md

title: Settings rendering does not connect or bill
body: Configuration boundary table and master/model controls describe supplied configuration. Render-time availability does not establish backend connectivity or trigger provider work; handlers own later effects.
note: 05 Findings/D775 Settings rendering does not connect or bill.md

title: Memory readiness and displayed records are separate conditions
body: Canonical query controls require retrieval_ready exactly true; portable context is separately labeled. Existing response rows are rendered from state, while controller owns detached-state clearing. Renderer does not certify integrity or reread canonical storage.
note: 05 Findings/D776 Memory readiness and displayed records are separate conditions.md

title: Activity classification trusts producer liveness and vocabulary
body: Renderer deduplicates stale correlations and excludes seven terminal status strings from active rows, but timed_out is absent. It does not recompute agent heartbeat age. Missing capture policy can produce an ACTIVE presentation; supplied integrity flags determine badges.
note: 05 Findings/D777 Activity classification trusts producer liveness and vocabulary.md

title: Learning raw state can expose action despite blocked effective state
body: Raw candidate state branches precede some effective-state gating, so a raw validated candidate may show Admit while effective state is blocked. Backend admission remains necessary. Missing available flag does not disable creation.
note: 05 Findings/D778 Learning raw state can expose action despite blocked effective state.md

title: Knowledge control presentation accepts schema presence
body: Any truthy core schema_version selects proposal controls. Raw proposal state and supplied action availability decide buttons; renderer neither validates schema version nor performs verify/approve/promote/rollback.
