If snapshot/root changes while validation runs, this local code does not compare the validated source identity with that later snapshot key. Cached result is reused without a TTL in this owner.
note: 05 Findings/D1636 Validation cache is keyed to snapshot identity at publication time.md

title: Selected host action receipts are latest in-memory observations
body: durableHostActionTypes controls storage in activeRuntime.lastHostActionRequest/Result, not a persistent journal. Only one latest request/result survives; no per-request idempotency check or history exists. Setting a terminal result before reply preserves it across later delivery failure, but extension restart loses this local memory.
note: 05 Findings/D1637 Selected host action receipts are latest in-memory observations.md

title: Graph rendered acknowledgement is client-supplied state
body: The graphRendered branch directly replaces activeRuntime.dashboardGraph with supplied request ID, view and counts after general message validation. It does not correlate to current delivered graph request/result or verify actual DOM itself. Query-delivered status and client-rendered acknowledgement are different evidence sources.
note: 05 Findings/D1638 Graph rendered acknowledgement is client-supplied state.md

title: Canonical memory setup can be partially applied before cancellation
body: Workspace initialization and discovery can write before project-name/selection dialogs; project creation/activation and workspace config update are separate effects. Later cancellation or memory/refresh failure does not compensate earlier writes. Detach clears workspace configuration but does not itself show an explicit lease-release call in this branch; lease controller handles subsequent state.
note: 05 Findings/D1639 Canonical memory setup can be partially applied before cancellation.md

title: Enterprise policy toggle has two separate persistence effects
body: The toggle updates VS Code workspace billable.enabled, then writes enterprise execution policy. Configuration change listener can also write policy. Failure after configuration update leaves the earlier effect in place; a returned operation error is not evidence of rollback.
note: 05 Findings/D1640 Enterprise policy toggle has two separate persistence effects.md

title: Owned-harness flags select multiple approval shortcuts
body: Two PX_OWNED flags switch confirmations from modal, choose fixture paths, bypass selected Studio/memory/toggle approvals and write exports into fixture paths. Studio setup optionally requires a physical marker when exercising approval. These test-only routes are controlled by inherited environment; they are not independent user-presence proof.
note: 05 Findings/D1641 Owned-harness flags select multiple approval shortcuts.md

title: Environment lifecycle uses typed-target UI approval rather than another host prompt
body: Unlike native extension install/update/uninstall/rollback branches, environment execute and restore directly pass approved=true with exactTarget from the message to their manager. The dashboard owns typed target/acknowledgement interaction, while manager owns token/identity checks. These are distinct approval boundaries.
note: 05 Findings/D1642 Environment lifecycle uses typed-target UI approval rather than another host prompt.md

title: Lifecycle refresh can hide a completed manager receipt
body: Native install/update/uninstall/rollback and environment move/restore await refreshEnvironment after action but before posting result. If discovery/publication fails, outer operationError follows the completed effect and the manager receipt may not reach that webview. Recovery should inspect authoritative manager state rather than infer no effect from reply error.
note: 05 Findings/D1643 Lifecycle refresh can hide a completed manager receipt.md

title: Enablement observation explicitly records temporal association only
body: A single pending handoff with five-minute expiry is consumed by next extension-change event, then refreshed only if a view is visible. The emitted receipt says temporal-pending-handoff-only, enablement_observed=null and activation_is_not_enablement=true. Multiple concurrent handoffs overwrite this single slot; arbitrary extension change can consume it.
note: 05 Findings/D1644 Enablement observation explicitly records temporal association only.md

title: Studio create origin trust has explicit bounds and detach semantics
body: Active create map rejects duplicate kind/request and more than 64 operations. Host-origin proof ownership, initial physical absence, source reauthentication and postcommit warning handling are delegated explicitly. Closing panel disposes origin trust and marks create operations detached; it does not cancel already committed or running work.
note: 05 Findings/D1645 Studio create origin trust has explicit bounds and detach semantics.md

title: Editor source token can be consumed before a later failed recheck
body: Skill next-version consumes source-selection token, then verifies requested identity/version, rereads package, checks hashes/provenance and asks backend for allocation. A mismatch/read/backend failure can consume the token without producing allocation, requiring new selection. Catalog lookups are limited to first 100 matching results and require exact uniqueness.
note: 05 Findings/D1646 Editor source token can be consumed before a later failed recheck.md

title: Dashboard readiness is distinct from successful rendered snapshot
body: ready resolves panel readiness before awaiting initial snapshot publication. openDashboard waits at most fifteen seconds, then forces snapshot/deep link. Timeout throws without disposing panel here; later callers can await same ready promise. Panel disposal releases origin and detaches creates, while other asynchronous handlers may continue and encounter delivery errors.
note: 05 Findings/D1647 Dashboard readiness is distinct from successful rendered snapshot.md

title: Activation transaction cannot own values before argument evaluation finishes
body: Output channel/publisher/catalog are created before their first transaction.own call. Multiple registrations are passed as function arguments to one own call; if a later argument throws, earlier-created disposables from that expression may not yet be registered with transaction. Explicit rollback helps only resources already enrolled.
note: 05 Findings/D1648 Activation transaction cannot own values before argument evaluation finishes.md

title: Startup zero-effect counters are declarations rather than measurements
body: startup records elapsed activation time but subprocesses_started=0, discovery_started=false and project_writes=0 are hardcoded. Canonical memory lease start and listener/provider registration precede this assignment; imported owners determine actual deferred behavior. These constants are not independently observed effect counts.
note: 05 Findings/D1649 Startup zero-effect counters are declarations rather than measurements.md

title: Deactivation clears some state but leaves other module globals
body: Lifecycle dispose clears selected timers/listeners/bridge/publisher; deactivate clears runtime/environment/lifecycle fields. It does not clear currentSnapshot, currentContextEnvelope, panel, dashboard view cache or activeHostRuns in this function. VS Code subscription disposal and process exit may close them elsewhere; same-module reactivation should not assume all state reset.
note: 05 Findings/D1650 Deactivation clears some state but leaves other module globals.md

title: MCP definition creation is distinct from a verified server invocation
body: Providing definitions signs a new project/session authority and creates public JWK file only if absent. Existing path contents/link identity are not checked here before reuse. Server is launched by VS Code from generated bundle with explicit identity/env and cwd; registration remains registered_unverified until invocation evidence exists.
note: 05 Findings/D1651 MCP definition creation is distinct from a verified server invocation.md

title: Configuration fault once markers differ from host-action markers
body: Configuration fault injection only checks marker existence and does not consume it, so a .once filename can repeatedly fail until external removal. Host-action fault injection checks plain-file JSON schema/operation/effect, unlinks then throws. Both routes are gated by owned-host flags but implement different failure lifetimes.
note: 05 Findings/D1652 Configuration fault once markers differ from host-action markers.md

title: Working draft recovery is exact-bound local state, not authority
body: The dashboard stores editable overlay and a source binding, then reloads the exact catalog predecessor and host allocation before reopening. Persisted local view state takes precedence when nonempty; a source/candidate mismatch preserves the overlay rather than applying it. Canonical JSON buffer is sliced to 524288 characters, not bytes.
note: 05 Findings/D1653 Working draft recovery is exact-bound local state, not authority.md

title: Editor presentation retries measure presence rather than complete visibility
body: Accepted editor presentation carries identity/version token and is checked by microtask, animation frame and 100/500ms timers. Matching DOM controls and baseline are inspected, not a rendered screenshot. Timers are guarded by presentation identity rather than cancelled as a group.
note: 05 Findings/D1654 Editor presentation retries measure presence rather than complete visibility.md

title: Save detachment preserves host commit ownership
body: Close while a save is active records a detached request and sends detach rather than release of proof owned by the host commit. Matching detached result refreshes catalog and history but does not clear or replace the current editor. The detached request set is bounded to 64, so very late results can become unmatched.
note: 05 Findings/D1655 Save detachment preserves host commit ownership.md

title: Some rejected editor replies remain pending without a timeout
body: Agent/workflow editor replies require exact request, catalog record, identity, version, revision/content hash and allocation proof. A matching but malformed reply releases incoming proof and leaves the original request pending. No timeout clears this local pending request; explicit closure or later result is needed.
note: 05 Findings/D1656 Some rejected editor replies remain pending without a timeout.md

title: Information modal metadata changes before replacement is accepted
body: showInformationModal assigns shared title/record/copy fields before showModal checks whether a live Studio editor may be replaced. A refused replacement can therefore update shared metadata while leaving prior DOM present. Separately, operationalCardResult and operationalInventoryResult explicitly closeModal before showing uncorrelated details, which can detach a newer in-flight save.
note: 05 Findings/D1657 Information modal metadata changes before replacement is accepted.md

title: Workflow approval can be attached to a different current session
body: The pending approval records workflow ID/version, but response matching compares only requestId, nodeId and nonempty approval_id. Later code assigns to any current workflow studioSession. An unchanged listener in a VM accepts approval for workflow A and writes it into current workflow B. This is transient UI contamination; backend approval capabilities remain separately authoritative.
note: 05 Findings/D1658 Workflow approval can be attached to a different current session.md

title: Studio lifecycle result matching is uneven across operations
body: Run queries match request/kind/operation and expected run ID; skill lifecycle matches subject/version; preview binds exact subject/version and effects_executed=false. Generic agent test/admit/register-authority and start/run result paths do not have the same pending request matching. They can update history/catalog/modal after current session changes.
note: 05 Findings/D1659 Studio lifecycle result matching is uneven across operations.md

title: Generic lifecycle success accepts an empty object
body: Operation-specific checks explicitly require passed/admitted/eligible/run identity for many operations. The fallback merely rejects failure words in status/state/decision, so an empty object for recover is accepted. VM probe confirms this; it does not establish recovery or durable outcome correctness.
note: 05 Findings/D1660 Generic lifecycle success accepts an empty object.md

title: Workflow trace remains an identity projection
body: The browser trace uses workflow/version/run identity, with a hash optional unless both compared records provide one. Node receipts are placed by node ID, so the final duplicate replaces earlier entries. Missing receipt list can clear node state. This projection does not validate event chains/signatures.
note: 05 Findings/D1661 Workflow trace remains an identity projection.md

title: Workflow zero positions and edge positions disagree
body: Node layout preserves zero using nullish fallback, while drawWorkflowCanvasEdges uses position.x || 40 and position.y || 40. An inert DOM probe produces source endpoint M 218 76 for a node at 0,0 instead of 178,36. The source discrepancy affects visual connection alignment.
note: 05 Findings/D1662 Workflow zero positions and edge positions disagree.md

title: Layout rule cap is per call rather than global retained ownership
body: Constructable stylesheet applies fixed numeric clamped attributes, reducing CSS injection through those attributes. However its 2048 limit counts this apply invocation; retained rules for still-connected elements can exceed that across partial calls. querySelectorAll materializes candidates before the cap is applied.
note: 05 Findings/D1663 Layout rule cap is per call rather than global retained ownership.md

title: Graph virtualization hides eagerly created nodes
body: materializeGraphGeometry creates all node foreignObjects and minimap dots before frame processing. Virtualization chunks 280 frames and 420 edges per animation frame but does not defer DOM allocation. The selected node is forced visible even outside the viewport; an edge crossing the viewport can be hidden if both endpoint frames are hidden.
note: 05 Findings/D1664 Graph virtualization hides eagerly created nodes.md

title: Graph rendered acknowledgement does not prove paint completion
body: reportGraphRender counts DOM elements and calculates node rectangles from model positions. Visible count prefers non-virtualized frames, including forced selected frames. The 250ms fallback prepares geometry and reports without awaiting frame chunks; a suspended renderer can therefore report before virtualization finishes. Host stores supplied counts as rendered without independent request correlation.
note: 05 Findings/D1665 Graph rendered acknowledgement does not prove paint completion.md

title: Full graph pagination has no aggregate termination guard
body: Each request has 12-second timeout and max page sizes, but load-all repeats while backend has_more is true. No maximum total pages, aggregate deadline, repeated-cursor rejection or accumulated-node cap is enforced here. Merge matches only full mode and view, not snapshot hash or full filter identity.
note: 05 Findings/D1666 Full graph pagination has no aggregate termination guard.md

title: Late graph success is accepted after local timeout
body: The 12-second timeout clears graphPending and renders an error but retains graphRequestId. A later result with that same ID passes the response guard, clears the error and replaces data. Timeout is therefore a display deadline, not cancellation or terminal rejection.
note: 05 Findings/D1667 Late graph success is accepted after local timeout.md

title: Knowledge browse can overwrite a newer browser view
body: requestKnowledge and learning operations share kind knowledge without request tracking. Any knowledge browse response replaces knowledgeData; an unchanged listener VM accepts an obsolete request result. Environment subject results and several detail modals likewise lack exact request-generation checks, unlike catalog/memory/activity queries.
note: 05 Findings/D1668 Knowledge browse can overwrite a newer browser view.md

title: Snapshot updates do not invalidate all subject caches
body: Snapshot clears memory only when canonical retrieval_ready becomes false. Settings/coordination may be retained if absent and environment/catalog/knowledge projections are not invalidated by a snapshot root/revision identifier here. A new snapshot can coexist with older lazily loaded details.
note: 05 Findings/D1669 Snapshot updates do not invalidate all subject caches.md

title: Pending host actions are bounded memory with latest snapshot replay
body: Browser retains at most 64 pending host actions and matches direct reply operation/request. Snapshot can replay latest host request/result into globals and clear a matching pending item. These globals and host fields are memory, not a persistent complete action journal; no per-action timeout exists here.
note: 05 Findings/D1670 Pending host actions are bounded memory with latest snapshot replay.md

title: A global search debounce crosses independent surfaces
body: Activity, memory query/project/source and catalog search share one searchTimer. Typing on another surface before 250ms cancels the earlier scheduled query; callbacks retain the old input object. This is a single browser scheduling lane, not independent surface work.
note: 05 Findings/D1671 A global search debounce crosses independent surfaces.md

title: UI readiness and metric labels have limited evidence domains
body: readinessLiveBlockers checks source identity, MCP runtime verification, invalid available map, runtime failures and stale environment; unavailable environment is not itself a blocker there. Coordination summary counts claims array and board selects first task claim without filtering active lifecycle. Unknown Git uses its local fallback presentation; these values are not certification.
note: 05 Findings/D1672 UI readiness and metric labels have limited evidence domains.md

title: Browser authority declarations require downstream admission
body: Workflow new bindings/grants are initialized with state admitted and human-approval reference strings; agent additions use candidate. These are editable payload declarations. Register-authority/admission/backend checks remain distinct from setting those JSON fields.
note: 05 Findings/D1673 Browser authority declarations require downstream admission.md

title: Candidate JSON changes need explicit application
body: Typing canonical JSON marks draft dirty and saves a buffer, but studioEditorPayload uses structured draft while kind matches. Only studioApplyJson parses, normalizes and applies the text; predecessor-bound identity/version change is rejected. Save can therefore use the last applied structured definition, not newly typed raw text.
note: 05 Findings/D1674 Candidate JSON changes need explicit application.md

title: Workflow local graph edits use closed typed semantics
body: Connection checks require existing exact ports, equal data type, no self edge, duplicate, second input driver or cycle. Supported task adapters are explicit deterministic operations, not arbitrary agent execution. Retyping a node clears all incident edges; removing a binding leaves references for later validation rather than silently rebinding them.
note: 05 Findings/D1675 Workflow local graph edits use closed typed semantics.md

title: Human workflow sequence may be a synthesized presentation
body: When declared steps are absent workflowHuman synthesizes a sequential display from the skill list. ImportCatalogDefinition creates an independent basic workflow and preserves original source_definition/source_import; it does not compile all original workflow semantics. Explicit admission and operation remain separate.
note: 05 Findings/D1676 Human workflow sequence may be a synthesized presentation.md

title: Legacy agent topology is separate from the active graph renderer
body: upgradeLegacyAgentTopology and drawLegacyAgentTopologyEdges remain defined, but the modern upgradeAgentTopology route uses typed builder graph. Legacy edge selector expects data-agent-section while legacy created nodes use data-legacy-agent-section. The mismatch is a dormant helper boundary, not evidence that modern graph edges fail.
note: 05 Findings/D1677 Legacy agent topology is separate from the active graph renderer.md

title: Agent model selection and local graph status can diverge from final authority
body: Model provider change resets model_id/version to auto, while host execution requires an exact model. updateAgentValidationBox always replaces persisted-verified with working/Python-compile-required, even after validation-only updates. These labels describe browser state; final model route and compiled graph are backend-owned.
note: 05 Findings/D1678 Agent model selection and local graph status can diverge from final authority.md

title: Studio error and cancellation re-enable save without rerunning all local checks
body: studioDraftCancelled and createStudioDraft error set save.disabled=false directly. During an in-flight save other editor input handlers can also recompute availability. The browser button is not an exactly-once commit gate; submit revalidates and host create coordinator owns immutable occupancy and trust.
note: 05 Findings/D1679 Studio error and cancellation re-enable save without rerunning all local checks.md

title: Knowledge proposals distinguish cached canonical update from new candidate
body: Single cached matching canonical head supplies supersedes_sha256 and duplicate or malformed heads block. No cached match produces a proposal without predecessor. Current canonical verification must therefore occur downstream when the browse cache is partial or stale. The UI-provided bare source hash is evidence input, not proof of a new claim.
note: 05 Findings/D1680 Knowledge proposals distinguish cached canonical update from new candidate.md

title: Learning forms record evidence assertions rather than independently running trials
body: Observation captures outcome/metric/environment/evidence; pattern and hypothesis freeze declarations; trial records selected winner; research includes independent flags; final validation/reuse are explicit host requests. UI labels explain separate verify/approve/promote and non-destructive decay. Backend sources, confidence and dependency gates determine whether claims are accepted.
note: 05 Findings/D1681 Learning forms record evidence assertions rather than independently running trials.md

title: Native lifecycle handoff has differentiated result claims
body: Install/update/uninstall/rollback preview and response generally match exact pending request/action and token/target; enablement explicitly reports temporal observation rather than proof. Conflict resolution routes into a new separate governed install/uninstall/enablement preview. Conflict preview renderer does not test allowed here, so manager token authority remains essential.
note: 05 Findings/D1682 Native lifecycle handoff has differentiated result claims.md

title: Environment action UI is exact-target gated but response identity is weaker
body: showModal clears typed environment target and execute checks exact text plus consumer acknowledgement. Environment preview/result/restore messages have no pending request correlation; result-type captions assert moved/restored without checking status fields locally. Host manager remains authoritative. This audit reads those paths and performs no quarantine, restore or deletion.
note: 05 Findings/D1683 Environment action UI is exact-target gated but response identity is weaker.md

title: Coordination forms and release have different request evidence
body: Plan parses pipe-separated declarations and sends numeric budgets; claim/progress/reconcile use host validation. Release uniquely requires a reason of ten characters, explicit checkbox, request ID and task-bound returned authorization. Other coordination results set complete without operation-specific matching here. Portable memory remains proposed/non-canonical.
note: 05 Findings/D1684 Coordination forms and release have different request evidence.md

title: Deep links can use positional subtask fallback
body: The resolver first tries exact task/subtask identity, then extracts digits from a dotted suffix and indexes a parent subtask list. A stale or noncanonical identifier can therefore display a positional sibling. The record is a read-only snapshot projection, not task identity authorization.
note: 05 Findings/D1685 Deep links can use positional subtask fallback.md

title: Keyboard and frame liveness preserve partial rather than full visual guarantees
body: Graph focus trap filters visible elements; modal focus trap does not. Graph arrow focus walks all graph-node DOM entries, including virtualized frames. Shared render defers while any modal exists, and ready posts immediately after render rather than after data, geometry or paint completion.
note: 05 Findings/D1686 Keyboard and frame liveness preserve partial rather than full visual guarantees.md

title: Full walk completion trusts the complete-chain aggregate
body: evaluateOperationalWalk checks control count/attempts and accepts complete_interaction_chains plus recovered boundaries at least equal to denominator. It does not recompute complete stages, inspect ordinary control errors, require rendered/visible, enforce unique IDs or cap inflated complete counts. Pure probe returns completed for one attempted control with empty stages and errors when aggregate says one complete.
note: 05 Findings/D1687 Full walk completion trusts the complete-chain aggregate.md

title: Source verified is a supplied status at this evaluator boundary
body: Explicit mismatch always blocks and unknown/reported-match are distinguished. However verified is accepted from source_identity.state without checking digests, method or artifact bytes. Upstream identity producer and downstream artifact validation remain separate proof owners.
note: 05 Findings/D1688 Source verified is a supplied status at this evaluator boundary.md

title: Issue deduplication keeps the first blocking decision
body: Issue key includes source/code/context/message, but not severity or blocking. Duplicate occurrence/recovered fields merge while first blocking/severity/details remain. Probe supplies a nonblocking issue then the same blocking issue and retains nonblocking. Truncating message/context before key creation can also merge distinct long observations.
note: 05 Findings/D1689 Issue deduplication keeps the first blocking decision.md

title: Nonobject additional issues are silently discarded
body: dedupeIssues skips values that are not objects. The isolated child pushes native helper termination/exit failures as strings, so those explicit failure signals vanish. A pure evaluator probe with the actual helper failure string returns completed. Other independently classified failures may still block, but these strings cannot.
note: 05 Findings/D1690 Nonobject additional issues are silently discarded.md

title: Prior walker profile failures are lost during child recomputation
body: The walker passes profileFailures as additionalIssues into its first status evaluation and stores status_truth. The isolated child reads that receipt but calls evaluateOperationalWalk again with only normalized processIssues. The evaluator ignores prior status_truth. It accepts expected nonzero exit derived from the original status. A pure reproduction changes original incomplete with a retained profile failure to completed.
note: 05 Findings/D1691 Prior walker profile failures are lost during child recomputation.md

title: Launcher ignores contradictory child terminal status
body: evaluateLauncherTerminal copies child issues and checks owner tree/worker closure. It does not require recognized status schema, terminal completed, scope_complete or operationally_complete. A child object saying failed with an empty issue list is recomputed completed in the probe.
note: 05 Findings/D1692 Launcher ignores contradictory child terminal status.md

title: Focused completion is promoted in the nested launcher flag
body: A successful focused walk correctly returns operationally_complete=false and scope_complete=true. Launcher recomputation returns operationally_complete=true whenever no issues remain, losing that distinction. The outer report separately sets full_operational_completion_claimed=false for focused profiles, leaving conflicting nested scopes for consumers to interpret.
note: 05 Findings/D1693 Focused completion is promoted in the nested launcher flag.md

title: Host-boundary focused profile accepts no interaction stages
body: The host-boundary predicate uses Object.values(chain).every with no required key set; an empty object satisfies it. It checks record count, rendered/attempted and errors but not exact IDs/uniqueness. Probe with one rendered attempted empty-chain record returns completed. Its test positive case supplies only two stages.
note: 05 Findings/D1694 Host-boundary focused profile accepts no interaction stages.md

title: Generic focused probe counts do not prove exact control identities
body: completeOwnedProbe requires positive eligible count, equal records length and thirteen stage states, but does not require unique IDs, admitted eligible ID set, visibility or stage evidence references. Most stages may be not_applicable without a reason. Error-indicators is stronger: two exact unique IDs and nonempty evidence for every named stage.
note: 05 Findings/D1695 Generic focused probe counts do not prove exact control identities.md

title: Focused configuration and Studio lifecycle predicates omit important denominators
body: Configuration accepts any nonempty attempted error-free records without checking eligible_control_count equality. Studio lifecycle requires each kind with one or more valid operations, but no exact lifecycle operation sequence. The positive test deliberately uses only an inspect operation for each kind and still completes the scoped predicate.
note: 05 Findings/D1696 Focused configuration and Studio lifecycle predicates omit important denominators.md

title: Focused builder evidence is a selected flag contract
body: Builder scope requires interaction_complete, durability.verified, closed modal, no saved candidate/runtime execution and two attempted control IDs. It does not independently inspect malformed JSON rejection, recovery evidence, all builder controls or errors array despite its explanatory text. These are producer-trusted observations.
note: 05 Findings/D1697 Focused builder evidence is a selected flag contract.md

title: Surface capture checks labels rather than image bytes
body: Surface capture requires exactly eighteen named records, navigation_active, matching capture surface and first/deep screenshot status captured. It does not read screenshot files, inspect image hashes, timing, visibility or dimensions. The test uses status-only screenshot objects and is a predicate fixture, not rendered evidence.
note: 05 Findings/D1698 Surface capture checks labels rather than image bytes.md

title: Recovered refusal coverage is distinct and less complete than execution coverage
body: Ten exact control IDs can count as accepted coverage while terminal remains skipped_requires_authority, with rendered/visible/attempted, four nonempty explanation strings, failure/recovery observed and at least one noncomplete stage. Full stage set/evidence/unique IDs are not required. Stage Map takes last duplicate; nonarray errors are ignored in this helper.
note: 05 Findings/D1699 Recovered refusal coverage is distinct and less complete than execution coverage.md

title: Process output normalization leaves unknown closure to callers
body: normalizeProcessOutput only emits closure issue for explicit false, and only checks exit if walkerExit exists. Missing exit/closure yields zero issues in probe. Generic error-word matching examines stderr rather than stdout, while selected token/unresponsive patterns examine both. Launcher applies stricter explicit-true closure checks separately.
note: 05 Findings/D1700 Process output normalization leaves unknown closure to callers.md

title: Diagnostic exceptions are exact lexical policy, not independent attribution
body: Four console patterns and paired Windows Jump List output are downgraded as external warnings. They depend on message/location text rather than authenticated origin. A responsive line anywhere marks unresponsive observation recovered without chronological/PID pairing, but unresponsiveness correctly remains blocking.
note: 05 Findings/D1701 Diagnostic exceptions are exact lexical policy, not independent attribution.md

title: Terminal severity precedence is source-driven
body: Blocking process/page/console wins failed, source_identity/extension_host wins blocked, other blocking sources yield incomplete. Severity error itself does not force failed; profile errors become incomplete. Exit codes map completed/failed/incomplete/blocked to 0/1/2/3, so consumers must preserve both scope and issue provenance.
note: 05 Findings/D1702 Terminal severity precedence is source-driven.md

title: Bootstrap completion is a narrower flag proof
body: Bootstrap evaluator requires ready plus extension found, activation, command registered/executed and storage verified. It does not check exact extension/command identity, signature, source hash, receipt schema or screenshot. Its operationally_complete means bootstrap predicate passed, not the complete product walk.
note: 05 Findings/D1703 Bootstrap completion is a narrower flag proof.md

title: Status tests model predicate inputs rather than physical operational evidence
body: completeReceipt has six attempted controls with terminal strings and aggregate counts but no stages/evidence. Focused cases construct booleans and mutate selected failure fields. These test predicate behavior, including exact diagnostic exceptions; they do not execute installed host, verify signatures or independently establish every represented lifecycle.
note: 05 Findings/D1704 Status tests model predicate inputs rather than physical operational evidence.md

title: Disposable engine copy is not a consistent full-tree snapshot
body: Copy excludes current coordination locks, evidence/caches and links. Afterwards only runtime/cli.py and registry/engine_identity.json are re-copied and checked with three before/after attempts. Other copied files lack identity comparison or two matching whole-tree snapshots. Counters describe initial enumeration and can differ after the re-copy.
note: 05 Findings/D1705 Disposable engine copy is not a consistent full-tree snapshot.md

title: Copy and fixture path checks leave pathname intervals
body: Engine source/root lstat then realpath checks reject root links; cp filter checks child entries at enumeration time. Later copy/read/removal occurs by path, allowing changes after checks. Some fixture helpers realpath first then lstat the resolved result, which does not reject a linked caller-supplied root, and lexical inside does not inspect every ancestor.
note: 05 Findings/D1706 Copy and fixture path checks leave pathname intervals.md

title: Loopback port readiness is not process identity
body: reserveLoopbackPort listens on port zero then closes before VS Code starts, leaving a reuse race. probeCdp accepts HTTP200 and any truthy webSocketDebuggerUrl without matching expected host/PID/port. Its 1-second timeout is socket inactivity, not an overall response deadline; an ongoing body is sliced to 16KiB while waiting for end.
note: 05 Findings/D1707 Loopback port readiness is not process identity.md

title: Storage isolation is inferred from chunk-local stdout text
body: storageBoundaryObserver recognizes shared-storage database paths only within each stdout chunk and accumulates paths without a cap. Split log text can be missed; classified paths are lexical rather than physical. Recognized in-memory or owned path plus no observed external path becomes verified, not an independent inspection of all host storage.
note: 05 Findings/D1708 Storage isolation is inferred from chunk-local stdout text.md

title: Proxy flags and denial sentinels are not network containment
body: Launch environment sets HTTP(S) proxies to dead loopback and NO_PROXY loopback after billing-key filtering. Sentinel checks only uppercase proxy strings; clients can ignore proxy environment or use other protocols. Native helper and runtime fixture invocations use nonBillableEnvironment rather than the same proxy wrapper. No network attempt was made by this audit.
note: 05 Findings/D1709 Proxy flags and denial sentinels are not network containment.md

title: Selected Python is not used by every child
body: resolveOwnedPython accepts arbitrary requested string or a plain certification executable before system fallback. VS Code and walker receive config.pythonPath, but native helper always spawns python and runtime fixture command chooses system python/python3. Existence is not dependency/version/digest verification.
note: 05 Findings/D1710 Selected Python is not used by every child.md

title: Installed VSIX hash check proves archive stability during install only
body: Child hashes VSIX before install against prepared digest, invokes native CLI with a 120-second bound and English success substring, then rehashes archive. It does not independently compare all installed bytes here. Ordinary source mode runs live extensionRoot while engine is a prior copy, so separate source identity checks are necessary.
note: 05 Findings/D1711 Installed VSIX hash check proves archive stability during install only.md

title: Ordinary operational host and bootstrap host follow separate activation routes
body: Bootstrap-only supplies extensionTestsPath and waits for ready JSON/registered/executed flags. Ordinary host records deferred-to-operational-walker and relies on walker to open dashboard. It waits for CDP and recognized storage first. Native profiles require Windows/cached executable and receive native secret/root/PID; other modes may download pinned host.
note: 05 Findings/D1712 Ordinary operational host and bootstrap host follow separate activation routes.md

title: Local host waits rely partly on the outer owner deadline
body: Initial cache/download and walker exit have no child-local total timeout; outer worker is thirty minutes or explicitly one hour. JSON receipt wait reads existing file before checking host exit and has no size/link/atomic-read guard. No correlation schema is required by generic waitForJsonFile itself.
note: 05 Findings/D1713 Local host waits rely partly on the outer owner deadline.md

title: Sequential child finalization can prevent later cleanup
body: Finally writes sentinel, terminates walker, writes progress, requests native stop, awaits/races helper, terminates VS Code then publishes result. Some awaited termination/progress/receipt writes are not independently caught; an early failure can skip later cleanup and child-result. Parent timeout/process owner may still reconcile independently.
note: 05 Findings/D1714 Sequential child finalization can prevent later cleanup.md

title: Natural walker exit is recorded as termination verification
body: After waitForExit the child sets walker_termination_verified=true without descendant verification in that branch. Helper natural exit considers no signal termination verified even when nonzero; it adds separate failure string later, which normalizer drops. Full parent process-tree proof is a different owner and must not be conflated.
note: 05 Findings/D1715 Natural walker exit is recorded as termination verification.md

title: Walk cleanup marker and retry boundaries are partial
body: Cleanup requires supplied tree closure, direct os.tmpdir child with fixed prefix, root not symlink and marker owner/classification. Marker itself is not checked for symlink, schema, session/PID binding or retention obligations. Retry loop does not recheck root identity, and caller options attempts/delay are Number-converted without finite upper bounds. No cleanup was executed in this audit.
note: 05 Findings/D1716 Walk cleanup marker and retry boundaries are partial.md

title: Owned acquisition fallback can remove a custom root without the normal gate
body: acquireWalkOwnership obtains lease before temporary allocation, a useful duplicate-owner boundary. If marking a custom makeTemporaryRoot result fails, catch directly rmSync recursively on that returned path rather than using safeOwnedEphemeralCleanup. Default allocation is mkdtemp; custom injection can widen this fallback target. Lease release follows best-effort removal.
note: 05 Findings/D1717 Owned acquisition fallback can remove a custom root without the normal gate.md

title: Post-worker failures can bypass cleanup and final receipt
body: After runOwnedHostWorker returns/releases its lease, owner reads child/fixture JSON and hashes source without an encompassing finally. Parse/hash failures occur before settleOwnedEphemeralCleanup. Successful cleanup removes temp root before final wx report write, so a report collision can lose the child evidence kept only there. Final worker assertion also occurs after report publication.
note: 05 Findings/D1718 Post-worker failures can bypass cleanup and final receipt.md

title: Evidence output scope is lexical and prior walk output may be reused
body: main checks repository-relative paths and refuses existing reportPath, but does not require walkOutput absent or check every ancestor for links. prepare recursively creates output, progress appends and walker receipt overwrites its fixed name. Existing output can mix prior progress/artifacts with new run; exact timestamp/ownership correlation is not enforced here.
note: 05 Findings/D1719 Evidence output scope is lexical and prior walk output may be reused.md

title: Final source labels are sampled after the host run
body: Final report hashes live extension entry, walker, bootstrap and VSIX after child execution. These are not compared with initial copies/loaded bytes in this report builder. Required engine file digests describe earlier staging. Source mutation during execution can mix evidence generations unless separate identity consumers reject it.
note: 05 Findings/D1720 Final source labels are sampled after the host run.md

title: Fixture construction changes multiple authorities before a complete receipt
body: Knowledge fixture creates workspace directories/files then validates/writes engine registry. Host-boundary fixture writes coordination plan, initializes workspace/project, activates, ingests and transitions up to 64 memory IDs twice before provider policy change. Failure late leaves earlier disposable changes; no transactional rollback exists inside these helper functions.
note: 05 Findings/D1721 Fixture construction changes multiple authorities before a complete receipt.md

title: Fixture memory certification and provider readiness are scoped assertions
body: Runtime fixture helper checks valid/applied flags for transitions with literal evidence labels, then reports lifecycle certified. Provider fixture copies an enabled Ollama budget and adds zero-charge deny-unknown row. This prepares a fixture rather than proving independent research, billing behavior, model availability or production canonical quality.
note: 05 Findings/D1722 Fixture memory certification and provider readiness are scoped assertions.md

title: Progress retention has a read/hash interval and no lifecycle chain
body: Readers cap file size and validate schemas/states but then hash by a separate file read, not the parsed bytes. Profile reader accepts empty input and checks no profile start/end pairing, timestamps or owner; last record is copied without field sanitization. Host writer whitelists pid/ready_after_ms but appends by path without rejecting a linked existing target.
note: 05 Findings/D1723 Progress retention has a read/hash interval and no lifecycle chain.md

title: Focused lane isolation is an explicit alternate lease key
body: main rejects multiple focused modes and restricts post-audit long-running to full. A validated lane name with any focused profile selects a separate temp lock rather than global host lock; same profile can run in distinct lanes. Root/fixture separation is still required; lane string alone does not prove independent scopes.
note: 05 Findings/D1724 Focused lane isolation is an explicit alternate lease key.md

title: Isolated launcher tests mix real narrow fixtures with source regex contracts
body: Tests physically copy small trees, hash source fixtures, exercise lease collision and prelaunch failure, and open a loopback test server. Many profile/native/network guarantees are assertions that source contains specific strings. Canonical memory runtimeCommand is mocked to return valid/applied, so that test proves call order and local fixture bytes rather than backend certification.
note: 05 Findings/D1725 Isolated launcher tests mix real narrow fixtures with source regex contracts.md

title: Cache subprocess test isolation is platform-dependent and unbounded
body: runIsolatedCacheOwner changes TEMP/TMP but not HOME/cache override; cache owner uses home-based root on Linux. Its subprocess has no timeout or nonbilling environment filtering. The test writes fixed cache-layout fixtures and removes a temp directory afterwards; it is not evidence of universally isolated cache behavior.
note: 05 Findings/D1726 Cache subprocess test isolation is platform-dependent and unbounded.md

title: Storage and native finalizer tests leave operational gaps
body: Storage tests toggle in-memory flags rather than parsing split real output; native finalizer test checks source regex and waits one millisecond. They do not exercise helper exit errors passing through status normalization or failures interrupting sequential cleanup. Those gaps were found by caller review and pure status probes.
note: 05 Findings/D1727 Storage and native finalizer tests leave operational gaps.md

title: Source manifest does not close complete loaded-byte identity
body: currentSourceManifest hashes only source_refs declared by the matrix, before browser work. It rejects outside lexical paths and leaf links, but does not reject linked ancestors or bind all preview/controller/harness assets. There is no final source equality check. sourcePath splits the first colon, so Windows absolute references are not supported.
note: 05 Findings/D1728 Source manifest does not close complete loaded-byte identity.md

title: Equal matrix digest bypasses changed source and chain verification
body: resumeReceiptCompatible returns after checking record count and ordered control IDs when matrix_sha256 matches. It does not compare current source manifest or check surface, kind, evidence mode, interaction chain or operational boolean on that branch. Pure exported probe accepted changed source with an absent chain.
note: 05 Findings/D1729 Equal matrix digest bypasses changed source and chain verification.md

title: Metadata-change resume validates policy parity rather than evidence truth
body: The slower branch compares manifests and exact record identity plus thirteen stage keys and not-applicable parity. It does not recompute operational, require legal states for required stages, verify evidence references, dates or error types. Copied records retain prior assertions.
note: 05 Findings/D1730 Metadata-change resume validates policy parity rather than evidence truth.md

title: Default resume leaves incomplete error-free controls untouched
body: Without a pattern, resume selects only rows whose errors have length. A row with missing stages, operational=false and errors=[] is never rerun. This is confirmed by exact filter reproduction. A pattern may select only part of inherited evidence.
note: 05 Findings/D1731 Default resume leaves incomplete error-free controls untouched.md

title: Predecessor digest may describe later bytes than parsed receipt
body: Resume JSON is read before browser launch and the predecessor path is read again for its digest after browser work. Concurrent changes can make the retained records and predecessor_sha256 disagree. Neither read bounds size or rejects a linked path.
note: 05 Findings/D1732 Predecessor digest may describe later bytes than parsed receipt.md

title: Control selectors can alias distinct indicators
body: Multiple indicators resolve to the same metric card, provider container, cleanup summary or graph-state element. Direct resolution proves the first selector match is visible, without validating the requested state/value. Semantic fallback ranks substrings; the token id matches invalid with score one.
note: 05 Findings/D1733 Control selectors can alias distinct indicators.md

title: Row variant is not an exact repeated-row identity
body: variantsMatch accepts row if any dataset key contains id, index, row or key; even invalid is accepted. Other variants may match any dataset value or visual context. resolveAction returns first compatible item without uniqueness or target-row verification.
note: 05 Findings/D1734 Row variant is not an exact repeated-row identity.md

title: Preview fixtures are declared inputs rather than host observations
body: prepare injects loading/error/catalog/project/plugin/runtime/task/Studio states using window.eval and synthetic MessageEvents. Sidebar fixture includes connected execution/provider billing state. The receipt correctly limits authority to contained browser evidence; maps must preserve that boundary.
note: 05 Findings/D1735 Preview fixtures are declared inputs rather than host observations.md

title: Preparation reuse can mix state across semantic controls
body: preparationKey isolates a selected regex of state-bound IDs; other field/editor/indicator controls reuse a surface. Mutating input handlers, local drafts and uncaught restoration differences can influence subsequent controls. revealControl false does not prevent exercise; it only contributes to resetting the cache.
note: 05 Findings/D1736 Preparation reuse can mix state across semantic controls.md

title: Prerequisite setup uses direct DOM actions and synthetic authority previews
body: Studio prerequisites call element.click with no visibility check and choose first matching dataset; graph endpoint pairs are selected by type text. Plugin preview grants/tokens and environment exact-target acknowledgements are fixture-generated. These make controls reachable without verifying native authority.
note: 05 Findings/D1737 Prerequisite setup uses direct DOM actions and synthetic authority previews.md

title: Action validation credit follows successful click dispatch
body: exercise sets validationObserved=true after click and a fixed delay, without testing invalid input or reading a validation result. contained_ui_interaction acknowledgement is unconditional after that; other modes only require outbound message count growth, not a correlated accepted response.
note: 05 Findings/D1738 Action validation credit follows successful click dispatch.md

title: Field restoration does not prove logical state rollback
body: Fields are edited and reset, then attempted is promoted to validation and acknowledgement. No post-value or model-state comparison is performed. If an earlier edit or restoration throws, only disclosure-open state is in finally, so earlier changes may remain.
note: 05 Findings/D1739 Field restoration does not prove logical state rollback.md

title: Absent numeric bounds are converted to zero
body: Number(await getAttribute(min/max)) converts null to zero. For ordinary number inputs without attributes, alternate selection may fail to exercise the field despite a valid editable control. The harness needs explicit missing-bound semantics.
note: 05 Findings/D1740 Absent numeric bounds are converted to zero.md

title: Form failure test validates browser custom validity rather than product rejection
body: The first visible editable field is changed/restored, then setCustomValidity injects a temporary failure and clears it. This verifies local browser validity and field value, not the product validator, persistence or runtime recovery. Re-rendering may leave the captured field detached from current DOM/model.
note: 05 Findings/D1741 Form failure test validates browser custom validity rather than product rejection.md

title: Form restoration can disturb coupled controls and derived state
body: Checkbox/radio assignment, select changes and input events may alter other fields, derived draft state or retained working history. Only the chosen field object and validity flags are compared. Event-triggered dispatch is not counted, yet host stages are declared not applicable.
note: 05 Findings/D1742 Form restoration can disturb coupled controls and derived state.md

title: Unknown stage policy fails open to not applicable
body: Only the literal required makes a stage required. Missing, misspelled or unsupported policy values produce not_applicable rather than rejecting malformed matrix. completeChain accepts those states. Main parses JSON without a schema validation call.
note: 05 Findings/D1743 Unknown stage policy fails open to not applicable.md

title: Contained form policy overrides explicitly required host stages
body: stageResult sets authorization, backend_dispatch and runtime_effect not_applicable whenever evidence_mode is contained_ui_form, even if stage_policy requires them and probe is not attempted. A pure predicate probe confirms the override; this is a local interaction scope decision, not full control coverage.
note: 05 Findings/D1744 Contained form policy overrides explicitly required host stages.md

title: Visible error-named indicator receives failure credit without error content
body: Failure handling is marked present when an indicator is visible and the control ID/label matches an error word. It need not expose an actual failure value or request identity. Progress reporting similarly follows indicator visibility. The test endorses this predicate.
note: 05 Findings/D1745 Visible error-named indicator receives failure credit without error content.md

title: Fallback editor and gesture checks can acknowledge swallowed input errors
body: Generic menu/editor probes catch key/click errors and still set all three attempted/validation/acknowledged flags. Unrecognized non-knowledge graph gesture focuses, catches ArrowRight error and returns true. Drag-existing-workflow-node also returns true without comparing coordinates.
note: 05 Findings/D1746 Fallback editor and gesture checks can acknowledge swallowed input errors.md

title: Graph gesture evidence is narrower than named gesture families
body: plusMinus tests plus only and zeroOrHome tests zero only. Arrow focus checks inequality, which can pass if focus leaves nodes. Synthetic wheel/pointer events do not independently prove native input routing. Other graph cases use before/after transform datasets, a useful but bounded observation.
note: 05 Findings/D1747 Graph gesture evidence is narrower than named gesture families.md

title: Operational boolean and process success use different predicates
body: Per-record operational depends solely on completeChain, ignoring probe.errors. Receipt operationally_complete compares operational count to all records; process exitCode is set only for aggregate errors. Missing controls/chains can therefore leave exit zero, while errors may coexist with operational true.
note: 05 Findings/D1748 Operational boolean and process success use different predicates.md

title: Parallel browser preparation failures lose partial receipt publication
body: prepare/reveal failures escape the per-control exercise catch. Promise.all rejects, browser finally closes, but the final receipt write is skipped. No progress receipt/checkpoint is written between controls. Browser launch/newPage and cleanup failures have separate partial-resource windows.
note: 05 Findings/D1749 Parallel browser preparation failures lose partial receipt publication.md

title: Output is exclusive but path and read scope are not constrained locally
body: output/resume resolve arbitrary CLI paths; output uses wx after recursive directory creation, protecting existing leaf files but not linked ancestors. Worker count is clamped but not required integer. User regex has no complexity bound; matrix/receipt/source sizes are unbounded in this owner.
note: 05 Findings/D1750 Output is exclusive but path and read scope are not constrained locally.md

title: Exhaustive walker tests mostly certify helper predicates and text
body: Tests assert CSS strings, fixture fields, stage states and source regex. Help is a real bounded subprocess. No test runs the complete browser main, resumes stale same-matrix source, or compares model rollback with DOM restoration. Tests were fully read, not run in this report audit.
note: 05 Findings/D1751 Exhaustive walker tests mostly certify helper predicates and text.md

title: Dashboard end-to-end tests are preview browser tests
body: Every page loads file preview.html and uses fixture messages. Even installed Studio adversarial profile is invoked through page.evaluate on preview. Tests exercise real browser controller behavior but not an installed VS Code host, physical Python effects, canonical persistence or authority verification.
note: 05 Findings/D1752 Dashboard end-to-end tests are preview browser tests.md

title: Approval correlation tests omit current workflow replacement
body: The two-node approval case tests stale/duplicate request IDs and distinct nodes within one unchanged workflow session. It does not switch workflow/version while a response is pending, leaving the cross-session assignment reproduced in batch96 uncovered.
note: 05 Findings/D1753 Approval correlation tests omit current workflow replacement.md

title: Screenshot manifest can include stale evidence from earlier runs
body: writeVisualManifest enumerates every PNG in fixed extension/evidence/screenshots. Two tests overwrite named screenshots and rewrite one manifest without an exact expected set, per-run directory or source digest. Surviving old PNGs acquire the new manifest timestamp/browser label.
note: 05 Findings/D1754 Screenshot manifest can include stale evidence from earlier runs.md

title: Visual assertions cover geometry rather than all rendered accessibility
body: Checks assert containment/overlap, finite CSS transforms, target widths, forced-color media and screenshot byte length. They do not perform pixel-baseline comparison, comprehensive contrast/readability or assistive-technology verification. The 720px/DPR2 case is a reflow proxy, not an actual browser zoom setting.
note: 05 Findings/D1755 Visual assertions cover geometry rather than all rendered accessibility.md

title: Suspended-frame test accepts render acknowledgement without completed frame work
body: Test replaces requestAnimationFrame with a no-op and waits for a graphRendered message with positive counts/dimensions. It proves the fallback acknowledgement remains live, not that all chunked graph rendering or paint completed. This matches the graph evidence boundary recorded in batch96.
note: 05 Findings/D1756 Suspended-frame test accepts render acknowledgement without completed frame work.md

title: Long browser scenario shares state and aborts later checks on first failure
body: The large 300-second test combines eighteen route screenshots, Studio lineage/editing, graph gestures, scopes, memory, environment and seven width sweeps. Assertions are sequential: early failure prevents later coverage and final manifest. Fixed sleeps depend on preview timing; evidence retained before failure may remain for later runs.
note: 05 Findings/D1757 Long browser scenario shares state and aborts later checks on first failure.md

title: Draft and lineage tests preserve useful browser-side rejection boundaries
body: Tests reject substituted catalog revision, wrong-family/cross-kind allocation replies, lineage changes through JSON and detached stale save outcomes; they retain overlays and check proof-release requests. Hashes/proofs are fixture values. This is meaningful controller coverage, separate from authenticating host proofs or physical commit.
note: 05 Findings/D1758 Draft and lineage tests preserve useful browser-side rejection boundaries.md

title: Preview tests intentionally accept uncorrelated knowledge browse fixture
body: Knowledge head test dispatches studioOperationResult browse without requestId to seed malformed head and asserts proposal refusal. It does not assert rejection of obsolete browse responses; the stale cache boundary observed in batch96 remains.
note: 05 Findings/D1759 Preview tests intentionally accept uncorrelated knowledge browse fixture.md

title: Responsive route coverage is finite and does not equal all interaction coverage
body: Eighteen route headers/screenshots and selected high-risk actions are checked at one wide viewport; dashboard/graph seven-width sweeps and seven other mobile routes follow. Control matrix membership is not used to derive this test denominator, so the broad test name is not exhaustive control proof.
note: 05 Findings/D1760 Responsive route coverage is finite and does not equal all interaction coverage.md

title: Successive incomplete scenarios can merge into a complete installed chain
body: applyInstalledProbeObservations keeps already observed stages and promotes later present stages without a scenario/run identity. Complementary failed scenarios can therefore union into a complete chain although no scenario completed it. The report-only exported predicate probe reproduces this; separate child profile issues mitigate locally but the parent status reconstruction drops those issues.
note: 05 Findings/D1761 Successive incomplete scenarios can merge into a complete installed chain.md

title: Later failure does not revoke prior observed stages
body: The merger does not downgrade an existing observed stage when a later record reports missing or failed evidence. A previously complete record remains complete after a total-failure observation. Completion is chosen ahead of error/authority disposition, so retained stage state and latest outcome can disagree.
note: 05 Findings/D1762 Later failure does not revoke prior observed stages.md

title: Merged control records lose profile errors and exact evidence custody
body: Input record errors are used for a terminal branch but not copied into the resulting control errors array. Stage records have no enforced source/run/request/time binding and preserve base observation timestamps. Exact thirteen input keys do not authenticate evidence references or the preexisting stage denominator.
note: 05 Findings/D1763 Merged control records lose profile errors and exact evidence custody.md

title: Applicability can be widened during installed evidence composition
body: An incoming not-applicable observation can replace a missing stage without rechecking matrix policy. Inline command inheritance fills every required target stage once its source chain is complete, even when the corresponding source stage was not applicable. Inline entrypoints are not physically exercised by this copy.
note: 05 Findings/D1764 Applicability can be widened during installed evidence composition.md

title: Builder observation projects shared success onto individual controls
body: Builder attribution sets exact resolver/render/attempt flags from broad draft observations, shares screenshot references across builders and credits stages when a digest exists rather than when it changes. Same-webview resume and shared durability flags are not separate persistence/reload proof for each action.
note: 05 Findings/D1765 Builder observation projects shared success onto individual controls.md

title: Raw asset verification is narrower than complete installed-code identity
body: The identity enumerates top-level dashboard/src JavaScript and selected fixed assets, excluding generated host code and missing nested CSS/server deployment code. Host manifest hash difference is explicitly intentional because packaging changes main; it needs complementary generated/installed byte provenance, not raw equality. This predicate alone cannot certify all loaded code.
note: 05 Findings/D1766 Raw asset verification is narrower than complete installed-code identity.md

title: Verified installed source is not rebound to final current bytes
body: The local identity is sampled once and cached through refreshes. Only unknown state receives late refresh; verified identity is not rechecked after effectful profiles or against final source bytes. Host matches=true can coexist with mismatch reasons, and protocol strings are not compared to exact supported values.
note: 05 Findings/D1767 Verified installed source is not rebound to final current bytes.md

title: Source mismatch is not a universal stop before effectful profiles
body: Main gates initial captures/builders and late checks on mismatch but still schedules project, configuration, Studio, Knowledge, Learning, coordination, cleanup and plugin effects from authority flags. The final limitation text saying mismatch blocks further interaction is broader than the implemented schedule. Unknown identity also permits work.
note: 05 Findings/D1768 Source mismatch is not a universal stop before effectful profiles.md

title: Proof-matrix preflight compares counts rather than exact contracts
body: Before effects, main compares only proofMatrix.controls.length and inventory.control_count. Equal-count substituted IDs, policy/evidence modes, duplicate controls or manifest drift are not rejected there. The matrix file is reread for a final digest after effects, which can describe different bytes than the parsed schedule.
note: 05 Findings/D1769 Proof-matrix preflight compares counts rather than exact contracts.md

title: Owned-host flags do not themselves prove exact host authority
body: Child authority derives from PX_OWNED_VSCODE_HOST and an argv token prefix plus effect flags. This is not marker/PID/birth/root custody and some prefix checks admit an empty token. The parent and individual helpers have additional checks; their proof cannot be inferred solely from these booleans.
note: 05 Findings/D1770 Owned-host flags do not themselves prove exact host authority.md

title: Timeout returns without cancellation or reconciliation of underlying UI work
body: boundedOwnedUiAction and content/locator boundaries use Promise.race. On timeout the original operation may continue mutating browser/product state while restoration or a later profile begins. Reacquisition clears failure latches without joining prior tasks. Tests use never-resolving promises and do not exercise a late completion after reset.
note: 05 Findings/D1771 Timeout returns without cancellation or reconciliation of underlying UI work.md

title: Local phase budgets do not guarantee whole-operation elapsed bounds
body: Several helpers start deadlines after navigation or await predicates outside timeout ownership; nested phases receive fresh full budgets. Content handle acquisition occurs before the evaluation timeout. Invalid numeric options are not consistently rejected. A bounded inner wait does not prove aggregate operation duration.
note: 05 Findings/D1772 Local phase budgets do not guarantee whole-operation elapsed bounds.md

title: Profile health and prerequisite failure can diverge
body: timedProfile collects errors but generally does not require completed=true or an exact observation denominator. Pre-builder baseline failure is returned and ignored; builder outer catch is usually bypassed because timedProfile swallowed the exception. Studio candidate watchdog can return only an attempted prefix; later candidates never enter its denominator.
note: 05 Findings/D1773 Profile health and prerequisite failure can diverge.md

title: Late diagnostics are omitted from earlier fault partitions
body: faultDiagnostics is computed before late identity refresh and worker/controller/bridge profiles. New hostErrors appended later do not enter retained/recovered arrays used by final receipt and late-card completeness input. Initial page listeners also do not cover pages created later.
note: 05 Findings/D1774 Late diagnostics are omitted from earlier fault partitions.md

title: Receipt publication precedes owned browser closure and is not atomic
body: Main overwrites the final receipt before viewport detach/browser.close, so closure failure can leave a completed-looking artifact with process exit1. Early failure may leave an older receipt in place. Progress appends to a preexisting path without a new exclusive run envelope. No final cleanup receipt binds released frame/listener ownership.
note: 05 Findings/D1775 Receipt publication precedes owned browser closure and is not atomic.md

title: Native fallback accepts operation type without exact request target
body: nativeWorkbenchRequestFallbackAdmitted checks request.type and allowed label/type mapping, not a nonempty request ID, target, current terminal state or authority token. After750ms an observed request can trigger keyboard-only fallback even with no visible native blocker. Pure probe accepted permanent-delete mapping with only type. Physical helper PID checks are separate and do not restore missing effect-target binding.
note: 05 Findings/D1776 Native fallback accepts operation type without exact request target.md

title: Native dialog selection can escape exact dialog identity
body: Dialog discovery searches all context pages by text and may fall back to an actionable ancestor or body. Click resolution searches matching labels in dialog and workbench, selecting a visible candidate without uniqueness or exact request-to-dialog identity. Escape cancellation can report success without proving the expected modal was active.
note: 05 Findings/D1777 Native dialog selection can escape exact dialog identity.md

title: Palette disappearance can reuse a stale command identity
body: Command selection normalizes visible labels rather than contributed command IDs/publisher. When the palette disappears the decision helper may retain last valid identity and continue Enter dispatch; acceptedPrompt can accept closure without observing that prompt. Focus or tab changes can redirect keyboard effects.
note: 05 Findings/D1778 Palette disappearance can reuse a stale command identity.md

title: Harness event interception is weaker than production authority refusal
body: Workbench/sidebar/control/validation failure scenarios inject capture handlers or custom validity, then assert blocked input. This proves the harness can suppress an event or force browser invalidity, not that product policy rejects the unauthorized request at the backend. Maps distinguish synthetic refusal from governed rejection.
note: 05 Findings/D1779 Harness event interception is weaker than production authority refusal.md

title: Generic control acknowledgement can accept unrelated state change
body: Local acknowledgement follows attempted/restored flags; host acknowledgement can follow any response count increase or body-text change. Conditional recovery matches type/kind/operation without exact request ID or success state. Attempted input broadly yields validation credit, while first/broad/fuzzy selectors can alias controls.
note: 05 Findings/D1780 Generic control acknowledgement can accept unrelated state change.md

title: Body-text fingerprints do not cover editor and graph state restoration
body: Editor/gesture probes compare body-text FNV/length, which can remain constant when values, transforms, graph geometry or model state change. Field probes restore captured elements without guaranteed finally or replacement-node/model equality. Numeric suffix editing can become empty while still counted attempted.
note: 05 Findings/D1781 Body-text fingerprints do not cover editor and graph state restoration.md

title: Synthetic failures share instrumentation with real host messages
body: Bridge listeners record every message and custom outbound event in the same arrays, including injected operation errors and fixture snapshots. No provenance distinction marks synthetic versus actual host results; arrays are unbounded and listeners are not removed by the instrumentation owner.
note: 05 Findings/D1782 Synthetic failures share instrumentation with real host messages.md

title: Frame retry and tab recovery do not prove previous effect closure
body: Cached webview identity does not always recheck outer visibility. Selected frame errors can retry an operation after it already affected state; reacquisition resets latches without closure. Failed tab focus can be caught before Ctrl+W closes the currently active tab. Label/selector/time-origin checks are narrower than exact process custody.
note: 05 Findings/D1783 Frame retry and tab recovery do not prove previous effect closure.md

title: Stable samples need valid counts and stable identity
body: Settlement counts consecutive boolean acknowledgements, not the same element or source revision. Required sample count0 or negative can accept unacknowledged state; the report pure probe reproduces zero-sample acceptance. Scope/capability references can also become detached after preparatory clicks.
note: 05 Findings/D1784 Stable samples need valid counts and stable identity.md

title: Host action durable naming describes in-memory retention
body: Host result waiters consult current response arrays, controller globals and latest snapshot, matched by request/operation and a lower time bound. Extension state is in memory, not a persisted journal; tests explicitly forbid globalState retention. This can support webview reconstruction while not proving extension-process restart durability.
note: 05 Findings/D1785 Host action durable naming describes in-memory retention.md

title: Configuration acknowledgements have weaker branches than host-action receipts
body: Enterprise response matching uses operation and Boolean(master_enabled), not exact request/status, allowing absent state to resemble disabled. Approval may return a read acknowledgement before final disposition validation. Fault marker errors are operation-matched rather than request-bound and the config marker differs from the consumed host-action marker.
note: 05 Findings/D1786 Configuration acknowledgements have weaker branches than host-action receipts.md

title: Host prerequisite failure can lose its restoration record
body: Preparation makes changes before returning the scenario, so throwing during preparation can leave the caller without baseline state. A repeated preparation result is discarded. Activity settings restore writes original bytes without intermediate compare-and-swap and may overwrite concurrent edits; root/link ownership is not fully established here.
note: 05 Findings/D1787 Host prerequisite failure can lose its restoration record.md

title: Canonical memory normalization can precede reliable predecessor capture
body: Attached state is disconnected before its previous root is fully validated. On failure, an already attached state may be marked restored without comparing root; failure before baseline capture leaves a false detached default and may disconnect a preexisting attachment. Restoration checks selected UI/target fields rather than exact registry state.
note: 05 Findings/D1788 Canonical memory normalization can precede reliable predecessor capture.md

title: Setup and candidate evidence are attributed beyond exact exercised controls
body: Setup has useful exact request-to-terminal matching, but one agents setup action and generic positive counts credit multiple controls/indicators. Candidate invalid-identity fallback uses harness customValidity if product validation does not reject it. Typed receipt checks verify identity/version/hash shape, not persisted artifact hash equality.
note: 05 Findings/D1789 Setup and candidate evidence are attributed beyond exact exercised controls.md

title: Revision preservation does not compare pre-save predecessor hashes
body: predecessor_preserved checks original owner and hash shape in the predecessor read after save. It never compares those hashes with pre-save allocation/source/candidate hashes. Changed predecessor content can therefore satisfy preserved if selected owner remains. Reopened editor comparison checks owner/identity/version, not complete saved content bytes.
note: 05 Findings/D1790 Revision preservation does not compare pre-save predecessor hashes.md

title: Revision stale-response and conflict fixtures omit complete predecessor restoration
body: Skill stale_result_rejected is preset, while agent/workflow cases inject malformed unmatched allocation responses. Conflict/fork scenarios assign globals and synthetic hashes then clear selected request state; no full original draft/proof/catalog restoration or valid late concurrent response is demonstrated.
note: 05 Findings/D1791 Revision stale-response and conflict fixtures omit complete predecessor restoration.md

title: Lifecycle result predicates omit expected run and revision identity
body: Many predicates accept operation schema/status and any run ID. Pause/cancel/stop durable-run receipts need no expected terminal state; rollback accepts a rolled-back object. Pure probe accepted another run with failed state for pause. Later status waiting adds checks but earlier operation.valid remains true after subsequent failure.
note: 05 Findings/D1792 Lifecycle result predicates omit expected run and revision identity.md

title: Lifecycle stage attribution can survive failed sequencing
body: The builder credits all required stages from one valid same-operation observation or shared invalid-transition flag; missing action is treated as rejected transition. Run-control selectors omit exact run/kind, and the profile has no universal finally to stop/release unfinished work. Per-kind merge can replace prior identity observations.
note: 05 Findings/D1793 Lifecycle stage attribution can survive failed sequencing.md

title: Learning effectiveness evidence is supplied by the fixture
body: The installed Learning profile hashes deterministic labels, supplies six challenger wins, an independent:true reference and12/12 reuse outcomes. These are valid UI state-machine inputs, not independently retained observation artifacts or measured causal improvement. Shared completion credits fields/actions not individually exercised.
note: 05 Findings/D1794 Learning effectiveness evidence is supplied by the fixture.md

title: Knowledge and coordination waiters are not uniformly request-bound
body: Knowledge operations/browse and coordination results often match type/kind/operation after an offset. Browse may precede the mutation and another same-operation result may match. Selected proposal/head/hash and task/confirmed checks are useful but do not establish all request/state ordering or full durable content.
note: 05 Findings/D1795 Knowledge and coordination waiters are not uniformly request-bound.md

title: Coordination and Codex error exits can leave partial durable state
body: Plans, task claims, memory and context are created; claim release and normal restoration occur on the success path without a universal failure finally. Context tab text or cleared receipt does not independently establish saved-context absence. Shared flags credit many fields and entrypoints beyond their individual actions.
note: 05 Findings/D1796 Coordination and Codex error exits can leave partial durable state.md
